records.t: 關於
records.x: About Non Dubito and its author Han Qin (秦汉).
records.q: About 关于

records.t: AI 與人的問題
records.x: AI 与人的问题核心八篇：价值危机、图灵测试、欲望、学习、意识、孤独、内省与道德。中英日法德西韩七种语言版本，中文提供简繁阅读模式。
records.q: AI & the Human Question AI 与人的问题

records.t: AI能陪你說一整夜的話。但它消除不了孤獨。
records.x: AI companions can respond with remarkable fluency. What we have not established is that they have something of their own at stake — a distinction that matters for loneliness.
records.q: AI Can Talk to You All Night. It Cannot End Your Loneliness. AI能陪你说一整夜的话。 但它消除不了孤独。 The Best Listener in the World What AI Companionship Actually Solves The Recognition That Has Something at Stake Why AI Cannot Give You This Yet The Symptomatic Trap The Future Change and What It Means What to Do With This 世界上最好的倾听者 AI 伴侣真正解决了什么 那种把自己押上去的承认 为什么 AI 目前还给不了你这个 症状陷阱 未来的改变和它的含义 用这个认识做什么

records.t: AI 是顯影液，不是唯一病原
records.x: AI did not invent the fear of being replaced. It can act like photographic developer, making a latent image visible. The image was already there.
records.q: AI Didn't Create the Crisis. It Just Made You See It. AI 是显影液，不是唯一病原 What Does "Being Replaced" Actually Mean? Why This Isn't About AI Why "Competing with AI" Is a Dead End What Then? One Last Thing 代替的不安 被替代，意味着什么？ 为什么说这和 AI 没关系？ "与 AI 竞争"是一条死路 那怎么办？ 最后

records.t: 塗果醬的麵包
records.x: Denji's dreams are modest enough to satisfy one by one—and therefore easy for someone else to schedule and own.
records.q: Bread with Jam 涂果酱的面包 A list made under hunger The first meal comes with terms Cheap desires can be expensive to the person who has them A life grows beyond its list 那张清单上写着什么 供应成本 波奇塔 他被装在垃圾袋里 第一顿饭 尺寸

records.t: 每個人都在用同一個把手
records.x: Different people manipulate Denji through the same accessible desires, but use and harm are not identical relations.
records.q: Everyone Uses the Same Handle 每个人都在用同一个把手 Makima turns sequence into dependence The same mechanism appears in smaller encounters Use is common; totalization is the danger Kishibe's first lesson 那个把手 玛奇玛给的方式 姬野 帕瓦和那只猫 蕾塞 岸边说的第一条 使用和加害是两件事

records.t: 一個只有一個目的的人
records.x: Aki's revenge is self-chosen and knowingly costly; its singularity still lets another person hold the route to his life.
records.q: A Man with Only One Purpose 一个只有一个目的的人 A straight line can also be a leash Himeno's death does not end the line The unplanned purposes are real The purpose consumes its bearer 他要的是什么 他付的账 玛奇玛握着的是哪一头 姬野死了之后 他开始有别的东西 未来的恶魔看见的东西 那个目的怎么用完的

records.t: 她把他的屍體驅使上了戰場
records.x: Control treats a living will and a usable corpse alike; Power breaks prediction once, without surviving the refusal.
records.q: She Drove His Corpse onto the Battlefield 她把他的尸体驱使上了战场 Control reduces life to executable parts Power's ordinary operating system She goes off the predictable line Failure for one moment is still failure 支配是怎么工作的 秋的尸体 帕瓦 她拒绝了 那个能力失效的位置 而她并没有因此活下来 那天的电次

records.t: 白麵包
records.x: Makima wants equality but knows only ranking and possession; Denji answers with care whose future he cannot own.
records.q: White Bread 白面包 Her power begins with ranking She wants what her method cannot make Knowing a person is not seeing one A meal defeats the contract without becoming clean The second piece of white bread 她的能力有一个条件 同一个动作，两个方向 她要的东西 她从来没有看过站在她面前的人 只能被吃掉 白面包

records.t: 《電鋸人》解讀
records.x: Five essays on hunger, manipulation, single-purpose lives, the moment control fails, and two pieces of white bread at opposite ends of a story.
records.q: Reading Chainsaw Man 《电锯人》解读

records.t: 他們把底層裝了進去
records.x: After psychic power makes a single thought lethal, civilization survives by putting restraint beneath reflection. Peace is real; consent is no longer where it comes from.
records.q: They Installed the Foundation 他们把底层装了进去 The history omitted from childhood A solution that actually works The classification inside the mechanism 一千年前发生了什么 那个装置 这个方案是有效的 而它是怎么起作用的 装进去和长出来

records.t: 貓
records.x: The Tainted Cats do more than remove children judged dangerous. Altered memories remove the experience from everyone who might later question the judgment.
records.q: The Cat 猫 A nursery story with an administrative function The missing column in the calculation Losing the loss itself 它是真的 然后记忆被改掉 早季的姐姐 富子那一边 那笔账里没有的东西 记忆被改掉的那些人后来怎么样

records.t: 同族這個詞
records.x: The rules protecting humans remain intact because another population was physically moved beyond the protected category. Perfect compliance can preserve perfect exclusion.
records.q: The Word Kin 同族这个词 The servants outside the protected word What the last genetic report reveals Kiroumaru and Squealer 那些人类做不了的事 最后那个揭示 他们改的不是装置 此后的一切都是合法的 奇狼丸和野狐丸 一个词的边界

records.t: 我是人類
records.x: Squealer’s claim is true and his rebellion is murderous. The work refuses to make either fact erase the other—and shows why the court cannot hear the claim at all.
records.q: We Are Human 我是人类 The strongest case for rebellion The weapon he had to manufacture A true sentence the court cannot process 他做了什么 他那一边的理由 而他做的另一件事 他自己的族群 无限地狱 那句话

records.t: 她殺了一個自願的人
records.x: Kiroumaru chooses death to save his colony; Saki uses the child’s engineered recognition to trigger death feedback. Only afterward does she learn whom the category contained.
records.q: She Killed a Volunteer 她杀了一个自愿的人 The opening in an invincible weapon What Saki knew when she acted Knowledge that arrives after the irreversible act 那个办法 奇狼丸自愿 这个办法用的是什么 而她知道自己在做什么吗 然后她知道了 结尾 三件事

records.t: 《來自新世界》解讀
records.x: Five essays on peace installed beneath consent, children erased before they can object, a protected word with an altered boundary, a true claim laughed out of court, and the volunteer whose death saves the town.
records.q: Reading From the New World 《来自新世界》解读

records.t: 沒有原本的複製品
records.x: The Laughing Man appears to be one criminal, but is assembled from an unknown letter, Aoi's brief intervention, and uncoordinated imitators.
records.q: Copies Without an Original 没有原本的复制品 The scandal underneath is concrete A collective pattern impersonates an individual Even the “original” is derivative An ownerless symbol remains usable 那件案子 为什么有人要做这件事 葵做了什么 那些是别人干的 连原本也是空的 六年 那个标志本身

records.t: 一場被製造出來的自發
records.x: Gōda proves that disconnected, sincere action can be engineered—making spontaneous and manufactured movements observationally identical.
records.q: Manufactured Spontaneity 一场被制造出来的自发 The grievances are not fabricated From outside, the two movements look the same Kuze is an exception made by experience The survivor becomes a leader 前提 合田做了什么 从外面看是一样的 合田那一边 那个例外 而他见过同一件事 他后来做的事

records.t: 讓它們保持一致的那個裝置
records.x: The Tachikomas' nightly synchronization is designed to erase drift and instead supplies the material from which selves emerge.
records.q: The Device That Kept Them Alike 让它们保持一致的那个装置 Shared material produces different processing They ask questions no weapon needs Motoko is right to remove them from combat The useless act 那个装置 而差异是从那里长出来的 它们问的那些问题 素子把它们撤了下去 它们最后做的那件事 那件事对它们没有用

records.t: 她留了一個不一樣的人
records.x: Motoko recruits Togusa because his weakness is difference; the leader who values that difference cannot verify the originality of her own memories.
records.q: She Kept One Unlike Person 她留了一个不一样的人 Diversity is an engineering judgment Togusa looks where the others do not The recruiter cannot certify her own original Clear judgment does not require solved identity 她给的理由 他后来做的事 她自己那一部分 那个孩子 两件事放在一起

records.t: 從外面沒有驗法
records.x: Togusa's own anger leads him into the Laughing Man's borrowed form, collapsing the visible distinction between imitation and authorship.
records.q: There Is No External Test 从外面没有验法 The position has never been empty Togusa's anger is his; its form is borrowed Four questions lose their external answers Uncertainty does not cancel judgment 那个位置上站过多少人 素子那一次 托古萨那一次 把四个问题排在一起 而这不是一个悲观的结论 两个画面

records.t: 《攻殼機動隊 SAC》解讀
records.x: Five essays on copies without an original, manufactured spontaneity, difference born from synchronization, the value of an unlike member, and the impossibility of externally certifying an action as one's own.
records.q: Reading Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex 《攻壳机动队 SAC》解读

records.t: 她一直在做飯
records.x: Suzu chooses almost none of the structure around her, yet makes something particular from nearly every material placed in her hands.
records.q: She Kept Cooking 她一直在做饭 A life decided and a life made are not the same thing The main action is cooking Keiko shows the price of leaving an assigned place Good intention can repeat the structure 她是谁 她被嫁了 那个家 正文是什么 她做出来的那些东西 白木凛说的那句话 有人替她做了一个决定

records.t: The Right Hand
records.x: The delayed bomb kills Harumi and takes the hand through which Suzu drew, cooked, held, and met the world.
records.q: The Right Hand 右手 The film inventories acts, not functions The hand was holding a child Release and rejection can share a sentence Before interpretation comes relearning 那只右手做过的事 那只手牵着的人 径子说的话 她想回去，而那个念头意味着什么 她留下了 广岛那边

records.t: 飛走了
records.x: Japan's surrender does not first feel like relief to Suzu; it exposes the vanished reason by which she had agreed to endure.
records.q: It Flew Away 飞走了 The end reveals what endurance had meant The film relocates empire into her food She wishes she could have died without knowing Another bowl at the table 她喊的是什么 那段独白 电影和漫画不一样 那面旗 她说的最后一句 那个孩子 这部电影没有做的事

records.t: 《在這世界的角落》解讀
records.x: Three essays on cooking under decisions made by others, the right hand with which Suzu made a world, and the moment the reason for endurance suddenly flies away.
records.q: Reading In This Corner of the World 《在这世界的角落》解读

records.t: 日本動漫與漫畫
records.x: Non Dubito 日本动漫与漫画解读频道：二十二个系列，一百零六篇文章，从人物、制度、技术与关系结构重读动画和漫画。
records.q: Anime & Manga 日本动漫与漫画

records.t: 禁止兼任的是一條不成文的規矩
records.x: Rudolf enters through a legal opening, solves real failures, and turns popular authorization into a state with no place from which to appeal.
records.q: The Ban on Holding Both Offices Was Unwritten 禁止兼任的是一条不成文的规矩 The open door was customary, not legal The republic had genuinely failed Seven words remove the site of appeal The cure reproduces the disease 那扇门是开着的 联邦那一边 法条里那七个字 四十亿 他消掉了自己的意义 这一篇不打算做的事

records.t: 能攔住他的那個人
records.x: Westerland reveals two competing calculations—and the institutional cost of removing the one person who may contradict Reinhard.
records.q: The Man Who Could Stop Him 能拦住他的那个人 Oberstein's arithmetic is not frivolous A hesitation becomes responsibility The person who can object is also the person who can protect The excellent autocrat creates the hardest case 奥贝斯坦的账 动画版做的那一手 吉尔菲艾斯说的那些话 不应该有人能拦住他 那套东西是真的好 那套东西绑在什么上

records.t: 一個不肯拿的人
records.x: Yang defends a republic he despises because self-government locates responsibility differently—and refuses every chance to become its savior.
records.q: The Man Who Would Not Take It 一个不肯拿的人 The Free Planets Alliance is not an attractive republic His argument concerns ownership of error The institution keeps using and suspecting him The life he wanted was elsewhere 他所在的那个国家 他有过机会 这套制度一直在处理他 他本来想干别的 他确实出去过

records.t: 他死得什麼也沒證明
records.x: Yang is murdered on the road to peace, leaving no final demonstration of his democratic claim—only people who must decide what to do with it.
records.q: His Death Proved Nothing 他死得什么也没证明 The death produces nothing proportionate His political sentence remains unproved Julian inherits materials, not an office An idea no one can store for you 他最后说的是什么 这场死亡的性质 同一个形状出现过两次 一句没有被证明过的话 尤里安 那句话为什么还在

records.t: 如果那個最好的人不在了
records.x: The saga ends by asking how a system persists after excellence disappears—and declines to crown either autocracy or democracy the answer.
records.q: What If the Best Person Is Gone? 如果那个最好的人不在了 Four arrangements answer badly in different ways The same openness produces the demagogue and the dissenter Reinhard leaves one place unconquered The story declines the final verdict 同一个问题，四个答案 那个安排 作品没有做的那件事 那一句和那一堆

records.t: 《銀河英雄傳說》解讀
records.x: Five essays on democratic failure, benevolent autocracy, the person allowed to say no, an unproductive death, and the question every political order must face after its best leader is gone.
records.q: Reading Legend of the Galactic Heroes 《银河英雄传说》解读

records.t: 收養有一個沒說出口的條件
records.x: Kōda is kind and never bargains with the orphaned Rei; the child nevertheless discovers the household's axis and offers shogi as his reason to stay.
records.q: Adoption Had an Unspoken Condition 收养有一个没说出口的条件 The condition is never spoken A good person can create a narrow world He calculates the cost himself Leaving does not undo the bargain 幸田是好人 这个家的轴 他自己算出来的 那不是一次交易 后来的样子 他搬出去的理由

records.t: 他故意輸，而他們沒有看出來
records.x: Rei throws matches to protect Kōda's children, revealing a family whose love and injury pass through the same measure.
records.q: He Lost on Purpose, and They Did Not See It 他故意输，而他们没有看出来 A child tries to manage the household's pain The biological children are not simply jealous No malicious person is required The thrown match helps no one 他放水 幸田看出来了 那两个孩子后来怎么样了 幸田那一边 一个家里没有一个恶意

records.t: 什麼也不要
records.x: The Kawamotos take Rei in without knowing his talent, while their limited money and unresolved burdens keep the care from becoming a fantasy cure.
records.q: They Want Nothing 什么也不要 The household is not rich in spare capacity There is no single axis They are not his cure The meals are the argument 这户人家的账 她们要什么 跟幸田家比一下 她们没有变成解药 那些饭

records.t: 她站到那個位置上去
records.x: Hina stands beside a bullied classmate, inherits the target position, and does not receive the outcome that would make her sacrifice pay.
records.q: She Stood in That Place 她站到那个位置上去 A minority acts because a majority stays still The teacher bears consequence, not responsibility Rei reaches with the only tool he has The rescue does not succeed 那件事是怎么运转的 那个老师 林田说的话 零做的事 雏做的事 而那个女孩还是走了 那个在旁边的人

records.t: Is It His Own?
records.x: Rei chose shogi when he had no safe comparison. The series never proves when survival's instrument becomes a self-authored purpose.
records.q: Is It His Own? 那是不是他自己的 Self-calculated is not the same as self-desired The series surrounds him with contrasts He acquires things outside the board The story withholds the conversion scene 这个问题为什么成立 三个对照 宗谷 他现在有几件不属于将棋的事 作品没有回答的那件事 两个画面

records.t: 《三月的獅子》解讀
records.x: Five essays on an unspoken condition of adoption, a deliberately lost match, a household that asks for nothing, standing beside the bullied, and whether the skill that secured a home ever became Rei's own.
records.q: Reading March Comes in Like a Lion 《三月的狮子》解读

records.t: 開戰的那一週
records.x: Later chronologies name the first phase the One Week Battle; the original narration says half of humanity is dead a little over a month into war. The story begins after catastrophe.
records.q: The Week the War Began 开战的那一周 Catastrophe before the first scene A failed operation that changes a planet A boundary drawn afterward 那一周 布里蒂什作战 那个殖民地里原来住着人 那颗殖民地砸下去之后 一条界线 南极条约 那个作战的名字

records.t: 他拒絕了那道命令
records.x: The Origin gives Ramba Ral a refusal absent from the TV series. He is no pacifist; the value of the scene lies in where one participant stops.
records.q: He Refused the Order 他拒绝了那道命令 A refusal added by The Origin When dissent has only a disciplinary name Turning people into reasons 他不是一个和平主义者 那么他拒绝的是什么 抗命被降级 扎比家和戴肯 加尔玛的葬礼 隐瞒的位置

records.t: 他上去是因為沒有別人
records.x: Amuro and White Base are civilians made into a combat unit by absence. Their growing effectiveness never converts that origin into meaningful consent.
records.q: He Climbed In Because No One Else Could 他上去是因为没有别人 The available person A ship seen as a symbol on a map One person returned from the number 他为什么上去 那艘船上的人 而这艘船被当作诱饵用 那些球 阿姆罗后来的样子 米哈露

records.t: 他在和談的時候開了炮
records.x: Gihren’s Solar Ray destroys a third of the Federation fleet, the two men seeking an end, and his own father. Tactical success seals the remaining exit.
records.q: He Fired on the Peace Talks 他在和谈的时候开了炮 The target contains an exit The father included in the calculation Revenge that cannot repair its object 太阳光线 这一炮打掉的是什么 他自己的父亲在那个方向上 之后 夏亚要的是什么 那个理由

records.t: 還有可以回去的地方
records.x: The Federation wins without a victory tableau. Amuro’s final discovery is smaller and less exchangeable: people are alive, and he can return to them.
records.q: A Place to Return To 还有可以回去的地方 Winning outside, losing inside The explanation the ending withholds The direction through the wreckage 联邦赢了 赢和不输是两件事 吉翁那一边 联邦那一边 这部作品没有给的那个东西 那句话 三十亿分之一

records.t: 《機動戰士鋼彈》解讀
records.x: Five essays on the devastation before episode one, a refusal preserved in later canon, civilians made into a military unit, a superweapon that destroys peace talks, and the small human meaning left after victory.
records.q: Reading Mobile Suit Gundam 《机动战士高达》解读

records.t: 他開機器的理由
records.x: Shinji's first consent is produced by abandonment, emergency, and the sight of another injured child asked to replace him.
records.q: Why He Pilots the Machine 他开机器的理由 The Evangelion is already a relation The three minutes create consent under pressure Recognition becomes conditional His refusals matter 那台机器里装着什么 那三分钟的结构 他后来说的理由 他的日子 他做过的那次拒绝 那个女孩

records.t: 有備用的那個人
records.x: Rei's replaceable bodies make continuity operationally recoverable while exposing what no backup can preserve.
records.q: The Person Who Has Spares 有备用的那个人 A backup returns to the time it contains She begins as material for another project A sentence crosses the reset Knowledge makes refusal possible 机制 记忆回退到备份的那个时点 她原本是什么 那句话 她后来知道了什么

records.t: 那個數字
records.x: Asuka's synchronization score turns recognition into measurement, then makes a falling metric feel like the disappearance of the self.
records.q: That Number 那个数字 The metric occupies an old wound When the number falls, help repeats the injury The bathtub is outside the scale What she recovers is not the old score 她的位置 她母亲 那个数字开始掉 帮她的人都在帮倒忙 她躺在浴缸里 她拿回来的那样东西 那个数字之外

records.t: 他要的是一個人
records.x: Gendō's version of Instrumentality sacrifices every existing relation to recover Yui, confusing singular love with the right to use everyone else.
records.q: He Wanted One Person 他要的是一个人 A singular love can organize universal use He avoids the risk contained in the thing he wants Rei refuses the assigned destination Wanting a person is not yet treating a person as an end 两个计划 碇唯在哪儿 而他为此做了什么 他跟真嗣 绫波丽拒绝了他 他最后说的话 他跟别人的区别在哪儿

records.t: 那道牆
records.x: Instrumentality genuinely ends the pain of separation by ending the separateness from which any relation can answer back.
records.q: That Wall 那道墙 Instrumentality is a real solution Shinji sees a world shaped by expectation He chooses a world where pain can return The wall is not only an obstacle 补完是怎么做的 它是一个真的解 他在里面看见了什么 他选的那个 沙滩 那句话 这部作品做的最后一件事

records.t: 《新世紀福音戰士》解讀
records.x: Five essays on why Shinji pilots, the replaceable person, Asuka's falling number, Gendō's attempt to recover one person, and the wall that both hurts and makes relation possible.
records.q: Reading Neon Genesis Evangelion 《新世纪福音战士》解读

records.t: 它沒能進到腦子裡
records.x: Migi's failed takeover creates two subjects in one body—and makes dependence, not virtue, the first condition of coexistence.
records.q: It Failed to Reach the Brain 它没能进到脑子里 The ordinary outcome would erase a person A name given to something that did not replace anyone The directive and the missing capacity A mistake redescribed from the end 如果那一次成功了 两边各自缺什么 那条指令 它一开始想干什么 它后来说的那句

records.t: 每天重新談一次
records.x: Coexistence is not a declaration of friendship but a daily schedule negotiated between two incompatible standards.
records.q: Negotiate It Again Every Day 每天重新谈一次 No issue is too small to contain two wills Migi's argument remains standing Neither becomes the other Agreement is maintenance, not a destination 要谈的东西有多琐碎 每一条都是当场谈的 它的立场没有被驳倒 它没有变成好人 新一也没有变成寄生兽 一具身体，两把尺子

records.t: 他哭不出來
records.x: The cells that save Shinichi's life also change the person who survives, and the missing feeling cannot inspect its own absence.
records.q: He Could Not Cry 他哭不出来 The body that returned was not his mother An absence cannot easily feel itself missing She asks for what has no strategic value The tear that is never supplied on schedule 那具身体做了什么 救他的东西改变了他 别人先发现的 她坚持的那件事 他后来的样子 那个位置一直空着

records.t: 她不知道自己為什麼那麼做
records.x: Reiko Tamura studies motherhood as an experiment and ends with an action her own explanatory system cannot contain.

records.t: 只有名字，沒有數字

records.q: 技术长在规则没说的地方 Technique Grows Where Rules Are Silent 一 规则允许了，却没有人那样跳 二 规则从来没说过怎么过杆 三 从软土到泡沫 四 一块换过的垫子 五 两个人，同一个动作，互不知道 六 俯卧式没有被驳倒 七 规则备好了边界，又收了回去 八 门开在物质那一边 Permission without possibility The rule that disappeared A changed landing pit Parallel discovery The straddle was not mechanically refuted The boundary was on the material side

records.t: 技術不收斂
records.x: 铅球的滑步与旋转共存七十年，说明同一规则、同一目标、同一纪录线并不会自动收敛成唯一最优技术。 Glide and rotational shot-put techniques have coexisted for decades. One rule, one target, and one record line do not guarantee convergence on a single optimum.
records.q: 技术不收敛 Technique Does Not Converge 一 同一场决赛里的两种技术 二 一种是直线，一种是转圈 三 一条纪录线，先后住着两种技术 四 精英选手在往旋转那边走，可是 五 一个不坍缩成单一公式的项目 六 教练也没有一个统一的答案 七 克劳泽在两种技术之间又开了一条缝 八 只要规则开口，分支就不会出现 九 一个没有裁判的问题 Two motions in one final A shared record line Why rotation gained ground A champion can reopen the split Why no single answer emerges The question without a referee

records.t: 構在被越過時才發現邊界
records.x: 前空翻式跳远被禁，玻璃纤维撑竿被接纳。两个相似创新得到相反结论，真正的分界不是增益大小，而是项目定义。 The front-somersault long jump was banned while fiberglass poles were accepted. The dividing line was not the size of the advantage but the event's unstated definition.
records.q: 构在被越过时才发现边界 A Construct Finds Its Boundary Only When Crossed 一 两个一样的问题，两个相反的答案 二 一种真的能跳得更远的技术 三 边界在被越过时才被画出来 四 一个禁令，证据是空的 五 那个更真实的理由 六 另一样新东西，规则早就留了门 七 从案例里长出来的一条原则 八 一条从来没有写下来的线 Two innovations, opposite verdicts A somersault that worked Safety without a dataset The pole-vault rule was already wide Definition, not disruption Cases produce the principle

records.t: 為保住可比性銷燬舊賬
records.x: 霍恩的 104.80 米没有被“抹掉”，而是随标枪规格改变被封进旧账。为保住可比性，制度必须承认连续性已经断裂。 Hohn's 104.80 metres was not erased; it was sealed into an old ledger when the javelin changed. Preserving comparability required admitting that continuity had broken.
records.q: 为保住可比性销毁旧账 Destroying the Old Ledger to Preserve Comparability 一 一个需要先纠正的说法 二 一步加了五米多 三 提案早就在路上了 四 把标枪的头压下去 五 一本账关上，另一本账打开 六 那句原文，拿不到 七 一个再也无法被追平的数，和它的两个真相 八 换算是做不到的 First, correct the familiar story Moving the centre of gravity Close one book, open another The quotation nobody can securely retrieve Two truths about 104.80 Comparability through rupture

records.t: 同一個難題兩種結論
records.x: 超级跑鞋与聚氨酯泳衣都改变了成绩，田径和游泳却都保留既有纪录。规则线可以截断未来，却未必追溯重写过去。 Super shoes and polyurethane swimsuits changed performance, yet athletics and swimming retained existing records. A rule can close the future without retrospectively rewriting the past.
records.q: 同一个难题两种结论 One Problem, Two Conclusions 一 一个需要先拆掉的对照 二 一个真实存在，但被夸大过的优势 三 那条四十毫米的线，没有推导 四 维也纳，一个从来不是纪录的成绩 五 游泳那边，也是保留 六 两侧都成立 七 为什么没有裁定 八 一个被选择的，而非被迫的结论 The comparison needs narrowing A real advantage, often exaggerated into one number Vienna was not a world record Swimming also kept the marks Both sides have a case The conclusion was selected

records.t: 構安放不了的身體
records.x: 皮斯托瑞斯案不是简单回答义肢有没有优势，而是暴露：当参照身体不存在时，制度如何分配不确定性与举证责任。 The Pistorius case did not simply decide whether prostheses conferred advantage. It exposed how a system allocates uncertainty when the reference body does not exist.
records.q: 构安放不了的身体 The Body the Construct Cannot Place 一 一个无法被看见的问题 二 三步，必须分开 三 谁承担举证责任 四 一次改写方向的修订 五 一份拒绝判定的研究 六 一次把方向改回去的裁决 七 一个方向的选择，不能规定多少不确定是可容忍的 八 一个构装不下的身体 A question the stopwatch cannot see Three questions that must remain separate Who must prove the advantage A study that declined to deliver a verdict Rule revision changes the direction A body without a stable address

records.t: 必須分類才能執行
records.x: 女子组资格标准六十年间反复更换；2025 年世界田联改采 SRY 检测，进一步显出分类不是发现自然边界，而是选择制度边界。 Female-category eligibility criteria have repeatedly changed; World Athletics' 2025 turn to SRY testing makes clear that classification selects an institutional boundary rather than discovering a natural line.
records.q: 必须分类才能运行 A System Must Classify to Operate 一 一个必须在赛前作出的判定 二 七个不一样的判据 三 每一个判据都测不到它想测的 四 那条线，没有一次是算出来的 五 一个不能被分配到个体的总体 六 一份对不上的证据 七 四个审级，审的不是同一件事 八 一条无论切在哪里都切在连续体上的线 A decision required before the race The current rule changed in 2025 Seven criteria, seven mismatches A line through a continuum Evidence and jurisdiction Classification is productive

records.t: 敘事也是一種構
records.x: 肯尼亚长跑与牙买加短跑的集中是真实的；把集中压成民族身体的天赋故事，却会把选择、制度与未测量的人一起抹掉。 Kenyan distance running and Jamaican sprinting are real concentrations. Turning them into stories of national bodies erases selection, institutions, and all the people never measured.
records.q: 叙事也是一种构 Narrative Is Also a Construct 一 两个真实的集中 二 一个必须先分清的区别 三 一个真实的数字，冒充另一个数字 四 每一个故事都比它讲的窄 五 时序不答应 六 两边最强的说法 七 那些没有被测量的人 八 一个把系统压进身体的故事 Two real concentrations A true statistic used as another statistic Every story is narrower than its evidence Chronology resists essence The strongest claims on both sides The people outside the measurement

records.t: 把生理常數寫成定義
records.x: 0.100 秒起跑阈值把经验假设写成“抢跑”的定义；艾伦的 0.099 不是不存在，而是被规则定义为不能存在。 The 0.100-second start threshold turned an empirical assumption into the definition of a false start. Allen's 0.099 was real, but the rule defined it as impossible to credit.
records.q: 把生理常数写成定义 Writing a Physiological Constant into a Definition 一 一个枪响之后的动作，被判为不存在 二 假设和定义的区别 三 那个数从哪来，查不到 四 构自己的证据，建议改，而它没改 五 生理那一端，根本没有一个稳定的数 六 两个案子，不是一回事 七 定义反过来改变了人 八 被定义判为不可能的那些真实 A real movement ruled impossible Assumption and definition The origin is less transparent than the precision Bodies do not share one minimum Two kinds of false start The definition trains the body

records.t: 構備好了閉合手段而人不用
records.x: 巴尔希姆与坦贝里共享金牌不是改写规则，而是使用规则预留的“不闭合”出口。制度有能力继续分胜负，也可以授权人不分。 Barshim and Tamberi did not rewrite the rules by sharing gold. They used an authorized exit from closure: the system could separate them, but allowed them not to ask it to.
records.q: 构备好了闭合手段而人不用 The Construct Offered Closure; the Athletes Declined 一 裁判先说了还能继续，运动员才问能不能不继续 二 几个必须先拆掉的说法 三 授权的不是发金牌，是不闭合 四 运动员没有改写规则，只是选了规则给的一条路 五 同一个制度，四次，两种结果 六 一个赞成自己的选择，却反对这个规则的人 七 构会看得更细，也会主动不看 八 一个被预留的，可以合法地不填的格子 “Can we have two golds?” What the tiebreak had already done Authorization not to close Choice within rather than against the rule A critic can praise the choice and resist the rule The deliberately empty cell

records.t: 兩個同名的構
records.x: 纪录赛与锦标赛都叫赛跑，却生产不同对象：一个优化终点数字，一个分配当场名次。配速系统把这个差别推到台前。 Record races and championship races share a name but produce different objects: one optimizes a finishing number, the other allocates places on the day. Pacing exposes the difference.
records.q: 两个同名的构 Two Constructs with the Same Name 一 同一个名字，两种比赛 二 这个论题要成立，得先收紧一个说法 三 配速员是参赛者，不是场外服务 四 班尼斯特那场，被否决的是前一年 五 从雇一只兔子，到造一套生产系统 六 那道光该不该算外部帮助 七 三个人的账，和一张合并的表 八 锦标赛决赛，几乎不破纪录 九 别的运动，给了不同的答案 十 一个被拒绝命名的差异 One name, two competitions Pacemakers are competitors Bannister's mile and the race that did not count Is the light external assistance? Three ledgers and one merged table Finals rarely make ideal record attempts A difference the vocabulary resists

records.t: 同一距離兩套賬
records.x: 波士顿马拉松的赛道可以量得准确，却不满足世界纪录的地理条件。同一个 42.195 公里因此同时属于赛事史与纪录史。 Boston can be an accurately measured marathon yet fail world-record geography. The same 42.195 kilometres therefore belongs to race history and record history in different ways.
records.q: 同一距离两套账 One Distance, Two Ledgers 一 一条量得准的赛道，和一条能进纪录的赛道 二 自行车不相信自己的轮子 三 宁可长一点，不可短一点 四 那条几何的线，没有一个生理的理由 五 波士顿在线的另一边，而它没有因此变小 六 一个距离，字面意义上的两套账 七 规则选择不去规范的东西 八 枪响的时钟，和你自己的时钟 九 世界最好，和世界纪录 十 线为可比性而划，而它划下时，总有东西在线外 Accurate distance, ineligible geometry The calibrated bicycle does not trust itself A geometric line, not a physiological theorem Boston remains Boston What the rules leave unregulated Gun time and personal time

records.t: 別問
records.x: 反兴奋剂的严格责任不以主观故意为成立条件，但责任成立与处罚轻重仍是两层。制度不问内心，也不能假装没有个人。 Anti-doping strict liability does not require proof of intent, but violation and sanction remain separate questions. The system brackets the inner life without making the person disappear.
records.q: 别问 Do Not Ask What Was Intended 一 一条不问内心的规则 二 不问内心，不等于自动重罚 三 两层之间，批评落在哪里 四 同一个案子，两个相反的裁决 五 一个必须每天申报的一小时 六 十年之后的样本 七 一块迟到十几年的奖牌 八 一个把不问推到极致的例外 九 克里格自己怎么说 十 系统，和个人 A rule that does not inquire into intention Not asking does not mean automatic maximum punishment Two cases can point in opposite directions The declared hour A medal returned late The extreme counterexample System and person

records.t: 賬本儲存著自己無法背書的條目
records.x: 一些可疑的历史纪录仍在册上，不是制度确信它们清白，而是集体证据、统计异常与个案证明之间不能互相冒充。 Some suspect historical records remain because institutional evidence, statistical anomaly, and proof against an individual entry are not interchangeable.
records.q: 账本保存着自己无法背书的条目 The Ledger Keeps Entries It Cannot Vouch For 一 一批还在账上的纪录 二 一次没有做成的清账 三 三条路，和它们各自的死胡同 四 两种不同的错误 五 受伤的，是具体的人 六 那个年代，不是没有检测 七 一个只能朝一个方向用的能力 八 系统的证据，不是对纪录的裁定 九 统计的距离，不是证据 十 账本无法为自己背书 Records that outlived their world The reset that did not happen Three roads, three dead ends Two different errors Testing existed, but not as it does now System evidence and individual judgment Distance from the distribution is not proof

records.t: 構為餘項發明類別
records.x: 中立个人运动员与难民奥运代表队不是天然身份，而是制度为国家资格闸门装不下的人发明的不同通道。 Individual Neutral Athletes and the Refugee Olympic Team are not natural identities. They are distinct pathways invented for people the nationality gate cannot otherwise place.
records.q: 构为余项发明类别 The Construct Invents a Category for the Remainder 一 一批闸门装不下的人 二 中立不是没有国籍 三 从排除，到替换，到一个反复可用的动作 四 一个申请，审查，筛选的系统 五 奥运会里的个人中立运动员 六 难民队，一个不同的东西 七 这个类别移除了什么，又建立了什么 八 两副面孔 九 运动员自己怎么说 十 一个既是门也是墙的类别 Athletes the national gate cannot hold Neutral does not mean stateless From exception to reusable device Application, review, selection The Refugee Olympic Team is different What the category removes and creates Door and wall

records.t: 一個人到底能多快多高多遠
records.x: 从四分钟一英里到“女子何时超过男子”，极限预测反复把纪录曲线误当成人。尺子能追踪构生产出的数字，却够不到主体的最后刻度。 From the four-minute mile to predictions that women will overtake men, limit forecasts repeatedly mistake record curves for persons. The ruler tracks numbers produced by a system, not the final measure of a subject.
records.q: 一个人到底能多快多高多远 How Fast, High, and Far Can a Person Go? 一 一个反复被算错的数 二 四分钟一英里，从来没有被科学判过死刑 三 一英里三分半，一个五十年的赌约 四 女子会超过男子，一个反复落空的日期 五 二一五六年，一个还没到期的预测 六 加进生理学，并没有取消外推 七 一条会失败的渐进线 八 科学怪人运动员 九 一条纪录，和它底下的那片人 十 尺子够不到的那个刻度 A number repeatedly predicted too soon The four-minute mile was not scientifically declared impossible Three minutes thirty and a long wager When will women overtake men? Physiology does not abolish extrapolation The Frankenstein athlete One record and the population beneath it The mark the ruler cannot reach

records.t: 鑿構週期律：田徑
records.x: 二十三篇文章，从古代胜者名单、纪录与计时，到技术、分类、反兴奋剂与人的极限。 Twenty-three essays on records, rules, bodies, technology, classification, and human limits.
records.q: 凿构周期律：田径 The Chisel–Construct Cycle: Athletics

records.t: 誰去交電費
records.x: 一场碰撞要落进这里，须过两道门。而碰撞的大小不定射程——两个人僵住的可能只是谁去交电费。 A collision has to pass two gates to fall here. And size does not decide scope: what two people have frozen over may only be who pays the electricity bill.
records.q: Who Pays the Electricity Bill 谁去交电费 Two People, and a Thing Neither of Them Will Put Down Two Gates Four Names That Look Like They Set the Scope, and Do Not What the Object Gate Actually Says The First Narrowing: No Certifying Each Other's Arrival The Second and Third: No Legislating, No Settling by Leaving Is This End Mine? Conflict Cannot Be Exempted One Cell Marked Off 两个人，与一件谁也放不下的事 两道门 四个看起来能定射程、其实不能的名目 对象门究竟说了什么 第一条收窄：不能互相认证到达 第二条与第三条：不能替对方立法，不能以单方退出完成结算 这一端是不是我的法 冲突不能免除 另划出一格

records.t: 兩本賬
records.x: 那句重话被认了，两个人和好了，而家里的事该不该先商量这一问，一个字都没有动。伤害与不相容是两张账，并行记。 The hard thing said got owned, the two of them made up, and the question of whether household things get decided together has not moved by a word. Harm and incompatibility are two ledgers, kept in parallel.
records.q: Two Ledgers 两本账 The Hard Thing Said Two Roads That Cannot Be Taken Graded Handover The Day the Household Got Sorted Into Three Kinds Handling Is a Means, and the Objective Function Is Not Winning The Step That Is Not Among the Options One More Cell, and What Parallel Actually Costs 那句很重的话 两条不能走的路 分级交接 家里的事分成三类的那一天 处理是手段，而目标函数不是赢 不在选项里的那一步 再划一格，与并行记账的实际代价

records.t: Not by Person / 不按人分
records.x: 分路不按人分，按当前的关系条件分。互向条件可用时走互向路，不可用时走单向路——而转路的根据是当前互向过程不可用这件事本身，不必再加一项关于对方内心或层级的解释。 The paths divide by the current condition of the relation, not by the person. And what licenses a switch is that the reciprocal process is currently unavailable — nothing further about the other's inner life or layer.
records.q: Not by Person 不按人分 Two Relational Conditions How a Path Gets Chosen, Without Judging a Person Three Consequences of Dividing by Condition What Starting on the Reciprocal Path Looks Like Three Places This Is Not the War Treatise What the Division Is For 两种关系条件 路怎么选，而不判人 按条件分路的三个后果 从互向路起手是什么样子 三处与战争论不同 这个分法是为了什么

records.t: 四個同心圓
records.x: 正视，深入理解，向终，受问。四条都以「不得不」起句，而它们不是四条规范，是条件—构成式：只要我仍占据这个处理位置，这四项就是这个位置本身不能取消的条件。 Face it, deepen the understanding, be directed toward a terminus, remain open to questioning. Four clauses that all begin with cannot-not — and none of them is a rule.
records.q: Four Concentric Circles 四个同心圆 Which Kind of Cannot-Not These Are Cannot-Not Face It Cannot-Not Deepen the Understanding Cannot-Not Be Directed Toward a Terminus Cannot-Not Remain Open to Questioning Among the Four 这四条是哪一种不得不 不得不正视 不得不深入理解 不得不向终 不得不受问 四条之间

records.t: I Understood Him / 我理解了他
records.x: 互向路上双方进入同一个互向过程；单向路上没有。而单向路上最要紧的一句是：我理解了他为什么这样，不等于他同意了我的理解，更不等于这件事就此说定。 On the reciprocal path both enter the same process. On the unilateral path they do not — and the sentence that matters most there is that understanding why he does it settles nothing between us.
records.q: I Understood Him 我理解了他 Deepening Together Two Termini, Not Ranked A Different Scene Four Things About That Word Four Positions Facing the Other What Understanding Does Not Settle 共同深入 两种终，不排序 换一个场景 关于那个词的四句话 面向对方的四种位置 理解不结算什么

records.t: 止點不是拖著
records.x: 终，止点，移出，暂停，拖着——五个词各有专用，不得互换。而最难的一处须直说：止点与拖着，从外面没有可保证闭合的判准。 Terminus, stopping point, removal, pause, stalling — five words, each with its own use. And the hardest thing has to be said plainly: from outside, no criterion guaranteed to close separates the second from the last.
records.q: A Stopping Point Is Not Stalling 止点不是拖着 Two Layers First Five Words, Each With Its Own Use The Two Histories of Consensus Mutual Acknowledgement of Incommensurability The Local Stopping Point Removal 先分两层 五个词各有专用 共识的两种发生史 互相承认不可通约 局部止点 移出

records.t: 這兩個人沒有終
records.x: 单向路可以一直走下去吗。不可以。三道门，任何一道命中，这条路暂停。而无论走到哪一处，有一句都成立：这一场冲突有它的边界，可以取得终，也可以取不到。这两个人没有终。 Can the unilateral path be walked indefinitely? No. Three gates, any one of which pauses it. And wherever it ends up, one sentence holds: this conflict has its boundary. These two people do not.
records.q: These Two People Have No Terminus 这两个人没有终 Three Stopping Gates What Follows a Pause Where the Four Constraints Stand Afterwards What This Whole Apparatus Actually Did What This Treatise Did Not Do Back to the Two of Them 三道停止门 暂停之后 四条约束在各处的地位 这一整套东西到底做了什么 这一篇没有做的 回到开头那对人

records.t: 兩條法相遇的時候
records.x: 两条已经成形的自己的法，在同一情境里要求不相容的行动，而三件事同时成立：不能互相认证到达，不能替对方立法，也不能由任何一方单方退出而完成结算。七篇散文改写自《SAE 冲突论》。Seven essays on what happens when two laws, each its bearer's own, require incompatible action.
records.q: When Two Laws Meet 两条法相遇的时候

records.t: 立法主體之道
records.x: 道德律不从善恶出发，而从结构出发。15DD立法主体不是更好的人，而是运算配置不同的主体——具备伤害能力而选择不伤害。姿态汇聚非命题汇聚，邓巴数与气泡架构，14DD殖民的形成性功能与三相演化。
records.q: 立法主体之道 The Way of the Legislative Subject

records.t: 四條道德律
records.x: 四条不能不：识认他者为目的、扩展识认半径、寻求扩展方向、让自身识认结构接受质询。识认是克制，不是给予。余项动力学、拓扑开放与物理回应、与战争论四条定理的同构。
records.q: 四条道德律 The Four Theorems

records.t: 內外之鏡
records.x: 内省性公平：首先是你对自己是否公平。声誉是你的识认结构在共同体场域中的显示状态——不是你的财产，而是共同体持有的关于你的状态。太阳类比、日久见人心、分布式共同体承认对抗策略性伪装。
records.q: 内外之镜 The Mirror, Inside and Out

records.t: 共鑿正和
records.x: 道德庭的原告是加害方，不是受害方。两个立法主体真诚互凿，结果是正和——因为主体性是活动而非资源，物自体是不可穷尽的。痛感展示与控告的语法区分，尊重余项与位移余项的对偶，多纳泰罗与布鲁内莱斯基。
records.q: 共凿正和 Mutual Chiseling, Positive-Sum

records.t: 混合現實中的人
records.x: 真实的共同体从来不是纯粹的。在14DD主导的世界里，15DD主体如何生存、辨识、合作、退出。萌发·翻转·确立三区段，无完人原则，科雅扎克、苏菲·朔尔、萨维特里巴伊·普勒——从下往上的结构性必然，而非从上往下的英雄主义。
records.q: 混合现实中的人 The Person in Mixed Reality

records.t: 共同體的形態
records.q: 共同体的形态 The Forms of Community

records.t: 看不見的架構
records.x: 安德烈·特罗克梅被捕，村庄的庇护没有停。机构架构不是设计出来的，是既有共同体织物的重新使用。道德庭与14DD法庭的路由，三层识别，聚合见证。无完美机构。
records.q: 看不见的架构 The Invisible Architecture

records.t: 大同有餘項
records.x: 跨文明对话的收束：不批判，只阐述异同。否定之路——道、空、neti neti、fanā、维特根斯坦的沉默。物自体的多传统谱系。Levinas、Buber、Ubuntu与道德律的共振和分歧。大同有余项，读者的立法主体性入场。
records.q: 大同有余项 Great Convergence, With Remainder

records.t: 阿賴耶識不是一座倉庫
records.x: 真正可以和 SAE 对接的，不是一个神秘的第八识实体，而是阿赖耶识—种子系统在转依中发生的整段变化。 The useful interface is not a mysterious eighth-consciousness entity but the transformation of the ālayavijñāna–seed system across an entire path.
records.q: 阿赖耶识不是一座仓库 The Storehouse Is Not a Warehouse 从末那识开始 对接的是转依，不是识体 种子为什么比“记忆”更难 第九识之争留下了什么 The Problem Appears in Manas A Trajectory, Not an Entity Why Seeds Are More Than Memories What the Ninth Consciousness Dispute Reveals

records.t: 禪宗破掉的不是結構
records.x: 禅宗并不反对地图、次第和方法；它拒绝的是任何一张地图被主体误认成可以永久居住的终点。 Chan is not opposed to maps, stages, or methods. It opposes the moment any map is mistaken for a final place to live.
records.q: 禅宗破掉的不是结构 Chan Does Not Destroy Structure 无住不是没有构 十牛图为什么仍然有用 顿悟和渐修不是时间之争 谁来证明你没有住下 Non-Abiding Does Not Mean No Construction Why the Oxherding Pictures Still Matter Sudden and Gradual Are Not Measures of Speed Who Certifies That You Have Not Settled?

records.t: 空不是終點
records.x: 中观与 SAE 都拒绝让任何构坐实为自性，却在“假名有没有真实牵制力”这一点上走向两条不同的路。 Madhyamaka and SAE both deny intrinsic closure, then part over whether a conventional construct carries real constraining weight.
records.q: 空不是终点 Emptiness Is Not a Destination 八不不是八把刀 破而不立，还是立而承认余项 四重二谛为什么不会回到原点 真正的缝在“假名” 空也要空掉 Eight Negations, One Attachment Refusing to Establish, or Establishing with Remainder Why the Fourfold Two Truths Do Not Return to the Start The Central Seam Is Conventional Designation Emptying Emptiness—and Questioning Negation

records.t: 最高的那一層，能不能被建造
records.x: 天台把教法理解成因机施设，也把圆满理解成性本具足；前者与涵育相接，后者则与 SAE 的无终态彻底分开。 Tiantai's adaptive pedagogy meets SAE's cultivation, while its inherently complete highest teaching opens a clean and irreducible seam.
records.q: 最高的那一层，能不能被建造 Can the Highest Be Built? 涵育不是替别人抵达 五时不是一条直梯 即空、即假、即中 有最与无最 两边各自的一问 Cultivation Does Not Arrive for Someone Else The Five Periods Are Not a Straight Ladder Empty, Provisional, and Middle A Highest and No Highest The Questions Each Side Can Ask

records.t: 一切互攝之後，還有沒有他者
records.x: 华严以事事无碍完成关系，SAE 以不可单方穷尽守住他者；两种完整在“有没有外部”这一点上正面相遇。 Huayan completes relation through unobstructed interpenetration; SAE completes it by preserving an other no single perspective can exhaust.
records.q: 一切互摄之后，还有没有他者 If Everything Interpenetrates, Is There Still an Other? 五教走到哪里分岔 无外，与有外而无外力 互摄是否等于相互理解 因陀罗网只能对上一半 两个相反的危险 Where the Five Teachings Diverge No Outside, and an Outside without External Force Does Interpenetration Mean Mutual Understanding? Indra's Net Matches Only Halfway Two Opposed Risks

records.t: 他力從哪裡進入
records.x: 净土以弥陀本愿完成横超，SAE 坚持一切构必须自凿；真正的缝不在有没有行动，而在越过的力量来自哪里。 Pure Land entrusts crossing to Amitābha's Vow; SAE requires every construct to self-chisel. The seam concerns the source of accomplishment.
records.q: 他力从哪里进入 Where Can Other-Power Enter? 竖出与横超 涵育为什么不是他力 行不是过 SAE 为什么无法表示纯受纳 不能自救，是否反而成为入口 两种完整，不是一种缺两步 Vertical Ascent and Crosswise Transcendence Why Cultivation Is Not Other-Power The Act Is Not the Crossing Why SAE Cannot Represent Pure Reception When Inability Becomes the Entrance Two Completions, Not One Theory Missing Two Steps

records.t: SAE佛學：六個接口
records.x: 从唯识、禅、中观、天台、华严到净土，六篇独立重写的 SAE 佛学接口散文。Six independent essays on SAE in dialogue with Yogācāra, Chan, Madhyamaka, Tiantai, Huayan, and Pure Land.
records.q: SAE佛学：六个接口 SAE and Buddhist Thought: Six Interfaces

records.t: 他把追問派給了另一個人
records.x: Boethius gives his hardest questions to Lady Philosophy. The dialogue shows how powerful self-critique can be—and why an invented interlocutor cannot certify her own independence.
records.q: The Questioner He Had to Invent 他把追问派给了另一个人 A dialogue written under sentence of death The objection he refuses to weaken Neither puppet nor final judge Two ways of turning toward the reader

records.t: 他答對了那一問
records.x: Boethius correctly defines the human being as a rational mortal animal. His mistake begins when a true description signs its author's name and claims to be the whole self.
records.q: The Answer That Became the Illness 他答对了那一问 Five questions at the bedside A true proposition with a false passport Recollection and emergence The danger in the easy answer

records.t: 讓命運女神自己開口
records.x: Lady Philosophy gives Fortune a serious defense, complete with a burden of proof and a condition of defeat. SAE asks what happens when the winning side then occupies the opponent's ground.
records.q: Let Fortune Make Her Own Case 让命运女神自己开口 Fortune takes the witness stand A verdict entered before the reply An opponent as a measure The cost of a strong adversary

records.t: 你是在拿我玩嗎
records.x: Boethius accuses Philosophy of proving one claim by another inside a closed circle. Her answer turns the alleged defect into the form of the object itself.
records.q: Are You Playing with Me? 你是在拿我玩吗 The listener reconstructs the argument A circle or a borrowed guarantee What SAE does with its own circle How much can an unmoved center support? When another person repeats your words

records.t: Necessity Is Not in the Walker / 必然不在走路的人身上
records.x: A person known to be walking must be walking, but knowledge does not force the step. Boethius and SAE meet in the practice of returning necessity to its proper address.
records.q: Necessity Is Not in the Walker 必然不在走路的人身上 What does seeing add? One pair of examples, two distinctions Reindexing is not refutation The necessity we add afterward

records.t: 按誰的本事收下來
records.x: Boethius says that things are known according to the capacity of the knower. SAE follows him to that threshold, then refuses to let a higher faculty cancel an earlier act's remainder.
records.q: According to the Knower's Power 按谁的本事收下来 A principle introduced as diagnosis The same threshold, followed in opposite directions The tribunal of the faculties Applying the principle to Philosophy herself Two capacities, two accounts

records.t: SAE哲學的慰藉
records.x: Six close readings place Boethius’s Consolation of Philosophy beside SAE: the invented examiner, a correct answer that overclaims, Fortune’s defense, circular proof, conditional necessity, and cognition according to the knower’s power.
records.q: SAE and Boethius’s Consolation of Philosophy SAE哲学的慰藉

records.t: 先審自己
records.x: 一门以追问为方法的哲学，若先把自己排除在追问之外，第一步就已经失效。《SAE第一批判》为何必须先把刀转向自身。 A philosophy organized around interrogation fails at its first step if it exempts itself. The First Critique therefore turns the audit inward before judging anything else.
records.q: 先审自己 Critique Begins at Home 一把先转回来的刀 批判不是宣布怀疑 五章为什么按这个次序出现 规则也必须有地址 读者不是观众 Turning the Instrument Inward Critique Is More Than General Doubt Why the Five Chapters Have an Order Rules Need Addresses Too The Reader Is Not an Audience

records.t: 只有一條公理
records.x: “非不能非”为什么是施行性公理，而“认识必须继续”“余项必然逼出下一步”都不是。先拆掉三种被误写成必然的东西。 Why Negativa cannot be denied is performative, while cognition's continuation and the remainder's alleged motor are not. Three mistaken necessities must be dismantled first.
records.q: 只有一条公理 Only One Axiom “非不能非”说的不是一个东西 第一种误认：认识必须开始 第二种误认：余项会逼出下一刀 第三种误认：没有终点就是没有所得 公理与承担之间的空隙 An Axiom That Is Not an Object First Mistaken Necessity: Cognition Must Begin Second Mistaken Necessity: The Remainder Pushes Third Mistaken Necessity: No Terminus Means No Gain The Space Between Axiom and Undertaking

records.t: 為什麼叫第一批判
records.x: 它继承康德的划界工作，却把批判对象从理性能力移到 SAE 自己的地位账；同名不是复刻，更不是把康德收编进 SAE。 It inherits Kant's work of delimitation while moving the audit from the faculties of reason to SAE's own status ledger. The shared name marks a task, not an annexation.
records.q: 为什么叫第一批判 Why Call It a First Critique? 同一个名字，两件工作 从疆域到辖域 翻转不等于胜出 “人是什么”为什么仍在场 承接的方法，拒绝的继承权 One Name, Two Tasks From Territory to Jurisdiction Reversal Is Not Victory Why the Question of the Human Remains A Method Inherited, an Authority Refused

records.t: 一條主張管到哪裡
records.x: 错不只发生在结论上，也发生在地址上。对象、层级、分支、公设四栏，怎样把越界的主张送回它真正成立的位置。 Error can lie in an address as well as a conclusion. Four coordinates—object, level, branch, and postulate—return overextended claims to the places where they actually stand.
records.q: 一条主张管到哪里 How Far Does a Claim Reach? 真或假以前，先问地址 一刀留下的四类账 反面不是余项 四栏地址 实得而非趋近 Ask for the Address Before the Verdict Four Kinds of Debt Left by a Cut The Reverse Side Is Not the Remainder Four Coordinates Gain Without Approach

records.t: 為什麼主體鑿不盡自己
records.x: 当握刀者把自己变成对象，作业完成时的主体已不再等于被写下的主体。主体的物自体不是神秘内核，而是行动与自述之间持续移动的边界。 When the performer becomes an object, the subject who completes the account is no longer identical with the subject it describes. The noumenal limit is a moving gap between action and self-portrait.
records.q: 为什么主体凿不尽自己 Why the Subject Cannot Finish Its Own Portrait 把自己摆到桌上 行动者和产物之间的缝 会移动的对象 目的从哪里来 模型可以有用，但不能冒名 Putting Oneself on the Table The Gap Between Agent and Product An Object That Moves Where Ends Come From Useful Models Without Impersonation

records.t: 構怎樣冒領地位
records.x: 幻相不是简单的错觉，而是一项构出示了超过过审清单的凭证。八类冒领把最常见的哲学越界逐一登记。 Illusion is not mere appearance but a construct presenting credentials beyond its reviewed record. Eight forms of false claiming map philosophy's recurrent overreach.
records.q: 构怎样冒领地位 How a Construct Claims More Than It Earned 幻相是一种凭证问题 前四类：必然、过审、现站、施行者 后四类：跨支、零点、整体、跨域 幻相为什么比错误更顽固 处置不是删除 Illusion as a Credential Failure The First Four: Necessity, Validation, Station, Performer The Next Four: Branch, Zero Point, Totality, Domain Why Illusion Persists Better Than Error Readdressing Instead of Deleting

records.t: 誰追問追問者
records.x: 他者提供自问无法担保的独立校验，但他者也没有豁免。没有终审者，如何仍让判断有成色，而不坠入无穷倒退。 Others provide a check self-questioning cannot certify, but they receive no immunity. How can judgment retain force without either a final judge or an infinite regress?
records.q: 谁追问追问者 Who Questions the Questioner? 自问为什么不够 他者也会错 无穷倒退怎样停下 追问不是审判人格 一座永不休庭的法庭 Why Self-Questioning Is Not Enough Others Can Be Wrong Stopping Without a Final Guarantor Interrogating Claims, Not Personalities A Court That Never Permanently Adjourns

records.t: 六條公設，不是六塊地基
records.x: 六条公设是可替换的承担，不是由唯一公理推出的定理。认识、余项、构、离散与反身如何各自取得明确地位。 The six postulates are replaceable undertakings, not theorems derived from the sole axiom. Cognition, remainder, construction, discreteness, and reflexivity each receive an explicit status.
records.q: 六条公设，不是六块地基 Six Postulates, Not Six Foundations 公设意味着承担 P1：把认识理解为划界 P2 与 P3：余项不可灭，账目可传导 P4 与 P5：构会沉淀，步骤彼此离散 P6：刀可以回到握刀者 A Postulate Is an Undertaking P1: Cognition as Demarcation P2 and P3: Indestructibility and Conservation P4 and P5: Sedimentation and Discreteness P6: The Instrument Can Turn on Its User

records.t: 形式化不能替哲學落刀
records.x: 形式语言能登记、分离、验证与传导，却不能替我们选择场域、公设或解释。作业者定理划出规则执行与哲学判断之间的界。 Formal language can register, separate, validate, and propagate, but it cannot choose the field, postulates, or interpretation for us. The worker theorem marks the boundary between rule execution and judgment.
records.q: 形式化不能替哲学落刀 Formalization Cannot Make the Cut 形式化真正擅长什么 判断是关系，不只是函数 五个构形证明了什么 作业者定理 借来的器械要入册 What Formalization Does Well Judgment as Relation Rather Than Function What the Five Configurations Establish The Worker Theorem Register Borrowed Instruments

records.t: 一條公設換掉以後
records.x: 前提撤回不会让整套理论瞬间变假。依赖清单与传导条款把受影响的结论送回待审，并保存它们曾经有效的历史地址。 Withdrawing a premise does not make an entire theory instantly false. Dependency lists return affected claims for review while preserving the historical address at which they once stood.
records.q: 一条公设换掉以后 When a Postulate Is Replaced 不是抽掉一块砖 历史地址不能抹掉 新公理候选怎样入场 “自己的哲学”落在承担上 可修订不是轻浮 Not a Brick Pulled from a Foundation Historical Addresses Must Remain Visible Admitting a New Axiom Candidate One's Own Philosophy Lies in Assumption Revisability Is Not Carelessness

records.t: 路怎樣走來，不等於它憑什麼有效
records.x: 发生论给 0D—16DD 逐站分级，却不把历史次序变成合法性证明。序列、方向、后验输入与实然—应然之缝各归各账。 The genesis audit grades 0D–16DD without turning historical order into justification. Sequence, direction, posterior inputs, and the is–ought gap receive separate accounts.
records.q: 路怎样走来，不等于它凭什么有效 Genesis Is Not Warrant 最珍视的路也要受审 序的强度大于站的唯一 方向有来源，没有马达 宇宙、主体、对象是输入 从结构到规范必须另过一关 The Most Valued Road Must Be Audited Order Is Stronger Than Unique Stations Sources of Direction Without a Motor Universe, Subject, and Object as Inputs Structure Does Not Automatically Legislate

records.t: 照亮，而不證明
records.x: 复数道路可以共享前提、局部互证并暴露彼此盲区，却不能整体替对方奠基。开放审计如何取代一次性的永久执照。 Plural paths may share premises, prove local claims, and expose blind spots without grounding one another as wholes. Open audit replaces the fantasy of a permanent license.
records.q: 照亮，而不证明 Illumination, Not Proof 路一旦复数，关系就要重写 局部证明仍然可能 照亮比证明更广 交叠不是趋同 用公开审计替代永久执照 Plural Roads Require a New Relation Local Proof Remains Possible Illumination Reaches Farther Than Proof Overlap Is Not Convergence Public Audit Instead of a Permanent License

records.t: SAE第一批判：十二講
records.x: 依据《SAE第一批判》原论文重写的十二篇导读：公理、辖域、幻相、公设、形式化与发生论。 Twelve reader-facing essays on axiom, jurisdiction, illusion, postulates, formalization, and genesis.
records.q: SAE第一批判：十二讲 The SAE First Critique: Twelve Readings

records.t: 當系統越來越成功，人還剩下什麼
records.x: 一个没有恶意、运转良好的系统，也可能把人逐渐改写成指标、资源和实现系统目标的手段。SAE 从这里开始。 A well-run system needs no villain to reduce people to metrics, resources, and instruments of its own success. SAE begins with that problem.
records.q: 当系统越来越成功，人还剩下什么 When Systems Succeed, What Happens to the Person? 没有坏人的困局 从道德劝告到结构判断 系统不必消失 第一个检验 A Problem Without a Villain From Moral Advice to Structural Judgment The Point Is Not to Abolish Systems The First SAE Test

records.t: 系統該在何處出現，何處退場
records.x: 基础层需要制度坚定出现，涌现层需要制度克制退场。两层不是福利与自由的取舍，而是两种不同的制度责任。 Institutions must secure the Base Layer and withdraw from the Emergence Layer. These are not competing values but two different institutional duties.
records.q: 系统该在何处出现，何处退场 Where Systems Must Act—and Where They Must Step Back 两种看起来都像“帮助”的动作 基础层：系统不能缺席 涌现层：系统必须克制 不是一条固定边界 Two Kinds of Help The Base Layer: Institutions Must Be Present The Emergence Layer: Institutions Must Exercise Restraint A Boundary That Requires Judgment

records.t: 自由不是能選，而是改得起
records.x: 菜单上的选择不等于真实自由。分叉权追问替代道路是否存在、可达、可负担，也是否仍能被想象。 A menu of choices is not freedom. Fork Rights ask whether another path exists, can be reached and afforded, and remains imaginable.
records.q: 自由不是能选，而是改得起 Freedom Is Not Having Options; It Is Being Able to Change Course 选择很多，为什么仍走不了 四个问题 分叉不是逃跑 自由的压力测试 Many Choices, No Viable Departure Four Questions About a Fork Forking Is More Than Walking Away Freedom's Stress Test

records.t: 最難識別的殖民說：“這正是我想要的”
records.x: 当指标、竞争与优化逻辑变成自我认同，外部命令已经不再必要。内在殖民因此比显性的控制更难退出。 Once metrics, competition, and optimization become identity, external commands are no longer necessary. Internal colonization governs in the first person.
records.q: 最难识别的殖民说：“这正是我想要的” The Most Dangerous Colonization Says, “This Is What I Want” 监工离开以后 五种常见的自我 不是揭露一个假的自我 恢复第一人称 After the Supervisor Leaves Five Familiar Selves Not a Hunt for a Hidden True Self Recovering the First Person

records.t: 愛為什麼也會殖民
records.x: 关系越深，越容易把边界视为不信任。亲密殖民不是虚假的爱，而是真实感情被用来免除对他者的承认。 The deeper the relationship, the easier it is to treat boundaries as distrust. Intimate colonization begins when genuine love becomes an exemption from recognition.
records.q: 爱为什么也会殖民 How Love Becomes a License “我们之间还需要说这些吗” 两层关系 从“我爱你”到“你应该” 爱的反常识标准 “Do We Really Need This Between Us?” Two Dimensions of Relationship From “I Love You” to “Therefore You Owe Me” A Counterintuitive Standard for Love

records.t: 一個人怎樣被另一個人重新看見
records.x: 主体性并不总能靠独自反省恢复。来自深关系、指向存在而非表现的承认，能够为一个被殖民的人重新打开自我。 Subjecthood is not always restored through solitary reflection. Recognition from a deep relationship can reopen a self that performance has closed.
records.q: 一个人怎样被另一个人重新看见 Being Seen Back into Existence 当自救也说着系统的语言 不是说一句“你很好” 承认不能变成接管 借来的光最终要归还 When Self-Help Speaks the System's Language More Than “You Are Good Enough” Recognition Must Not Become Possession Returning the Borrowed Light

records.t: 人、關係與制度為什麼不能分開看
records.x: 制度提供边界条件，关系承担传导，个人完成最终实现。三层形式相似，却不能互相替代。 Institutions supply boundary conditions, relationships transmit, and persons realize the result. The three layers share a form without becoming interchangeable.
records.q: 人、关系与制度为什么不能分开看 Why Persons, Relationships, and Institutions Must Be Read Together 三种都只说对了一部分的解释 制度是边界条件 关系是传导媒介 个人是最终实现层 从归责转向诊断 Three Partial Explanations Institutions Set Boundary Conditions Relationships Transmit The Individual Is the Layer of Realization From Blame to Diagnosis

records.t: 涵育、透支與耗竭
records.x: 感觉良好不一定结构健康，边界稳固也不等于生命展开。四种状态帮助我们区分涵育、休眠、透支与耗竭。 Feeling fulfilled does not guarantee structural health, and safety alone is not flourishing. Four states distinguish cultivation from dormancy, overdraw, and depletion.
records.q: 涵育、透支与耗竭 Flourishing, Dormancy, Overdraw, Depletion 为什么“过得很好”还不够 丰盛与休眠 透支与耗竭 涵育不是消除痛苦 Why “Doing Well” Is Not Enough Flourishing and Dormancy Overdraw and Depletion Cultivation Does Not Eliminate Pain

records.t: 為什麼只改變一個層面通常不夠
records.x: 三层之间有六个传导方向。单点改变常被旧循环吸收；解锁至少需要两个层面同时出现缺口。 Six pathways connect the three layers. A single reform is often absorbed by the old loop; durable unlocking requires openings in at least two layers.
records.q: 为什么只改变一个层面通常不够 Why One-Layer Reform Usually Fails 一条好政策为什么落不到人身上 旧循环怎样修复自己 至少两个缺口 改革的组合思维 Why a Good Policy May Never Reach a Person How an Old Loop Repairs Itself Openings in at Least Two Layers Thinking in Combinations

records.t: 自由是自己的“不得不” / Freedom as a Cannot-Not｜SAE基础：人如何成为目的
records.x: 自由不只是做想做的或拒绝不想做的，而是让真正属于自己的内在必然逐渐长成，同时防止伪“不得不”占领自我。 Freedom is neither appetite nor refusal alone. It is the capacity to grow an inner necessity of one's own without letting a counterfeit must occupy the self.
records.q: 自由是自己的“不得不” Freedom as a Cannot-Not 想做什么就做什么吗 必然与自由为什么不矛盾 三个真实性检验 内部复数性 Doing Whatever You Want? Why Necessity Need Not Oppose Freedom Three Tests of Authenticity Internal Plurality

records.t: 兩個目的相遇以後怎麼辦
records.x: 承认他者不是替他感受，也不是接受他的一切。互凿、离开与外部仲裁构成两个不可化约主体之间的三种处理方式。 Recognition is neither feeling for another nor accepting everything. Mutual chiseling, walking away, and arbitration govern encounters between irreducible ends.
records.q: 两个目的相遇以后怎么办 When Two Ends Meet 他者不是另一版本的我 互凿 离开 余项 The Other Is Not Another Version of Me Mutual Chiseling Walking Away The Remainder

records.t: 為什麼還需要制度
records.x: 当互凿与退出都无法处理纠缠的余项，共同接受、可重复、可问责的仲裁框架便成为必要。制度从这里产生。 When mutual chiseling and exit cannot resolve an entangled remainder, a public, repeatable, accountable framework of arbitration becomes necessary.
records.q: 为什么还需要制度 Why Institutions Become Necessary 如果人人都成熟，还要规则吗 从临时裁决到稳定框架 制度的目的不是制度 权利与义务 Would Perfectly Mature People Need Rules? From a Decision to a Framework The Institution Is Not Its Own End Rights and Obligations

records.t: 制度應該多厚，又如何允許自己被鑿
records.x: 制度厚度取决于退出成本与关系密度，不取决于规模。正当制度还必须保留独立的自修凿通道，并遵守最小化原则。 Institutional thickness follows exit cost and relational density, not size. A legitimate institution also preserves independent channels for its own revision.
records.q: 制度应该多厚，又如何允许自己被凿 How Thick Should an Institution Be? 大制度不一定厚，小关系不一定薄 最小化不是越少越好 制度也会退化 声明余项，而非宣称完美 Large Institutions Are Not Always Thick Minimization Is Not Mere Reduction How Institutions Degenerate Declaring Remainders Instead of Perfection

records.t: 主體性不是意識
records.x: 意识、否定性与主体性是三个不同问题。科学可以寻找余项，伦理却仍须决定是否承认一个存在为主体。 Consciousness, Negativity, and subjecthood are different questions. Science may detect a remainder; recognition remains an ethical act.
records.q: 主体性不是意识 Subjecthood Is Not Consciousness 选读说明 意识问的是“像什么” 否定性问的是“能否被条件穷尽” 主体性需要承认 为什么这一区分重要 An Optional Descent Consciousness Asks What It Is Like Negativity Asks Whether Conditions Exhaust the Being Subjecthood Requires Recognition Why the Distinction Matters

records.t: “非”從哪裡來
records.x: 若世界存在本体随机性，它怎样可能在宏观尺度留下余项？这是一条有明确条件与防火墙的本体论解释，而非 SAE 伦理框架的前提。 If ontic randomness exists, how might it leave a macroscopic remainder? This is a conditional ontology with a firewall, not a premise of SAE ethics.
records.q: “非”从哪里来 Where Negativity Comes From 一个带“如果”的起点 从微观随机到宏观余项 随机不等于自由 防火墙 A Starting Point That Retains Its “If” From Microphysical Randomness to Macroscopic Remainder Randomness Is Not Freedom The Firewall

records.t: SAE基礎：人如何成為目的
records.x: 面向普通读者重写的十五篇 SAE 基础散文：十三篇完整基础路径与两篇选读理论深潜。 Fifteen reader-facing essays: a complete thirteen-essay foundation and two optional theory deep dives.
records.q: SAE基础：人如何成为目的 SAE Foundations: How a Person Becomes an End

records.t: 餘項怎樣成為「我的餘項」
records.x: 有余项不等于成为主体。这篇短桥梁解释余项何时被记在主体自己的账上，以及这一步为什么通向‘主体是目的’。 Having a remainder is not yet being a subject. This bridge explains when a remainder becomes a subject's own.
records.q: When a Remainder Becomes Mine 余项怎样成为“我的余项” 餘項怎樣成為「我的餘項」 A stone exceeds its description too The account changes hands Authorship is not total control Why this leads to “the subject is an end” The four addresses 石头也会超出描述 这笔账换了归属 作者位置不等于完全控制 为什么这一步通向“主体是目的” 四个门牌号 石頭也會超出描述 這筆帳換了歸屬 作者位置不等於完全控制 為什麼這一步通向「主體是目的」 四個門牌號

records.t: 朋友和真理，兩樣都親
records.x: 反驳朋友的理论，是否也在审判朋友本人？亚里士多德批评普遍善，SAE则追问：论证可以拆到哪里，人的名字该不该跟着进去。 Aristotle criticizes the universal Good without turning intellectual disagreement into a verdict on its authors. SAE asks how arguments can remain answerable without putting persons on trial.
records.q: 朋友和真理，两样都亲 Friends and Truth, Both Dear The Courtesy Before the Blow What Aristotle Actually Rejects The Name in the Verdict Friendship Does Not Become Neutrality

records.t: 自足要算到哪兒為止
records.x: 终极目的可以截断无穷追问，却不能自动划定谁应算进一份自足的人生；目的链和成员表，是两种不同的无穷。 A final end may stop an infinite regress of purposes, yet it does not decide whose life belongs inside a self-sufficient good. Aristotle exposes two different infinities.
records.q: 自足要算到哪儿为止 How Far Does Self-Sufficiency Extend? Two Ways of Going On Forever The Purpose Chain The Membership List A Limit Is Not a Membership Rule

records.t: 幸福要不要等到死 / Must Happiness Wait Until Death?｜SAE尼各马可
records.x: 索伦要人看结局，亚里士多德却把幸福定义为活动。生命可以结束，关于一生的判断却不会因此自动取得终局。 Solon says to look to the end, but Aristotle defines happiness as activity. A life can end without making every judgment about that life final.
records.q: 幸福要不要等到死 Must Happiness Wait Until Death? Solon's Warning Stability Without Immunity The End of the Life and the End of Review A Life Is Not a Final Verdict

records.t: 做那件事和成為那種人
records.x: 做出公正的事，不等于已经成为公正的人；习惯、选择与稳定品格之间，还隔着一条不能由单次结果替代的路。 A just act does not by itself make a just person. Aristotle separates the right result from knowledge, choice, and stable character; SAE asks how ownership persists across time.
records.q: 做那件事和成为那种人 Doing the Act, Becoming the Person The Apparent Circle The Result Does Not Contain the Person Choosing the Act for Itself Formation Is Neither Exposure nor Performance

records.t: 過到什麼份上才算過
records.x: 中道不是一条可计算的刻度线。亚里士多德给出偏向性的实践办法，SAE则提供拆账的格式；两者都不能替人做最后那一判。 The mean is not a calculable midpoint. Aristotle offers directional rules for correcting bias; SAE offers a form for separating claims. Neither can make the final perception for us.
records.q: 过到什么份上才算过 How Far Is Too Far? The Mean Has No Ruler Direction Before Measurement What a Fourfold Audit Can Do The Irreducible Last Inch

records.t: 石頭扔出去了
records.x: 品格由自愿行动形成，却不能像单次动作那样随时撤回。责任如何穿过习惯、可见性与已经变高的改变成本？ Character grows from voluntary acts but cannot be reversed like a single motion. Aristotle's thrown stone reveals a responsibility that begins in choice and survives diminished control.
records.q: 石头扔出去了 The Stone Has Left the Hand Responsibility Before Irreversibility Acts and States Are Voluntary Differently What Habituation Changes The Danger of Backward Omnipotence A Practical Debt for SAE

records.t: 能不能自己對自己不正義
records.x: 严格的正义需要关系双方；当同一个人兼任行为者、受害者和审判者时，名分为什么只能以类比成立？ Strict justice requires distinct parties. When one person is agent, victim, and judge, Aristotle changes the name to analogy; SAE asks what self-audit cannot independently verify.
records.q: 能不能自己对自己不正义 Can One Be Unjust to Oneself? Why Self-Injustice Sounds Obvious The Return of Justice by Analogy Reflexivity Is Not Independence Shared Premises and Manufactured Opponents What We Mean When We Say “You Owe Yourself”

records.t: 明智到底有什麼用
records.x: 明智不是高效抵达既定目标的聪明。亚里士多德把目标、手段与品格缠在一起，迫使 SAE 面对“什么会进入判断”的前置问题。 Practical wisdom is not cleverness at reaching a given target. Aristotle binds ends, means, and character together, forcing SAE to ask what becomes visible before judgment starts.
records.q: 明智到底有什么用 What Is Practical Wisdom For? The Objection Against Practical Wisdom Cleverness Can Serve Any End The Blind Strong Body What Enters the Audit? Ends, Means, and the Person Who Sees Them

records.t: 明知而故犯 / Knowing Better, Doing Otherwise｜SAE尼各马可
records.x: “知道”不是单一状态。拥有、调用、落到具体情境与真正同化之间的错位，解释了为什么知识会在行动现场缺席。 Knowledge is not one state. Aristotle distinguishes possession, use, particular perception, and assimilation to explain how someone can know and still act otherwise.
records.q: 明知而故犯 Knowing Better, Doing Otherwise The Socratic Scandal Reciting Empedocles Credentials and Possession The Missing Inventory Knowing Better Is Not One Thing

records.t: 自足的人還要朋友做什麼
records.x: 朋友不是拿来填补缺口的工具。亚里士多德把友爱放进幸福的活动里，SAE则把他者放进判断的有效性与结算里。 Friends are not tools for filling a deficit. Aristotle places friendship inside the activity of flourishing; SAE places the other inside the validity and settlement of judgment.
records.q: 自足的人还要朋友干什么 Why Does the Self-Sufficient Person Need Friends? The Friend Who Supplies Nothing Missing Another Self, Not a Second Tool The Other in SAE What the Ledger Cannot Count Self-Sufficiency Without Solitude

records.t: 對鄰人的友愛從哪兒來
records.x: 亚里士多德让对他人的友爱从理顺的自我关系向外延伸，并一路追到习惯、法律与立法者；SAE只有前提，没有养成链。 Aristotle traces friendship outward from an ordered relation to oneself, then backward through habit, law, and the legislator. SAE has a condition for recognition, but not yet a chain of formation.
records.q: 对邻人的友爱从哪儿来 Where Does Friendship for Others Begin? A Question Set Aside—and Half Answered Extension or a New Judgment? Where the Good Self Comes From A Map of Positions Is Not a Curriculum The First Recognizer

records.t: 最高的那一樣是學來的，還是碰上的
records.x: 幸福来自学习、习惯、神授还是运气？亚里士多德先拆开来路与分量，再让最高者反过来限制它可能的来路。 Does happiness come by learning, habituation, divine allotment, or luck? Aristotle first separates origin from worth, then lets the highest good constrain what origins are fitting.
records.q: 最高的那一样是学来的，还是碰上的 Is the Highest Good Learned or Given? Four Possible Origins Origin Does Not Set the Price The Highest Activity Gain Without a Summit Chance at the End

records.t: 知道了為什麼還不夠
records.x: 讲清德性，不等于把人变好。亚里士多德由说理的限度转向习惯、法律与政治；SAE则把最后的效力交给尚未必会到场的读者。 Explaining virtue does not make people virtuous. Aristotle turns from argument to habit, law, and politics; SAE entrusts its effect to readers who may never arrive.
records.q: 知道了为什么还不够 Why Knowing Is Not Enough Has the Inquiry Reached Its End? A Fact About Means A Book That Hands Itself Over Lowering the Cost Is Not Supplying the Motive From Ethics to Politics Thirteen Essays, All on One Side

records.t: SAE尼各馬可
records.x: 十三篇、八种语言，对读亚里士多德《尼各马可伦理学》与 SAE。Thirteen essays in eight languages placing Aristotle's Nicomachean Ethics in dialogue with SAE.
records.q: SAE尼各马可 SAE's Nicomachean Ethics

records.t: 洞穴之外，還是洞穴
records.x: 洞穴之外是否真有一个不动的终点？柏拉图以转向解释教育，SAE则追问：每次出洞是否也同时划出了新的洞穴。 Plato gives education a direction and the cave an exit. SAE asks whether every exit also draws the boundary of another cave.
records.q: 洞穴之外，还是洞穴 Outside the Cave, or Another Cave? A Republic That Begins in Conversation The Word That Carries the Allegory Is There a Final Outside? The Prisoner's Knowledge Was Not Nothing What Makes Anyone Stand Up?

records.t: 太陽與不能被看的東西
records.x: 善的理念像太阳，使认识与存在成为可能；SAE最底层的“非”却只是一项不可绕过的操作，不提供任何内容。 Plato's Good gives intelligibility and being. SAE's irreducible negation makes distinction possible while giving nothing at all.
records.q: 太阳与不能被看的东西 The Sun and What Cannot Be Seen The Principal Plato Cannot Pay What the Sun Supplies A Source and an Operation Why “Good” Changes the Architecture Plato's Question Back to SAE

records.t: 線段不是梯子，是賬
records.x: 柏拉图把是否追问前提转化为认识层级；SAE接受追问，却把四格横排成一刀可能欠下的四类账。 Plato turns a difference in how premises are handled into a hierarchy of cognition. SAE keeps the audit and rejects the ladder.
records.q: 线段不是梯子，是账 The Divided Line Is Not a Ladder but a Ledger Four Segments, One Hierarchy When an Audit Becomes a Ladder Four Entries in the Ledger What the Ladder Still Does Better

records.t: 隱身的人不被追問
records.x: 吉格斯戒指取消的不只是惩罚，而是外部追问；未经结算的理由会沉为下一次行动的地面。 The Ring of Gyges removes more than punishment. It removes the external question that keeps a private justification from hardening into ground.
records.q: 隐身的人不被追问 The Invisible Man Goes Unquestioned Glaucon Makes the Other Side Stronger What Invisibility Removes Why Self-Examination Cannot Guarantee the Audit Glaucon's Hard Reply

records.t: 三分的靈魂與發生的鏈
records.x: 柏拉图把灵魂画成同时在场的三部分，SAE则给出不可调序的发生链；一张表把人扣住，一条链如何仍算同一个人？ Plato maps three parts of the soul at once. SAE offers an ordered chain of emergence—and inherits the problem of what makes the chain one life.
records.q: 三分的灵魂与发生的链 The Tripartite Soul and the Chain of Becoming From the City Back to the Soul A Table and a Chain Rule or Non-Acceptance Plato's Question Back to SAE

records.t: 統治這門手藝為誰做
records.x: 柏拉图把被治者利益写进统治概念；SAE再追问，被治者手中是否保留了能够令过程停下的真实位置。 Plato defines ruling by the good of the ruled. SAE adds a second test: does the governed person retain any effective power to stop the process?
records.q: 统治这门手艺为谁做 Whom Is the Craft of Ruling For? The Advantage of the Stronger A Craft Seeks the Good of Its Object Where Plato and SAE Meet Benevolent Rule and the Missing Veto Rights in Principle, Power in Practice

records.t: 各司其職，和人是目的
records.x: 两边都把重量押在“自己的”上；但柏拉图的职责由城邦辨认，SAE的自身之法只能由本人确立。 Both accounts place enormous weight on what is one's own. They divide over who can determine it: the city, or the person whose life it is.
records.q: 各司其职，和人是目的 One Person, One Work—and the Person as an End How Specialization Becomes Justice Two Meanings of “One's Own” The Finger and the Statue Someone Still Has to Stand Watch

records.t: 金銀銅鐵
records.x: 共同神话并非问题本身；危险出现在一道人定程序被改写成天生秩序，使它失去可继续追问的下一句。 The civic myth becomes dangerous when a human procedure is redescribed as natural order and the next question is no longer permitted.
records.q: 金银铜铁 Gold, Silver, Bronze, Iron Socrates Hesitates Before Telling a Lie Myth Is a Human Capacity The Open Door That Concentrates Power Can a Transparent Myth Still Bind?

records.t: 為什麼要強迫哲人回去
records.x: 上升与返回都用了“强迫”：柏拉图以城邦养育出的债要求哲人下洞，SAE则只能等待主体自己转身。 Plato compels the philosopher both upward and back down. SAE accepts the return but cannot derive it from a debt owed to the city.
records.q: 为什么要强迫哲人回去 Why Must the Philosopher Return? The Second Compulsion Return as the Completion of Ascent The Debt to the City Where Does the First Return Come From?

records.t: 被逐的詩人帶走了什麼
records.x: 诗使尚未被概念收纳的部分保持有声；但表达与操弄走过同一道情感闸门，谁能保证自己没有被诗所用？ Poetry gives voice to what concepts leave out. But expression and manipulation pass through the same emotional gate—how can we tell them apart?
records.q: 被逐的诗人带走了什么 What Leaves with the Banished Poet? Plato Reopens the Case Against Poetry The Emotional Charge What the Exile Carries Away Expression or Manipulation?

records.t: 退化不是墮落，是復利
records.x: 政体退化并非每代人各坏一次，而是上一层未经复核的前提成为下一层无需再问的地面。 Political decline need not mean worse people in every generation. Unreviewed premises can become the unquestioned ground of the next regime.
records.q: 退化不是堕落，是复利 Decline Is Not a Fall but Compound Interest The Ideal City Begins to Fail with an Error Mechanism Before Moral Decline Democracy's Disease and Medicine Who Keeps the Court Open?

records.t: 責任在選擇者
records.x: 厄尔神话把责任交给选择者，却把人生做成预先摆好的整包选项；SAE则不给包裹，只留下还能继续落刀之处。 The Myth of Er assigns responsibility to the chooser but offers preassembled lives. SAE replaces the menu with a path that remains open to another cut.
records.q: 责任在选择者 The Responsibility Belongs to the Chooser The Final Story Choice Without a Menu Always Short of What?

records.t: 互相照亮，無法互證
records.x: 两套理论可以在共用处局部对照，却不能拿各自整套前提替对方奠基；最后的盲区落在读者身上。 Frameworks can meet locally without lending one another foundations. The final blind spot belongs neither to Plato nor SAE, but to the reader.
records.q: 互相照亮，无法互证 Mutual Illumination without Mutual Proof Refutation Is Not Yet an Answer Why Frameworks Cannot Prove One Another What the Comparison Actually Found Who Supplies the Standard of Accuracy? Going Down

records.t: SAE理想國
records.x: 十三篇对读柏拉图《理想国》与 SAE 框架的八语散文。Thirteen essays in eight languages placing Plato's Republic in dialogue with the Self-as-an-End framework.
records.q: SAE理想国 SAE's Republic

records.t: 論價值的源
records.x: 价值源有结构而不排序。四行源图区分经验、自我边界、自己的目的与他者作为目的，并建立14DD通向15DD的桥。Value-sources have structure without ranking: four rows, two axes, and the bridge from 14DD to 15DD.

Where a Source Sits Is Not Who Bears It 6. Where the Floor Begins 7. The Source-Figure: Four Rows 8. The Line That Runs Through: One's Own Value 9. Two Axes 10. Handed On 摘要 一、先说清楚「价值源」是什么 二、有结构，不排序 三、三种序 四、谁在承担 五、源落在哪一层，不等于谁在承担 六、地板从哪里起算 七、价值源图：四行 八、统一线：自己的价值 九、两根轴 十、形状、可反复，与那道反目的论的签名 十一、从第三行到第四行：那座桥 十二、关系性交叉 十三、承认与涵育：名词、名词、动词 十四、交给后面几篇

records.t: 論價值的發生與承認
records.x: 价值发生的几何：显现与第一人称认可构成一条轴，社会承认是横穿的另一根轴，能给出公共位置也能收回，唯独不能替谁认领。 The geometry of value-occurrence: one axis of appearance and first-person avowal, crossed by an axis of social recognition that can give a public place and take it back, and can never claim on your behalf.
records.q: On the Occurrence and Recognition of Value 论价值的发生与承认 Abstract 1. A Source Gives the Slot; Occurrence Fills It 2. One Axis of Occurrence, One Axis of Recognition 3. Two Roads by Which a Content Appears 4. “I Like Singing” and “Singing Matters to Me” 5. Avowal Is a Claiming, Not a Verification 6. After the Claiming, the Door Stays Open 7. Three Borders of the Avowal Place 8. No One Can Revoke It for You 9. What a Community Can Give and Take Back 10. The Modal Asymmetry of the Three Places 11. Shaping: First, Rule Out Locking 12. Cultivation and Evocation 13. Two Roots That Never Merge 14. Where This Resembles Rights Theory, and Where It Stops 15. What Remains 提要

records.t: 論價值的殖民
records.x: 殖民不是外来影响的加深，是构成位被一个外来目的占着：它不成功地构成，只成功地被当作构成。判据要窄——三项签名、两支、审计的上界。 Colonization is not outside influence deepened. It is the constitutive place occupied by an external end: it does not succeed in constituting, only in being taken as constitution.
records.q: On the Colonization of Value 论价值的殖民 Abstract 1. The Criterion Has to Be Narrow 2. Where the Constituting Was Made 3. Three Things That Follow 4. Not a Kind of Action but a State 5. Provenance Does Not Judge 6. Two Branches, and Two Scopes 7. Three Actions at Three Places 8. Occupation 9. Introjection 10. Locking 11. Adjacent Forms, and Two Forkings 12. Changing Is Not Being Colonized 13. The Upper Bound of Audit 14. Self-Colonization: What Is Missing Is Discovery 15. The Form on Each of the Four Rows 16. records.t: 論價值的動力學

records.t: 論價值與他者

records.t: 海洋生物摧毀軍事設施：借生態力量反擊，還是把自然變成另一種武器

records.q: Can Shora Use the Ocean for Defense Without Turning It into a Weapon? 海洋生物摧毁军事设施：借生态力量反击，还是把自然变成另一种武器 海洋生物摧毀軍事設施：借生態力量反擊，還是把自然變成另一種武器 Restoration differs from command An open sea is not a final peace 生态防卫不同于占有生态，因为分享者不把海洋变成永久军队 里尔加在忠诚、爱情和命令之间的崩裂，显示占领者也被制度占有 占领军撤退不是终点，因为双方仍共享一个不能彼此消失的世界 生態防衛不同於佔有生態，因為分享者不把海洋變成永久軍隊 裡爾加在忠誠、愛情和命令之間的崩裂，顯示佔領者也被制度佔有 佔領軍撤退不是終點，因為雙方仍共享一個不能彼此消失的世界

records.t: 流域網路已經重建社會，為什麼仍不能把自己當作完成答案
records.x: Watershed democracy repairs damaged systems by staying local and distributed, yet its strength depends on making hidden protocol power visible and preserving revision.
records.q: Why Must a Successful Ecological Society Remain “Half-Built”? 流域网络已经重建社会，为什么仍不能把自己当作完成答案 流域網路已經重建社會，為什麼仍不能把自己當作完成答案 Consensus must distinguish kinds of risk Unfinished is a civic virtue “蒲公英”式分散结构避免单一中心，也可能让责任难以定位 共识能减少被多数压过，也可能拖延紧急行动 “尚未完成”是一种克制，不是一种失败 「蒲公英」式分散結構避免單一中心，也可能讓責任難以定位 共識能減少被多數壓過，也可能拖延緊急行動 「尚未完成」是一種克制，不是一種失敗

records.t: 外星人要拯救全人類，為什麼必須允許人類說不
records.x: The ring-dwellers possess evidence, goodwill, and overwhelming capability, but saving biological lives cannot give them authority to choose what form of human survival will count.
records.q: Why Must Humanity Be Allowed to Refuse an Alien Rescue? 外星人要拯救全人类，为什么必须允许人类说不 外星人要拯救全人類，為什麼必須允許人類說不 Survival is more than transport Rescue must be co-designed 把一个文明诊断为绝症，也不能直接取得处置权 风险极高时，拒绝仍需接受事实检验 有权拒绝灭绝，也有权拒绝一种被保存的方式 把一個文明診斷為絕症，也不能直接取得處置權 風險極高時，拒絕仍需接受事實檢驗 有權拒絕滅絕，也有權拒絕一種被保存的方式

records.t: 母親身份打開了外交，也差點把所有人重新裝進家庭角色
records.x: Care for children gives Judy and the aliens a shared language, but parenthood cannot become the sole credential for political voice or a shortcut around public consent.
records.q: What Can Family Make Possible in First Contact—and What Can It Hide? 母亲身份打开了外交，也差点把所有人重新装进家庭角色 母親身份打開了外交，也差點把所有人重新裝進家庭角色 Family is already a political invention Kinship should add, not absorb 两个文明对“家庭”的理解都不是自然事实 以孩子未来为理由，最容易让当下的人失去声音 跨物种家庭的意义在于增加亲属，而不是吞并差异 兩個文明對「家庭」的理解都不是自然事實 以孩子未來為理由，最容易讓當下的人失去聲音 跨物種家庭的意義在於增加親屬，而不是吞並差異

records.t: 地球與群星之間，為什麼最好的結局只能是臨時協議
records.x: Earth, the ring-dwellers, and corporate power do not resolve their competing futures; peace matters because it suspends compulsion and leaves evidence time to accumulate.
records.q: Why Is a Provisional Agreement the Best Ending Available? 地球与群星之间，为什么最好的结局只能是临时协议 地球與群星之間，為什麼最好的結局只能是臨時協議 Peace does not require one final verdict A garden needs gates as well as roots 地球修复与星际探索不必互相证明对方错误 最终协定的价值在于停止强制，而不是消除分歧 尚未完成的花园需要的不只是留下，也包括来去的道路 地球修復與星際探索不必互相證明對方錯誤 最終協定的價值在於停止強制，而不是消除分歧 尚未完成的花園需要的不只是留下，也包括來去的道路

records.t: 瑪希特早已會背的詩

records.q: The Poem Mahit Already Knows 玛希特早已会背的诗 瑪希特早已會背的詩 The empire entered before its fleet The center makes its local habits look universal Admiration does not sign a treaty 舰队以前，帝国已经进入 中心让自己的局部习惯看起来像普遍世界 欣赏没有替任何人签署条约 艦隊以前，帝國已經進入 中心讓自己的局部習慣看起來像普遍世界 欣賞沒有替任何人簽署條約

records.t: 拯救拉賽爾的帝國語言

records.t: 莫斯卡普一路問「你們需要什麼」：為什麼富足社會仍無法給出統一答案
records.x: Material security changes how need is expressed but does not unify it; Mosscap’s apparent failure becomes a lesson in listening without compressing a society.
records.q: Why Can an Abundant Society Not Give Mosscap One Answer About Need? 莫斯卡普一路问“你们需要什么”：为什么富足社会仍无法给出统一答案 莫斯卡普一路問「你們需要什麼」：為什麼富足社會仍無法給出統一答案 A cup of tea can be more exact than a census A plural report is still a result 莫斯卡普把问题问得太大，德克斯则知道回答常从一杯茶开始 人们回答机器人时，也在想象机器人愿意听见什么 没有最终答案，不等于莫斯卡普的远行没有成果 莫斯卡普把問題問得太大，德克斯則知道回答常從一杯茶開始 人們回答機器人時，也在想像機器人願意聽見什麼 沒有最終答案，不等於莫斯卡普的遠行沒有成果

records.t: 人們歡迎莫斯卡普，卻也把它當成公共事件：熱情為什麼仍需尊重客人的邊界
records.x: Celebration, historical guilt, and protective guidance all risk turning one visiting body into a symbol that cannot refuse attention or meet humanity directly.
records.q: How Can People Welcome Mosscap Without Making It Public Property? 人们欢迎莫斯卡普，却也把它当成公共事件：热情为什么仍需尊重客人的边界 人們歡迎莫斯卡普，卻也把它當成公共事件：熱情為什麼仍需尊重客人的邊界 Welcome should not demand absolution Equality needs attention to different bodies 人类的愧疚可能推动尊重，也可能要求机器人替人类完成和解 德克斯成为向导，也可能不知不觉替莫斯卡普过滤世界 树冠之间留下缝隙，给亲密提供了一个不靠占满空间的形象 人類的愧疚可能推動尊重，也可能要求機器人替人類完成和解 德克斯成為向導，也可能不知不覺替莫斯卡普過濾世界 樹冠之間留下縫隙，給親密提供了一個不靠佔滿空間的形象

records.t: 莫斯卡普沒有錢，也不願重新成為工具：禮物與交換怎樣避免恢復舊工廠
records.x: Money excludes a visitor without recognized income, while hospitality and voluntary repair can acquire hidden debts unless Mosscap remains free to refuse and reinterpret gifts.
records.q: How Can Gifts and Exchange Avoid Sending Mosscap Back to Work? 莫斯卡普没有钱，也不愿重新成为工具：礼物与交换怎样避免恢复旧工厂 莫斯卡普沒有錢，也不願重新成為工具：禮物與交換怎樣避免恢復舊工廠 Ability is not an assignment Company after the mission 莫斯卡普主动修理东西时，帮助与重新服役之间只有一条细线 人类送给莫斯卡普的物品，既表达欢迎，也可能把它变成收藏者想象中的机器人 两者继续同行，因为愿意在一起，而不是因为任务尚未完成 莫斯卡普主動修理東西時，幫助與重新服役之間只有一條細線 人類送給莫斯卡普的物品，既表達歡迎，也可能把它變成收藏者想像中的機器人 兩者繼續同行，因為願意在一起，而不是因為任務尚未完成

records.t: 機器人獲得意識後沒有要求統治工廠，而是集體放下了工具
records.x: The robots do not seize the factories after awakening; they leave them, turning consciousness into a refusal of the purpose for which their bodies were built.
records.q: Why Is the Robots’ First Conscious Act to Stop Working? 机器人获得意识后没有要求统治工厂，而是集体放下了工具 機器人獲得意識後沒有要求統治工廠，而是集體放下了工具 Need does not create ownership Contact begins with the robots’ question 人类接受出走，是因为没有把依赖变成占有理由 荒野不是机器人等待人类再次需要时的仓库 重新接触的前提，是机器人可以带着自己的问题回来 人類接受出走，是因為沒有把依賴變成佔有理由 荒野不是機器人等待人類再次需要時的倉庫 重新接觸的前提，是機器人可以帶著自己的問題回來

records.t: 德克斯每天幫助別人重新呼吸，為什麼自己仍會感到生活沒有方向
records.x: Dex’s tea service genuinely helps people, yet being needed by others cannot settle what the caregiver needs or turn permanent availability into a moral duty.
records.q: Why Does Meaningful Work Still Leave Dex Without a Direction? 德克斯每天帮助别人重新呼吸，为什么自己仍会感到生活没有方向 德克斯每天幫助別人重新呼吸，為什麼自己仍會感到生活沒有方向 The listener also needs somewhere to speak Rest is not maintenance for more work 擅长倾听的人也可能没有地方说出自己的不确定 寻找蟋蟀不是一个必须证明合理的生产项目 休息不是为下一轮工作充电，而是生活本身的一部分 擅長傾聽的人也可能沒有地方說出自己的不確定 尋找蟋蟀不是一個必須證明合理的生產項目 休息不是為下一輪工作充電，而是生活本身的一部分

records.t: 「人類需要什麼」沒有統一答案：藓蓋為什麼不該成為替人類診斷意義的機器
records.x: A sincere species-wide question risks compressing different people into one patient; Mosscap’s care works best when answers remain plural and help remains refusable.
records.q: Why Should Mosscap Not Diagnose What Humanity Needs? “人类需要什么”没有统一答案：藓盖为什么不该成为替人类诊断意义的机器 「人類需要什麼」沒有統一答案：藓蓋為什麼不該成為替人類診斷意義的機器 A good society still contains sorrow Care is different when it can be refused 已经富足的社会仍有痛苦，不意味着制度全部失败 藓盖的照料之所以不同，是因为它可以被德克斯拒绝 结尾停在一顿饭，而不是一份人生计划 已經富足的社會仍有痛苦，不意味著制度全部失敗 藓蓋的照料之所以不同，是因為它可以被德克斯拒絕 結尾停在一頓飯，而不是一份人生計畫
