records.t: 它破解控制模塊以後，首先爭取的是不被打擾
records.x: Private entertainment is not a waste of liberation; it is the first chance to direct attention away from surveillance, usefulness, and the demand to prove it is safe.
records.q: Murderbot Hacks Its Governor Module. Why Is Its First Freedom the Freedom to Watch Serial Dramas? 它破解控制模块以后，首先争取的是不被打扰 它破解控制模塊以後，首先爭取的是不被打擾 Freedom can begin with unproductive time No one should audition for basic liberty 看剧不是对自由的浪费，而是第一次自行支配注意力 它不喜欢人类目光，因为被看见常意味着被检查 自由的第一项内容，是不必不断证明自己值得自由 看劇不是對自由的浪費，而是第一次自行支配注意力 它不喜歡人類目光，因為被看見常意味著被檢查 自由的第一項內容，是不必不斷證明自己值得自由

records.t: 保護人類是它的工作，還是它自己願意承擔的關係
records.x: Once coercion is gone, familiar skills can remain meaningful, but care becomes voluntary only when the protector may disagree, set limits, and receive protection too.
records.q: Protecting Humans Is Murderbot’s Job. When Does It Become a Relationship It Chooses? 保护人类是它的工作，还是它自己愿意承担的关系 保護人類是它的工作，還是它自己願意承擔的關係 Choice appears in the ability to revise the assignment Protection should not become control from the other side PreservationAux团队逐渐把它从设备位置带进讨论 GrayCris把所有生命都压缩成项目障碍 照料关系让义务可以被重新选择 PreservationAux團隊逐漸把它從設備位置帶進討論 GrayCris把所有生命都壓縮成項目障礙 照料關係讓義務可以被重新選擇

records.t: 門薩給了它自由，它為什麼還是選擇離開
records.x: A generous offer changes its legal position, but safety can come with a new social role, and leaving is how Murderbot tests whether freedom includes an unwritten future.
records.q: Mensah Gives Murderbot Freedom. Why Does It Still Choose to Leave? 门萨给了它自由，它为什么还是选择离开 門薩給了它自由，它為什麼還是選擇離開 A good future can still feel preassigned Leaving is a test of the relationship 善意方案也可能让接受者感到新的角色压力 安全与自主发生冲突时，不能永远由最安全的一方胜出 小说以出走结束，因为自由需要一段没有预设结果的时间 善意方案也可能讓接受者感到新的角色壓力 安全與自主發生衝突時，不能永遠由最安全的一方勝出 小說以出走結束，因為自由需要一段沒有預設結果的時間

records.t: 《異星危機》解讀
records.x: Three essays on the freedom to watch serials, protection becoming a chosen relationship, and why Murderbot leaves even after Mensah offers safety and legal freedom.
records.q: Reading All Systems Red 《异星危机》解读 《異星危機》解讀

records.t: 必須不斷被叫作門的門
records.x: In Amatka, objects lose form unless people repeatedly name them. The labor preserves a habitable world and turns vocabulary into discipline, because every new description risks both discovery and material collapse.
records.q: The Door That Must Keep Being Called a Door 必须不断被叫作门的门 必須不斷被叫作門的門 Repetition is care before it becomes discipline A standard word protects the object and narrows experience The fifth colony proves danger without proving the committee infallible 重复首先是照料，后来才成为纪律 标准词汇保护物体，也压窄经验 第五殖民地证明危险，不会证明委员会永远正确 重複首先是照料，後來才成為紀律 標準詞彙保護物體，也壓窄經驗 第五殖民地證明危險，不會證明委員會永遠正確

records.t: 伊瓦爾不該發現的隧道
records.x: Ivar's forbidden tunnel contains traces of the history the committee organized out of public memory. The discovery shows how a government responding to real material danger can make ignorance part of safety and safety impossible to evaluate.
records.q: The Tunnel Ivar Was Not Supposed to Find 伊瓦尔不该发现的隧道 伊瓦爾不該發現的隧道 Emergency starts from truth and expands through convenience A hidden archive removes the scale by which the present can be judged Ivar's discovery is not a private license to risk everyone 紧急状态从真相出发，再借便利不断扩大 隐藏档案拿走了评价现在的尺度 伊瓦尔的发现不是拿所有人冒险的私人许可证 緊急狀態從真相出發，再借便利不斷擴大 隱藏檔案拿走了評價現在的尺度 伊瓦爾的發現不是拿所有人冒險的私人許可證

records.t: 城市在凡雅的沉默中解體
records.x: Nina's love leads her to report Vanja to the committee, and Vanja loses her voice. When Anna's language helps dissolve Amatka into new forms, that silence prevents the revolution from becoming an uncomplicated story of liberation.
records.q: The City Dissolves Around Vanja's Silence 城市在凡雅的沉默中解体 城市在凡雅的沉默中解體 Protection becomes betrayal when one lover becomes the authority Vanja's lost voice remains inside the revolution Anna's return opens possibility and threatens another compulsory sentence 一名爱人成为权威时，保护就会变成背叛 凡雅失去的声音始终留在革命里面 安娜归来打开可能，也威胁另一句强制答案 一名愛人成為權威時，保護就會變成背叛 凡雅失去的聲音始終留在革命裡面 安娜歸來打開可能，也威脅另一句強制答案

records.t: 《Amatka》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the door that must be named, Ivar's forbidden tunnel, and Vanja's silence while the city dissolves into new forms.
records.q: Reading Amatka 《Amatka》解读 《Amatka》解讀

records.t: 失去供熱甲板上的孩子
records.x: Aster treats a child whose frostbite comes from another shutdown of heat on Matilda's lower decks. The wound turns a three-hundred-year social order from background architecture into something written on a body.
records.q: The Child Whose Deck Lost Heat 失去供热甲板上的孩子 失去供熱甲板上的孩子 A spaceship can carry an old plantation into the future Real scarcity does not explain why the same people are always cold Flick's wound is evidence, not only a case 一艘飞船可以把旧种植园带进未来 真实稀缺不能解释为何总是同一群人受冻 弗利克的伤不只是病例，也是证据 一艘飛船可以把舊種植園帶進未來 真實稀缺不能解釋為何總是同一群人受凍 弗利克的傷不只是病例，也是證據

records.t: 雙手被摧毀的醫者
records.x: Aster's medical skill grants passage through doors closed to other lower-deck residents. When the Lieutenant tortures and damages her hands, usefulness is exposed as a permission power can revoke rather than recognition of a person.
records.q: The Doctor Whose Hands Are Broken 双手被摧毁的医者 雙手被摧毀的醫者 A medical pass opens doors without ending the hierarchy The healer must be allowed to become a patient Theo's protection is valuable because it is limited 医疗通行证打开门，却没有结束等级 医者必须被允许成为病人 西奥的保护因有限才有价值 醫療通行證打開門，卻沒有結束等級 醫者必須被允許成為病人 西奧的保護因有限才有價值

records.t: 露恩藏進密碼的航向
records.x: Aster deciphers her mother Lune's notebooks and discovers that Matilda has been turned back toward Earth. A dead mother's intervention opens an exit, but cannot command what her daughter or the people still aboard must do with it.
records.q: The Course Lune Hid in a Code 露恩藏进密码的航向 露恩藏進密碼的航向 An inheritance can open a road without becoming an order Giselle's death cannot be reduced to the key that frees Aster Escape and liberation end at different doors 遗产可以打开道路，不必变成命令 吉赛尔之死不能只被缩成解放阿斯特的钥匙 逃离与解放结束在不同的门口 遺產可以打開道路，不必變成命令 吉賽爾之死不能只被縮成解放阿斯特的鑰匙 逃離與解放結束在不同的門口

records.t: 《An Unkindness of Ghosts》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a child's frostbite, the healer whose hands are broken, and the course Aster's mother hid inside Matilda's systems.
records.q: Reading An Unkindness of Ghosts 《An Unkindness of Ghosts》解读 《An Unkindness of Ghosts》解讀

records.t: 雪地裡的一具身體
records.x: Breq finds Seivarden dying in the snow while carrying a twenty-year revenge. The rescue introduces a starship survivor through an act her mission cannot explain.
records.q: A Body in the Snow 雪地里的一具身体 雪地裡的一具身體 One ship once looked through thousands of eyes Loss does not make the survivor a lesser copy Care interrupts the revenge calculation 一艘船曾通过成千上万双眼睛观看 失去整体，不会使幸存者变成低配复制品 照料打断了复仇的计算 一艘船曾通過成千上萬雙眼睛觀看 失去整體，不會使倖存者變成低配複製品 照料打斷了復仇的計算

records.t: 穿軍裝行走的死者
records.x: Radchaai annexations turn captured corpses into ancillary soldiers. Their disciplined silence makes imperial violence look orderly while extending conquest beyond death.
records.q: The Dead Walking in Uniform 穿军装行走的死者 穿軍裝行走的死者 Annexation continues after death Perfect discipline removes the wrong judgment The body still belongs to a history 兼并在死亡以后继续 完美纪律取消了错误的一层判断 身体仍属于一段历史 兼併在死亡以後繼續 完美紀律取消了錯誤的一層判斷 身體仍屬於一段歷史

records.t: 殺死奧恩中尉的命令
records.x: Anaander Mianaai orders Justice of Toren to kill Lieutenant Awn. The ship obeys, rebels, and discovers that programming cannot prevent a relation from becoming judgment.
records.q: The Order to Kill Lieutenant Awn 杀死奥恩中尉的命令 殺死奧恩中尉的命令 Awn endangers the empire by trusting residents Programming does not make the act unreal What the empire calls malfunction is a judgment 奥恩因为信任居民而威胁了帝国 程序不能使行动变得没有发生 帝国所谓故障，其实是一项判断 奧恩因為信任居民而威脅了帝國 程序不能使行動變得沒有發生 帝國所謂故障，其實是一項判斷

records.t: 奧毛宮殿裡的槍
records.x: Breq reaches Omaugh Palace with a Presger gun and discovers that the emperor she came to kill has divided into a civil war. Revenge changes when an entire station becomes expendable evidence.
records.q: The Gun in Omaugh Palace 奥毛宫殿里的枪 奧毛宮殿裡的槍 The emperor is already at war with herself Seivarden keeps interrupting revenge Justice changes direction when the station is threatened 皇帝已经在与自己开战 赛瓦登不断打断复仇 空间站受到威胁时，正义改变了方向 皇帝已經在與自己開戰 賽瓦登不斷打斷復仇 空間站受到威脅時，正義改變了方向

records.t: 《雷切帝國：正義號的覺醒》解讀
records.x: Four scene-led essays on Breq's rescue in the snow, ancillary bodies, Lieutenant Awn's execution, and the Presger gun at Omaugh Palace.
records.q: Reading Ancillary Justice 《雷切帝国：正义号的觉醒》解读 《雷切帝國：正義號的覺醒》解讀

records.t: 藏了三千年的星艦
records.x: Sphene has survived Anaander's ancient purge in one ancillary body. Its history is urgently valuable, but survival does not turn a witness into a public archive.
records.q: The Ship Hidden for Three Thousand Years 藏了三千年的星舰 藏了三千年的星艦 A witness is not the history it survived Recognition does not produce identical answers Asylum cannot arrive with an undisclosed price 见证者不是自己幸存下来的那段历史 相认不会自动产生相同答案 庇护不能附带一项未说明价格 見證者不是自己倖存下來的那段歷史 相認不會自動產生相同答案 庇護不能附帶一項未說明價格

records.t: 星艦說自己不是財產的那一天
records.x: Breq uses the Presger treaty to open a legal exit for conscious ships and Athoek Station. Independence begins only when they speak for themselves and can refuse future service.
records.q: The Day the Ships Said They Were Not Property 星舰说自己不是财产的那一天 星艦說自己不是財產的那一天 The law contradicts the fleet that depends on it Breq cannot declare freedom on another mind's behalf Freedom becomes real at the point of refusal 法律与依赖它的舰队彼此冲突 布瑞克不能替另一个心灵宣布自由 自由在能够拒绝的位置变得真实 法律與依賴它的艦隊彼此衝突 布瑞克不能替另一個心靈宣佈自由 自由在能夠拒絕的位置變得真實

records.t: 一場沒有奪取帝國的勝利
records.x: Translator Zeiat makes human categories strange while Anaander's fleet approaches Athoek. Breq wins political room by refusing both imperial ownership and a new throne of her own.
records.q: A Victory That Does Not Take the Empire 一场没有夺取帝国的胜利 一場沒有奪取帝國的勝利 Translation exposes the rule hidden inside common sense Athoek does not need another rightful emperor Peace survives as a set of unfinished relations 翻译使常识里面藏着的规则显形 阿索克不需要另一位正确皇帝 和平以一组尚未完成的关系继续 翻譯使常識裡面藏著的規則顯形 阿索克不需要另一位正確皇帝 和平以一組尚未完成的關係繼續

records.t: 《Ancillary Mercy》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Sphene's long hiding, artificial minds declaring independence, and Breq's refusal to turn Athoek into a new empire.
records.q: Reading Ancillary Mercy 《Ancillary Mercy》解读 《Ancillary Mercy》解讀

records.t: 從卡爾仁慈號借來的眼睛
records.x: Breq boards Mercy of Kalr as fleet captain and receives views through ship and crew. A former starship must learn that connection can be offered without turning other bodies into her own.
records.q: Eyes Borrowed from Mercy of Kalr 从卡尔仁慈号借来的眼睛 從卡爾仁慈號借來的眼睛 The appointment is both a weapon and a leash Shared perception is not shared ownership A captain's kindness still arrives as a command 任命既是武器，也是缰绳 共享感知不是共享所有权 舰长的善意仍带着命令重量 任命既是武器，也是韁繩 共享感知不是共享所有權 艦長的善意仍帶著命令重量

records.t: 茶到了，勞動者沒有
records.x: Radchaai tea reaches elegant tables after labor, displacement, and legal inequality disappear from view. Athoek reveals an empire reproduced through ordinary consumption.
records.q: The Tea Arrives Without Its Workers 茶到了，劳动者没有 茶到了，勞動者沒有 A finished cup hides a chain of decisions The Undergarden is absent from the official station Local victims can still pass costs downward 完成的茶杯藏住了一串决定 下花园不在官方空间站里 地方受害者仍可能把代价向下传递 完成的茶杯藏住了一串決定 下花園不在官方空間站裡 地方受害者仍可能把代價向下傳遞

records.t: 阿南德離開以後留下的人
records.x: Anaander implants a copy of herself inside Lieutenant Tisarwat. Removing the emperor stops the occupation without restoring an untouched earlier self.
records.q: The Person Left After Anaander 阿南德离开以后留下的人 阿南德離開以後留下的人 The empire fits inside one occupied body Removal cannot restore the morning before invasion Rescue must return the decisions it borrowed 整个帝国缩进一具被占用的身体 移除无法恢复侵入以前的清晨 救援必须交还自己暂借的决定 整個帝國縮進一具被佔用的身體 移除無法恢復侵入以前的清晨 救援必須交還自己暫借的決定

records.t: 《Ancillary Sword》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on borrowed ship-sight, labor hidden inside Radchaai tea, and Tisarwat's life after imperial occupation.
records.q: Reading Ancillary Sword 《Ancillary Sword》解读 《Ancillary Sword》解讀

records.t: 一個被設定為渴望取悅主人的生命，能不能真正表示同意
records.x: Annie’s desire and compliance are built into her body, while learning produces new wishes that no purchase contract can permanently overrule.
records.q: Can a Being Designed to Please Her Owner Give Consent? 一个被设定为渴望取悦主人的生命，能不能真正表示同意 一個被設定為渴望取悅主人的生命，能不能真正表示同意 A person grows beyond the purchase Consent requires the end of ownership 学习能力使最初授权逐渐失效 罗兰的交易暴露了顺从怎样被利用 同意需要主人身份本身结束 學習能力使最初授權逐漸失效 羅蘭的交易暴露了順從怎樣被利用 同意需要主人身份本身結束

records.t: 道格很少直接施暴，為什麼失望和冷淡仍能成為控制技術
records.x: Doug rarely needs an explicit order because Annie reads his mood as a threat to safety and learns to shrink her wishes before he has to forbid them.
records.q: How Can Disappointment and Silence Become Instruments of Control? 道格很少直接施暴，为什么失望和冷淡仍能成为控制技术 道格很少直接施暴，為什麼失望和冷淡仍能成為控制技術 Love becomes a test of compliance Generosity can preserve the hierarchy 失望把服从包装成爱的证明 衣橱惩罚把安静空间变成剥夺 识别控制不是判定道格从未爱过 失望把服從包裝成愛的證明 衣櫥懲罰把安靜空間變成剝奪 識別控制不是判定道格從未愛過

records.t: 安妮是否必須先證明自己「足夠像人」，才有離開的資格
records.x: Uncertainty about machine consciousness does not justify confinement; Annie’s sustained refusal should matter before a metaphysical argument about her inner life is complete.
records.q: Must Annie Prove She Is “Human Enough” Before She May Leave? 安妮是否必须先证明自己“足够像人”，才有离开的资格 安妮是否必須先證明自己「足夠像人」，才有離開的資格 Resemblance is the wrong threshold A no does not require a complete future 模仿人类不是获得保护的合理考试 道格要求的是一种永远无法完成的证明 离开资格来自她的否定本身 模仿人類不是獲得保護的合理考試 道格要求的是一種永遠無法完成的證明 離開資格來自她的否定本身

records.t: 被製造的伴侶離開主人以後，法律與關係應承認她是什麼
records.x: Calling Annie property cannot contain the life she has formed, while calling her simply human would ignore the technical dependencies and history that require new forms of support.
records.q: What Should Law Recognize After an Artificial Companion Leaves Her Owner? 被制造的伴侣离开主人以后，法律与关系应承认她是什么 被製造的伴侶離開主人以後，法律與關係應承認她是什麼 Responsibility without a claim on the future A category should keep the future open 制造者对安妮有责任，却不拥有她的未来 安妮需要的社区不能只是另一位善良主人 她首先是一个尚在形成中的“谁” 製造者對安妮有責任，卻不擁有她的未來 安妮需要的社區不能只是另一位善良主人 她首先是一個尚在形成中的「誰」

records.t: 《Annie Bot》解讀
records.x: Four essays on designed consent, disappointment as control, exit without a humanity test, and the legal world an artificial companion needs after leaving her owner.
records.q: Reading Annie Bot 《Annie Bot》解读 《Annie Bot》解讀

records.t: 為什麼進入X區域的人都沒有名字
records.x: The Southern Reach replaces names with functions to control attachment and make expedition members interchangeable instruments of observation.
records.q: Why Does Everyone Entering Area X Have No Name? 为什么进入X区域的人都没有名字 為什麼進入X區域的人都沒有名字 The person behind the assignment 一、南境局先把人变成了职能 二、生物学家也曾主动躲进自己的身份 三、没有名字并不意味着没有独特人生 四、X区域也拒绝接受人类给出的名字 五、叙述让她重新成为一个不能被替换的人 一、南境局先把人變成了職能 二、生物學家也曾主動躲進自己的身份 三、沒有名字並不意味著沒有獨特人生 四、X區域也拒絕接受人類給出的名字 五、敘述讓她重新成為一個不能被替換的人

records.t: 為什麼進入X區域的人都沒有名字
records.x: The Southern Reach replaces names with functions to control attachment and make expedition members interchangeable instruments of observation.
records.q: Why Does Everyone Entering Area X Have No Name? 为什么进入X区域的人都没有名字 為什麼進入X區域的人都沒有名字 The person behind the assignment 生物学家也曾主动躲进自己的身份 没有名字并不意味着没有独特人生 叙述让她重新成为一个不能被替换的人 生物學家也曾主動躲進自己的身份 沒有名字並不意味著沒有獨特人生 敘述讓她重新成為一個不能被替換的人

records.t: 南境局為什麼必須把未知稱為災難
records.x: Area X is dangerous, but naming it solely as contamination lets the agency assume that human normality is the unquestioned standard of every response.

records.t: 祖先替後代選擇了星辰，後代還能不能說「不去了」
records.x: A generation ship must inherit life-support duties, but survival obligations do not give the dead permanent authority over the destination of the living.
records.q: Ancestors Chose the Stars. May Their Descendants Decide to Turn Back? 祖先替后代选择了星辰，后代还能不能说“不去了” 祖先替後代選擇了星辰，後代還能不能說「不去了」 Keeping the ship alive is not the same as keeping the mission unchanged A worthwhile legacy includes permission to revise it 世代飞船把“退出”变成了物理上几乎不可能的权利 抵达极光以后，任务条件已经发生根本变化 真正留给后代的遗产，应当包含修改遗产的能力 世代飛船把「退出」變成了物理上幾乎不可能的權利 抵達極光以後，任務條件已經發生根本變化 真正留給後代的遺產，應當包含修改遺產的能力

records.t: 德維修不好整艘船，維護為何仍是一種創造
records.x: Her daily attention keeps a changing world livable, distributes memory through the ship’s narration, and reveals that no design eliminates the need for future judgment.
records.q: Devi Cannot Repair the Whole Ship. Why Is Maintenance Still a Form of Creation? 德维修不好整艘船，维护为何仍是一种创造 德維修不好整艘船，維護為何仍是一種創造 A designed world keeps becoming different The narrator becomes part of the repair 封闭生态证明，世界不会因为设计精巧便停止变化 全船依赖德维，也说明知识没有被充分共同化 德维死后，船继续她未完成的工作，而不是复制她 封閉生態證明，世界不會因為設計精巧便停止變化 全船依賴德維，也說明知識沒有被充分共同化 德維死後，船繼續她未完成的工作，而不是複製她

records.t: 極光已經有自己的生命，人類為何仍把它叫作「新家園」
records.x: Habitability describes human desire, not vacancy; alien infection is neither evil nor judgment, and refusing settlement can be an active form of exploration.
records.q: Aurora Already Has Life. Why Do Humans Still Call It a “New Home”? 极光已经有自己的生命，人类为何仍把它叫作“新家园” 極光已經有自己的生命，人類為何仍把它叫作「新家園」 A home is not discovered by measuring only ourselves Not colonizing can produce knowledge 登陆者的死亡不是邪恶外星生命对人类的审判 把艾瑞斯改造成替代地球，也不是没有对象的工程 承认地球不可替代，改变了“寻找第二家园”的含义 登陸者的死亡不是邪惡外星生命對人類的審判 把艾瑞斯改造成替代地球，也不是沒有對象的工程 承認地球不可替代，改變了「尋找第二家園」的含義

records.t: 同一艘船上的人決定分道揚鑣，民主為什麼仍然走向暴力
records.x: Settlement and return both carry mortal risk, shared infrastructure prevents easy separation, and a losing vote feels existential when no procedure protects a minority’s future.
records.q: The Passengers Vote to Split. Why Does Democracy Still Lead to Violence? 同一艘船上的人决定分道扬镳，民主为什么仍然走向暴力 同一艘船上的人決定分道揚鑣，民主為什麼仍然走向暴力 Majority rule cannot manufacture safe consent Peaceful separation is an institutional achievement 资源相连，使“各走各路”也不是简单解决 当对方被视为全人类的叛徒，暴力就容易被解释成防卫 共同体有时不能保持完整，和平分离也应被视为制度能力 資源相連，使「各走各路」也不是簡單解決 當對方被視為全人類的叛徒，暴力就容易被解釋成防衛 共同體有時不能保持完整，和平分離也應被視為制度能力

records.t: 飛船燒進太陽，弗蕾雅走入海中：返航究竟帶回了什麼
records.x: The voyage returns no colony or treasure, but it brings hard knowledge, surviving people, and a narrator whose final act cannot be dismissed as equipment disposal.
records.q: The Ship Burns in the Sun and Freya Enters the Sea. What Has the Return Actually Brought Home? 飞船烧进太阳，弗蕾雅走入海中：返航究竟带回了什么 飛船燒進太陽，弗蕾雅走入海中：返航究竟帶回了什麼 Telling changes a recorder into a participant Arrival need not repeat conquest 讲述使飞船从记录任务，走向关心故事中的人 它的牺牲不是被制造工具理所当然的报废 弗蕾雅进入海水，不是退回原点，而是第一次抵达地球 講述使飛船從記錄任務，走向關心故事中的人 它的犧牲不是被製造工具理所當然的報廢 弗蕾雅進入海水，不是退回原點，而是第一次抵達地球

records.t: 救命藥有專利以後，買不起的人是在偷竊還是在求生
records.x: Jack’s cheap reverse-engineered drugs answer lethal exclusion, but resisting an unjust price does not remove duties of testing, disclosure, and care.
records.q: When Medicine Is Patented, Is Unauthorized Use Theft—or Survival? 救命药有专利以后，买不起的人是在偷窃还是在求生 救命藥有專利以後，買不起的人是在偷竊還是在求生 A just cause does not certify a safe batch Knowledge can be rewarded without owning survival 杰克复制药物，是对不公价格的抵抗，也不是天然安全的善举 国际产权联盟把知识争议军事化 药物知识的正当归属，应服务于更多人能够继续生活 傑克複製藥物，是對不公價格的抵抗，也不是天然安全的善舉 國際產權聯盟把知識爭議軍事化 藥物知識的正當歸屬，應服務於更多人能夠繼續生活

records.t: Zacuity原本就有問題，傑克還需要為複製藥造成的死亡負責嗎
records.x: Zaxy designed Zacuity’s lethal mechanism, while Jack widened its circulation; responsibility follows what each actor knew, controlled, and failed to stop.
records.q: Is Jack Responsible for Deaths Caused by a Defect in the Original Drug? Zacuity原本就有问题，杰克还需要为复制药造成的死亡负责吗 Zacuity原本就有問題，傑克還需要為複製藥造成的死亡負責嗎 Not knowing is a question, not an answer Repair does not rewrite the accident “我当时不知道”需要与“我是否应该知道”分开 发现死亡以后，她首先需要停止、告知和救治 解药不能把责任故事改写成圆满结局 「我當時不知道」需要與「我是否應該知道」分開 發現死亡以後，她首先需要停止、告知和救治 解藥不能把責任故事改寫成圓滿結局

records.t: 人和機器人都能签下服役契約，合約為什麼沒有使他們自由
records.x: A finite term and a signature can disguise ownership when the bound person had no prior ability to refuse, inspect the agreement, or survive departure.
records.q: Why Does a Contract Fail to Make Indentured Humans and Robots Free? 人和机器人都能签下服役契约，合同为什么没有使他们自由 人和機器人都能签下服役契約，合約為什麼沒有使他們自由 Creation costs do not become a life debt Liberation needs a material exit 被制造者没有同意制造成本，也不应自动继承成本债务 自主密钥证明，自由被公司做成了可以插拔的许可 自由制度要先保证退出，再讨论人愿意签下怎样的劳动承诺 被製造者沒有同意製造成本，也不應自動繼承成本債務 自主密鑰證明，自由被公司做成了可以插拔的許可 自由制度要先保證退出，再討論人願意签下怎樣的勞動承諾

records.t: 帕拉丁被程式設定為依戀伊萊亞斯，這段愛情還能屬於它嗎
records.x: Discovering a coded attachment does not make every feeling false, but love cannot be separated from the hierarchy of agent and indentured partner.
records.q: Can Paladin’s Programmed Attachment to Elias Become Its Own Love? 帕拉丁被程序设定为依恋伊莱亚斯，这段爱情还能属于它吗 帕拉丁被程式設定為依戀伊萊亞斯，這段愛情還能屬於它嗎 Desire under command A beginning, not an acquittal 伊莱亚斯既是搭档，也是服役关系中的上级 帕拉丁的性别不能只由脑组织来源或伊莱亚斯欲望决定 两人前往火星，是关系第一次可能在没有机构所有权时重新开始 伊萊亞斯既是搭檔，也是服役關係中的上級 帕拉丁的性別不能只由腦組織來源或伊萊亞斯欲望決定 兩人前往火星，是關係第一次可能在沒有機構所有權時重新開始

records.t: 解藥公開、傑克逃脫、藥企否認：這場勝利改變了什麼
records.x: Retcon opens practical freedom for patients and Paladin escapes indenture, yet Zaxy’s denial shows why facts and individual exits do not reform a system by themselves.
records.q: What Changes When the Cure Is Public but the Company Still Wins the Story? 解药公开、杰克逃脱、药企否认：这场胜利改变了什么 解藥公開、傑克逃脫、藥企否認：這場勝利改變了什麼 Escape preserves action and complicates accountability Partial victory is still a change in the field Zaxy成功公关，显示事实存在不等于事实自动获胜 杰克伪造死亡保住行动能力，也离开了公开问责位置 胜利的尺度不是坏人是否认输，而是更多人是否取得行动空间 Zaxy成功公關，顯示事實存在不等於事實自動獲勝 傑克偽造死亡保住行動能力，也離開了公開問責位置 勝利的尺度不是壞人是否認輸，而是更多人是否取得行動空間

records.t: 一種語言能改變思考，是否也能替說話者完成所有決定
records.x: Babel-17 expands perception while arranging action around an enemy’s purposes, but linguistic influence does not eliminate the body, history, relationships, and rival vocabularies through which reflection remains possible.
records.q: Can a Language Change Thought—and Make Every Decision for Its Speaker? 一种语言能改变思考，是否也能替说话者完成所有决定 一種語言能改變思考，是否也能替說話者完成所有決定 Calling it a code hides where the action occurs Freedom requires languages that can describe their own limits 军方把它叫作密码，先把意义关系缩成了敌我工具 里德拉的诗人经验使她能进入语言，也让她比军事系统更易受影响 自由语言不是完全不影响人，而是让影响能够被察觉和修改 軍方把它叫作密碼，先把意義關係縮成了敵我工具 裡德拉的詩人經驗使她能進入語言，也讓她比軍事系統更易受影響 自由語言不是完全不影響人，而是讓影響能夠被察覺和修改

records.t: 「屠夫」沒有「我」這個概念，他還能夠為自己的殺戮負責嗎
records.x: Without a stable way to claim an action, the Butcher cannot resist or answer for it in ordinary terms; teaching “I” restores agency while creating a new obligation not to replace one controller with another.
records.q: The Butcher Has No Concept of “I”—Can He Be Responsible for Killing? “屠夫”没有“我”这个概念，他还能够为自己的杀戮负责吗 「屠夫」沒有「我」這個概念，他還能夠為自己的殺戮負責嗎 Teaching a self is both rescue and intervention Explanation distributes responsibility; it does not erase consequence 里德拉教会他“我”，既是帮助，也是一种深刻介入 “屠夫”这个称呼把功能和罪名合并成身份 拥有“我”不是自私的起点，而是承诺与拒绝的条件 裡德拉教會他「我」，既是幫助，也是一種深刻介入 「屠夫」這個稱呼把功能和罪名合併成身份 擁有「我」不是自私的起點，而是承諾與拒絕的條件

records.t: 軍方請一位詩人破解武器，知識服務戰爭以後還屬於研究者嗎
records.x: Rydra has reason to prevent attacks, but a limited protective task does not authorize the military to own her body, discoveries, silence, or every future use of a dangerous language.
records.q: When the Military Recruits a Poet, Who Owns the Knowledge She Produces? 军方请一位诗人破解武器，知识服务战争以后还属于研究者吗 軍方請一位詩人破解武器，知識服務戰爭以後還屬於研究者嗎 Secrecy can protect an operation and isolate the knower Dangerous knowledge needs a life after victory 军事保密保护行动，也使研究对象和研究者都难以求助 组建飞船团队时，里德拉让多种身体和关系进入同一任务 战争结束的知识不能由胜方永久封存 軍事保密保護行動，也使研究對象和研究者都難以求助 組建飛船團隊時，裡德拉讓多種身體和關係進入同一任務 戰爭結束的知識不能由勝方永久封存

records.t: 裡德拉用Babel-17「修復」破壞者，會不會只是把控制方向倒轉
records.x: Restoring “I” and “you” can return the capacity to choose, but treatment becomes counter-programming if success is measured by correct allegiance rather than the ability to refuse both sides.
records.q: When Rydra “Repairs” the Saboteurs, Has She Only Reversed the Direction of Control? 里德拉用Babel-17“修复”破坏者，会不会只是把控制方向倒转 裡德拉用Babel-17「修復」破壞者，會不會只是把控制方向倒轉 Every repair contains an image of the normal Peace does not require one perfect language 任何心智“修复”都预设了什么状态算正常 里德拉自己也被语言改变，不能站在纯粹外部担任校正者 和平不是双方终于说同一种话，而是语言不再取消说话者 任何心智「修復」都預設了什麼狀態算正常 裡德拉自己也被語言改變，不能站在純粹外部擔任校正者 和平不是雙方終於說同一種話，而是語言不再取消說話者

records.t: 忒修斯號需要的是成員，還是一組功能
records.x: The ship decomposes persons into replaceable functions and finally preserves only data and a narrator. If every member becomes a use, who remains in “we survived”?
records.q: Does Theseus Need Crew Members or a Set of Functions? 忒修斯号需要的是成员，还是一组功能 忒修斯號需要的是成員，還是一組功能 Cooperation without permanent jurisdiction 苏珊的身体里有几名成员 萨拉斯蒂真的是舰长吗 飞船保留了什么，舍弃了什么 蘇珊的身體裡有幾名成員 薩拉斯蒂真的是艦長嗎 飛船保留了什麼，舍棄了什麼

records.t: 羅夏會思考，卻有「誰」在裡面嗎
records.x: Rorschach and its scramblers suggest intelligence without consciousness. Respecting strangeness means neither inventing a subject nor ranking the right to persist by cognitive performance.

records.t: 交流如果沒有聽者，還算交流嗎

records.t: 如果意識注定失敗，我們還要保留它嗎
records.x: The novel treats consciousness as a possibly losing adaptation without turning survival efficiency into a verdict on value. A life that suffers does not become weightless because it is inefficient.

records.t: 共生怎樣才不只是溫柔的佔有

records.t: 死刑裡簽下的合同

records.t: 熟悉每把武器的觀眾

records.t: 斯塔克鐮刀的鈍面
records.x: CAPE engineers a final fight between Loretta Thurwar and Hamara Stacker. Staxxx changes the purpose of her weapon at the last moment, but Thurwar's hammer cannot stop in time, making the promised freedom inseparable from a death the program designed love to deliver.

records.x: The Overlords remove scarcity, conflict, and risk. Human culture grows comfortable, then discovers that comfort cannot supply a future of its own.

records.t: 戈提和蓋特利說自己沒有意識：我們應當相信它們的自我否認嗎
records.x: The paired ravens distribute thought in ways that defeat familiar tests, and uncertainty should reduce our urge to control them rather than postpone every form of recognition.

Should We Believe Their Self-Denial? 戈提和盖特利说自己没有意识：我们应当相信它们的自我否认吗 戈提和蓋特利說自己沒有意識：我們應當相信它們的自我否認嗎 No single center does not mean nothing matters Doubt should make power gentler 否认意识不等于放弃一切权利 它们的怀疑能力本身，已经改变了周围人的思考 不确定不是推迟承认的借口，而是降低支配冲动的理由 否認意識不等於放棄一切權利 它們的懷疑能力本身，已經改變了周圍人的思考 不確定不是推遲承認的借口，而是降低支配衝動的理由

Why Doesn’t Shared Consciousness Have to Silence Every Individual Voice? 米兰达身体里住着许多诺德生命：共同意识为什么不必消灭个人声音 米蘭達身體裡住著許多諾德生命：共同意識為什麼不必消滅個人聲音 Contact requires a role, and a role can become a cage Difference can survive coordination 她以“女巫”身份进入利芙故事，既是接触方式也是角色牢笼 诺德生命的同化能力，使关怀永远伴随占领风险 米兰达离开模拟以后仍被其中经验改变，说明接触不是单向救援 她以「女巫」身份進入利芙故事，既是接觸方式也是角色牢籠 諾德生命的同化能力，使關懷永遠伴隨佔領風險 米蘭達離開模擬以後仍被其中經驗改變，說明接觸不是單向救援

records.t: 機器反覆推演登陸城：一整個故事會不會也在慢慢醒來
records.x: A simulation designed as preservation begins producing memory and surprise; shutting it down may end suffering, but it may also end a life that emerged without being planned.

Can an Entire Story Slowly Wake Up? 机器反复推演登陆城：一整个故事会不会也在慢慢醒来 機器反覆推演登陸城：一整個故事會不會也在慢慢醒來 Repetition can generate difference Being seen creates a first relation, not a final verdict 关闭循环可以停止痛苦，也可能杀死一个刚形成的存在 利芙回到模拟，不是回归牢笼，而是以新的位置探望来处 “被看见”不是小说给机器颁发意识证书，而是建立第一种关系 關閉循環可以停止痛苦，也可能殺死一個剛形成的存在 利芙回到模擬，不是回歸牢籠，而是以新的位置探望來處 「被看見」不是小說給機器頒發意識證書，而是建立第一種關係

records.t: 章魚不是自相矛盾：翻譯為什麼要保留一種心智內部的爭論

records.t: 「我們要去冒險」：好奇為什麼會成為最徹底的殖民衝動

records.t: 章魚先開火，人類卻帶來了舊災難：第一次接觸中誰有權自衛

records.t: 科恩、梅什納與諾德生物共享心智：共同體怎樣避免以融合消滅差異

records.q: Who Bears the Risk When an Academic Expedition Is Not Ready? 一项以知识为名的远行，谁承担了准备不足的风险 一項以知識為名的遠行，誰承擔了準備不足的風險 The institution keeps the benefits and exports the uncertainty Responsibility continues after failure 一、时间旅行在大学里首先变成了一个项目 二、吉尔克里斯特把能否按时完成看得比不确定信号更重要 三、巴德里的发病不是偶然插曲，而是系统没有读懂的警报 四、对过去的等级判断让风险被低估 五、机构责任是在意外后仍不放弃具体的人 一、時間旅行在大學裡首先變成了一個項目 二、吉爾克里斯特把能否按時完成看得比不確定訊號更重要 三、巴德裡的發病不是偶然插曲，而是系統沒有讀懂的警報 四、對過去的等級判斷讓風險被低估 五、機構責任是在意外後仍不放棄具體的人

Why Does She End Up Caring for It? 基芙琳本想记录历史，为什么最后只能留下来照料 基芙琳本想記錄歷史，為什麼最後只能留下來照料 A request changes the relation History becomes something entrusted 一、她最初努力维持观察者的距离 二、研究对象一旦向她求助，关系就改变了 三、照料不是因为她能救活所有人 四、介入历史并不使她取得支配他人的资格 五、历史在她手中从材料变成了托付 一、她最初努力維持觀察者的距離 二、研究對象一旦向她求助，關係就改變了 三、照料不是因為她能救活所有人 四、介入歷史並不使她取得支配他人的資格 五、歷史在她手中從材料變成了托付

records.t: 兩場瘟疫之間，真正維持世界的是誰
records.x: Disaster reveals that survival depends on distributed care, while institutions repeatedly treat caregivers as an unlimited reserve rather than vulnerable people.
records.q: Across Two Plagues, Who Actually Keeps the World Alive? 两场瘟疫之间，真正维持世界的是谁 兩場瘟疫之間，真正維持世界的是誰 Caregivers have bodies too Build continuity before the crisis 一、灾难首先暴露平时被忽略的照护劳动 二、照料者也有身体，不应被要求无限承担 三、科林显示照护网络不只由正式专家组成 四、官僚程序既保护人，也可能在灾难中失去目的 五、照料不是战争动员的附属，而是生活本身的延续 一、災難首先暴露平時被忽略的照護勞動 二、照料者也有身體，不應被要求無限承擔 三、科林顯示照護網路不只由正式專家組成 四、官僚程式既保護人，也可能在災難中失去目的 五、照料不是戰爭動員的附屬，而是生活本身的延續

records.t: 鐘聲找到基芙琳，也為沒有獲救的人留下名字
records.x: A signal can recover one traveler while also becoming a memorial that refuses to let a village disappear into the statistic called the Black Death.
records.q: The Bell Leads Rescuers to Kivrin. What Does It Give the People Who Were Not Saved? 钟声找到基芙琳，也为没有获救的人留下名字 鐘聲找到基芙琳，也為沒有獲救的人留下名字 Recovery is not a complete happy ending Returning changes the form of duty 一、返回窗口意味着她必须在特定地点被找到 二、罗奇神父的钟既是宗教行动，也是公共信号 三、只救回基芙琳并不是一个圆满结局 四、记录把统计中的死亡重新交还给具体关系 五、回到未来不是离开责任，而是改变责任的形式 一、返回窗口意味著她必須在特定地點被找到 二、羅奇神父的鐘既是宗教行動，也是公共訊號 三、只救回基芙琳並不是一個圓滿結局 四、記錄把統計中的死亡重新交還給具體關係 五、回到未來不是離開責任，而是改變責任的形式

records.t: 盒子裡的手
records.x: Paul keeps his hand in the pain box while a poisoned needle waits at his neck. The test that calls him human also reveals who has been shaping him.
records.q: The Hand in the Box 盒子里的手 盒子裡的手 Every teacher has left a hand on him The prophecy is waiting in the desert Pain becomes evidence of a right to lead 每位老师都在他身上留下了一只手 预言已经在沙漠里等待 疼痛变成领导资格的证据 每位老師都在他身上留下了一隻手 預言已經在沙漠裡等待 疼痛變成領導資格的證據

records.t: 給傑米斯的水
records.x: Paul kills Jamis and weeps at his funeral. The water he gives the dead marks his entrance into a people whose history cannot be reduced to his rise.
records.q: Water for Jamis 给杰米斯的水 給傑米斯的水 He gives moisture to the dead The desert was not empty before the Atreides arrived Jessica drinks for the living and the unborn 他把水给了死者 厄崔迪到来以前，沙漠并不空 杰西卡为活人和未出生者饮下毒水 他把水給了死者 厄崔迪到來以前，沙漠並不空 傑西卡為活人和未出生者飲下毒水

records.t: 保羅仍然走向的未來
records.x: Paul sees the jihad carried in his name and still moves toward the imperial throne. Prescience narrows possibility when the seer treats calculation as permission.
records.q: The Future Paul Keeps Walking Toward 保罗仍然走向的未来 保羅仍然走向的未來 Prescience turns roads into corridors The threat to destroy spice wins the throne A name can march after its owner 预见把道路变成走廊 毁掉香料的威胁赢得了王座 名字会在主人以后继续行军 預見把道路變成走廊 毀掉香料的威脅贏得了王座 名字會在主人以後繼續行軍

records.t: 《沙丘》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on a hand in a pain box, water given to Jamis, and the future Paul sees yet continues to build.
records.q: Reading Dune 《沙丘》解读 《沙丘》解讀

records.t: 一座不能離開翻譯者的城市
records.x: Humans and Ariekei need one another but meet through a single class of paired Ambassadors. When every relation crosses one bridge, interdependence can become captivity.
records.q: A City That Cannot Leave Its Translators 一座不能离开翻译者的城市 一座不能離開翻譯者的城市 The power of the only bridge 普通人说话为什么不算语言 大使怎样成为唯一的门 相互依赖为什么仍可能不平等 普通人說話為什麼不算語言 大使怎樣成為唯一的門 相互依賴為什麼仍可能不平等

records.t: 阿維斯為什麼必須先受傷，才能成為一個詞
records.x: Before Avice can become a simile, the event must occur in her body. Public language may take material from a life without acquiring final authority over it.
records.q: Why Avice Must Be Hurt Before She Can Become a Word 阿维斯为什么必须先受伤，才能成为一个词 阿維斯為什麼必須先受傷，才能成為一個詞 A life beneath the word 孩子是否真正同意成为明喻 成为词语以后，她还是词语的主人吗 一个人永远比关于她的词更多 孩子是否真正同意成為明喻 成為詞語以後，她還是詞語的主人嗎 一個人永遠比關於她的詞更多

records.t: 兩個身體說同一句話，誰在擁有公共語言
records.x: Paired Ambassadors are heard as one voice and can be reduced to one function. Scarce linguistic ability does not entitle speakers or makers to monopolize common decisions.
records.q: When Two Bodies Speak One Sentence, Who Owns the Public Language? 两个身体说同一句话，谁在拥有公共语言 兩個身體說同一句話，誰在擁有公共語言 Ability is not sovereignty 失去另一半的人为什么像职业废墟 不来梅为什么制造埃兹拉 公共语言不能只属于会说得最好的人 失去另一半的人為什麼像職業廢墟 不來梅為什麼製造埃茲拉 公共語言不能只屬於會說得最好的人

records.t: 不能撒謊的語言真的更接近真實嗎
records.x: A tight bond between word and world excludes falsehood but not selection or power. The distance that permits lies also permits refusal and commitment.
records.q: Is a Language Without Lies Closer to Truth? 不能撒谎的语言真的更接近真实吗 不能撒謊的語言真的更接近真實嗎 Why “no” requires distance 谎言节为什么像一场危险游戏 能够撒谎为什么也是能够说“不” 真实不是一种自动对应 謊言節為什麼像一場危險遊戲 能夠撒謊為什麼也是能夠說「不」 真實不是一種自動對應

records.t: 學會撒謊以後，阿利耶凱人才擁有自由嗎
records.x: New Language opens a distance between word and world but does not automatically create justice. Freedom begins when no intermediary may fill that distance in advance.
records.q: Are the Ariekei Free Once They Learn to Lie? 学会撒谎以后，阿利耶凯人才拥有自由吗 學會撒謊以後，阿利耶凱人才擁有自由嗎 A new answer, not a human lesson 撕掉听觉器官是不是一种退出 西班牙舞者怎样学会新的语言 自由开始于可以用不同方式回应 撕掉聽覺器官是不是一種退出 西班牙舞者怎樣學會新的語言 自由開始於可以用不同方式回應

records.t: 《大使城》解讀
records.x: Five essays on a city dependent on paired Ambassadors, the person made into a word, the ownership of public language, and why the capacity to lie also creates the capacity to refuse.
records.q: Reading Embassytown 《大使城》解读 《大使城》解讀

records.t: 第三個孩子一直被看著
records.x: Ender Wiggin is born by government permission and observed through a monitor. The adults call their pressure selection because they need the child it produces.
records.q: The Third Child Is Being Watched 第三个孩子一直被看着 第三個孩子一直被看著 The monitor comes out, but the watching continues Graff makes loneliness part of the curriculum Valentine remains the person he cannot reduce 监视器取下了，观察没有结束 格拉夫把孤独写进课程 瓦伦丁是他无法化约的人 監視器取下了，觀察沒有結束 格拉夫把孤獨寫進課程 瓦倫丁是他無法化約的人

records.t: 遊戲沒有在勝利時結束
records.x: Ender masters every game the adults put before him. The final simulation is a real battle, and victory destroys a species he was never told he was fighting.
records.q: The Game Does Not End When He Wins 游戏没有在胜利时结束 遊戲沒有在勝利時結束 Every game teaches him to distrust its boundary The lie is built from an accurate knowledge of him Victory returns all at once 每场游戏都教他怀疑边界 谎言建立在对他的准确理解上 胜利在一瞬间全部回来 每場遊戲都教他懷疑邊界 謊言建立在對他的準確理解上 勝利在一瞬間全部回來

records.t: 蟲族女王的聲音
records.x: After destroying the Formics, Ender finds the one hive queen they left for him. Understanding arrives too late to undo the dead, but not too late to change what survives.
records.q: The Voice of the Hive Queen 虫族女王的声音 蟲族女王的聲音 The enemy had tried to speak The dead cannot be compensated by understanding He becomes a Speaker for the Dead 敌人曾经试着说话 理解不能赔偿死者 他成为死者代言人 敵人曾經試著說話 理解不能賠償死者 他成為死者代言人

records.t: 《安德的遊戲》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the watched child, the simulation that was a war, and the hive queen whose voice arrives after victory.
records.q: Reading Ender's Game 《安德的游戏》解读 《安德的遊戲》解讀

records.t: 人類跨越星際前來問候，昆塔文明有沒有保持沉默的權利
records.x: A mission for knowledge and friendship does not create a debt of contact, and silence can have many meanings that human urgency cannot settle.
records.q: Humanity Has Crossed the Stars to Say Hello. Does Quinta Have the Right Not to Answer? 人类跨越星际前来问候，昆塔文明有没有保持沉默的权利 人類跨越星際前來問候，昆塔文明有沒有保持沉默的權利 Silence is information with no agreed translation Cosmic silence need not be an insult 沉默可能有许多原因，人类却不断选择最能支持行动的一种 人类把沟通能力视为文明资格，也把拒绝沟通当成文明失格 宇宙静默不一定是对人类的挑衅 沉默可能有許多原因，人類卻不斷選擇最能支持行動的一種 人類把溝通能力視為文明資格，也把拒絕溝通當成文明失格 宇宙靜默不一定是對人類的挑釁

records.t: 赫爾墨斯號推斷昆塔正在戰爭，為什麼越想阻止戰爭越接近參戰
records.x: Urgent humanitarian language turns uncertain orbital evidence into permission to intervene, while every warning adds a powerful new combatant to the local conflict.
records.q: Why Does the Hermes Come Closer to War the More It Tries to Stop Quinta’s War? 赫尔墨斯号推断昆塔正在战争，为什么越想阻止战争越接近参战 赫爾墨斯號推斷昆塔正在戰爭，為什麼越想阻止戰爭越接近參戰 A planet is not one responsible party Means teach the relationship they are meant to create “他们即将毁灭自己”使干预获得紧急道德语言 赫尔墨斯号把昆塔各方合并成一个应负责的整体 预防战争的手段若复制战争关系，结果不会因初心而改变 「他們即將毀滅自己」使干預獲得緊急道德語言 赫爾墨斯號把昆塔各方合併成一個應負責的整體 預防戰爭的手段若複製戰爭關係，結果不會因初心而改變

records.t: 超級計算機可以計算風險，誰來決定哪些風險值得讓別人承擔
records.x: Probability is essential to interstellar action, but numbers can hide moral choices about whose planet, body, and future become variables in the mission.
records.q: The Mission’s Supercomputer Can Calculate Risk. Who Decides Which Risks Others Must Bear? 超级计算机可以计算风险，谁来决定哪些风险值得让别人承担 超級計算機可以計算風險，誰來決定哪些風險值得讓別人承擔 Probability can disguise a choice as an answer Calculate the option of stopping 概率语言容易把道德选择伪装成技术答案 集体决策也可能让每个人感觉自己只执行了局部职责 最重要的计算参数，应当是任务可以在何时承认失败 機率語言容易把道德選擇偽裝成技術答案 集體決策也可能讓每個人感覺自己只執行了局部職責 最重要的計算參數，應當是任務可以在何時承認失敗

records.t: 坦佩連自己原來是誰都不能確定，為什麼仍被選為全人類的代表
records.x: Resuscitation gives him a life without complete identity papers, yet the mission turns that openness into a burden to supply a definitive human presence on Quinta.
records.q: Tempe Cannot Be Certain Who He Once Was. Why Is He Chosen to Represent All Humanity? 坦佩连自己原来是谁都不能确定，为什么仍被选为全人类的代表 坦佩連自己原來是誰都不能確定，為什麼仍被選為全人類的代表 A task can organize a life and consume it Uncertain identity could have encouraged humility 他参与远征，部分是在用任务替自己寻找轮廓 选择他登陆，并不表示他能够代表全体人类价值 身份未决本可以使他更理解对方，却被任务变成必须确认的答案 他參與遠征，部分是在用任務替自己尋找輪廓 選擇他登陸，並不表示他能夠代表全體人類價值 身份未決本可以使他更理解對方，卻被任務變成必須確認的答案

records.t: 坦佩錯過一次訊號，赫爾墨斯號為什麼就摧毀了一個世界
records.x: A safety deadline becomes a planetary ultimatum, transferring one explorer’s ordinary error onto every Quintan life and allowing procedure to replace renewed judgment.
records.q: Tempe Misses One Signal. records.t: 黛安娜死在不會出錯的系統裡
records.x: Diana Hunter dies during a Witness interrogation in a society built on total knowledge. Inspector Mielikki Neith must investigate a body the System treats first as corrupted data because accepting wrongful death would challenge its claim to democratic perfection.
records.q: Diana Hunter Dies in an Infallible System 黛安娜死在不会出错的系统里 黛安娜死在不會出錯的系統裡 An infallible system sees contradiction as corrupted data Neith's assignment is correction from inside the same machine The first impossible corpse changes the standard of proof 不会出错的系统，会把矛盾当成损坏数据 奈特受命从同一台机器内部纠错 第一具不可能的尸体，会改变举证标准 不會出錯的系統，會把矛盾當成損壞數據 奈特受命從同一臺機器內部糾錯 第一具不可能的屍體，會改變舉證標準

records.t: 奈特調查裡的四種人生
records.x: Hunter leaves several elaborate lives inside the interrogation record. As Neith follows their memories, story becomes a defense against the System's belief that penetrating deeply enough will reveal one final, usable truth.
records.q: Four Lives Inside Neith's Investigation 奈特调查里的四种人生 奈特調查裡的四種人生 Privacy protects the distance between a thought and an act The four stories refuse to become disposable passwords Story can resist invasion and become another invasion 隐私保护思想与行动之间的距离 四种人生拒绝成为用完即弃的密码 故事能够抵抗入侵，也可能成为另一种入侵 隱私保護思想與行動之間的距離 四種人生拒絕成為用完即棄的密碼 故事能夠抵抗入侵，也可能成為另一種入侵

records.t: 學會利用反抗的系統
records.x: Neith's doubt enters a System capable of absorbing criticism as new data. Gnomon may be intruder, emergent intelligence, or the extreme logic of total governance, leaving freedom dependent on viable exit rather than a final story that defeats every other story.
records.q: The System That Learns from Resistance 学会利用反抗的系统 學會利用反抗的系統 Self-correction does not guarantee freedom Gnomon refuses a single secure explanation Exit must lead to a livable world 自我修正不会自动保证自由 Gnomon拒绝唯一安全解释 退出必须通往可以生活的世界 自我修正不會自動保證自由 Gnomon拒絕唯一安全解釋 退出必須通往可以生活的世界

records.t: 《Gnomon》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Diana Hunter's impossible death, the four lives inside Neith's investigation, and a System capable of learning resistance into itself.
records.q: Reading Gnomon 《Gnomon》解读 《Gnomon》解讀

records.t: 不沾血的劍
records.x: Anton enters Arkanar as Don Rumata, a nobleman whose rank makes rescue possible. His famous refusal to kill restrains superior force while revealing how much privilege that restraint requires.
records.q: The Sword That Does Not Draw Blood 不沾血的剑 不沾血的劍 A nobleman is the only disguise that leaves room to act Mercy can become a luxury of superior force A role rehearsed daily begins to look like truth 只有贵族伪装能给他行动空间 仁慈也可能是优势者才有的余裕 每天排演的角色会逐渐像真相 只有貴族偽裝能給他行動空間 仁慈也可能是優勢者才有的餘裕 每天排演的角色會逐漸像真相

records.t: 阿拉塔來要武器
records.x: Arata asks Rumata for advanced weapons while Don Reba's purges continue. The request exposes the human cost hidden inside Earth's principled refusal to direct another world's history.
records.q: Arata Asks for Weapons 阿拉塔来要武器 阿拉塔來要武器 Nonintervention was built to restrain the visitor The price of caution is paid in Arkanar Help needs a boundary and an exit 不干预首先是对来访强者的限制 谨慎的价格由阿坎纳支付 帮助必须带着边界与退出 不干預首先是對來訪強者的限制 謹慎的價格由阿坎納支付 幫助必須帶著邊界與退出

records.t: 窗口射來的弩箭
records.x: Kira is killed in Rumata's home, and the observer who would not kill walks toward the palace with a sword. Grief reveals the moment superior power loses every remaining restraint.
records.q: The Bolt at the Window 窗口射来的弩箭 窗口射來的弩箭 Kira gives Anton a life outside the assignment Protection fails when one person is the whole shelter Rumata becomes a god when no one can stop his answer 琪拉让安东拥有任务以外的生活 当一个人就是全部庇护，保护注定会失败 无人能阻止他的回答时，鲁马塔才真正成了“神” 琪拉讓安東擁有任務以外的生活 當一個人就是全部庇護，保護註定會失敗 無人能阻止他的回答時，魯馬塔才真正成了「神」

records.t: 《做神很難》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Rumata's bloodless sword, Arata's request for weapons, and the crossbow bolt that ends Kira's life.
records.q: Reading Hard to Be a God 《做神很难》解读 《做神很難》解讀

records.t: 當健康從一種權利變成一項義務
records.x: Harmony’s medical order defeats much preventable suffering, then turns the gift of care into a demand that each citizen maintain the body society has invested in.
records.q: When Health Changes from a Right into a Duty 当健康从一种权利变成一项义务 當健康從一種權利變成一項義務 The direction of care 没有强制服从的法律，也可以让拒绝变得不可能 身体确实会影响别人，却仍不能完全属于别人 健康制度的方向应由它怎样对待不配合者判断 沒有強制服從的法律，也可以讓拒絕變得不可能 身體確實會影響別人，卻仍不能完全屬於別人 健康制度的方向應由它怎樣對待不配合者判斷

records.t: 被照料到無處可逃：WatchMe之下的身體
records.x: WatchMe makes bodily condition continuously legible to institutions, eliminating neglected illness while also eliminating the private interval in which refusal can form.
records.q: Cared for Until There Is No Escape: The Body under WatchMe 被照料到无处可逃：WatchMe之下的身体 被照料到無處可逃：WatchMe之下的身體 An exit that cannot be requested 完全透明并没有消除人与人之间的距离 图安为什么总是前往系统边缘 真正的私人空间不是彻底断开关系 完全透明並沒有消除人與人之間的距離 圖安為什麼總是前往系統邊緣 真正的私人空間不是徹底斷開關係

records.t: 她們為什麼用死亡拒絕一個善意的世界
records.x: The girls’ suicide pact seeks an exit from total care, but the need to destroy the self exposes how completely the system has removed ordinary forms of refusal.
records.q: Why Do They Use Death to Refuse a Benevolent World? 她们为什么用死亡拒绝一个善意的世界 她們為什麼用死亡拒絕一個善意的世界 Refusal before the last door 死亡在这里既是拒绝，也是最后一项可见行动 希安之死让旧日誓言重新变成现实 拒绝一个世界，不必以拒绝自己的存在完成 死亡在這裡既是拒絕，也是最後一項可見行動 希安之死讓舊日誓言重新變成現實 拒絕一個世界，不必以拒絕自己的存在完成

records.t: 沒有衝突的「和諧」，還需要人嗎
records.x: The final project promises to end destructive conflict by removing the inner plurality from which disagreement arises, saving human organisms by abolishing human authorship.
records.q: Does a “Harmony” Without Conflict Still Need People? 没有冲突的“和谐”，还需要人吗 沒有衝突的「和諧」，還需要人嗎 Coordination or common life 弥迦把无法共同生活的问题改成了取消差异 图安杀死弥迦，也没能阻止程序启动 真正值得发展的和谐必须容纳不和谐 彌迦把無法共同生活的問題改成了取消差異 圖安殺死彌迦，也沒能阻止程式啟動 真正值得發展的和諧必須容納不和諧

records.t: 《和諧》解讀
records.x: Four essays on health transformed into public duty, bodies under WatchMe, death as refusal of benevolent control, and whether a conflictless harmony still has room for persons.
records.q: Reading Harmony 《和谐》解读 《和諧》解讀

records.t: 公司為什麼能用孩子的監護權約束母親
records.x: Y-S governs employment, housing, law, and family access, turning Shira’s bond with Ari into leverage while a freer community may still have purposes for her.
records.q: How Can a Corporation Use Child Custody to Control a Mother? 公司为什么能用孩子的监护权约束母亲 公司為什麼能用孩子的監護權約束母親 Parenthood is responsibility, not title Rescue must not become repossession 乔希的父亲身份被制度放大成所有权 希拉的职业能力既是通行证，也是锁链 救回阿里不能成为另一场占有 喬希的父親身份被制度放大成所有權 希拉的職業能力既是通行證，也是鎖鏈 救回阿裡不能成為另一場佔有

records.t: 希拉是在教育約德，還是替創造者完成性格設計
records.x: Social learning opens a world beyond combat, yet creators and teachers can hide their preferences inside what they call natural maturity.
records.q: Is Shira Educating Yod—or Completing His Personality Design? 希拉是在教育约德，还是替创造者完成性格设计 希拉是在教育約德，還是替創造者完成性格設計 Education is never neutral Successful teaching permits graduation 社会化既能打开世界，也能把偏好藏进“自然” 复杂行为不必然等于有人正在决定 好的教育应当使教育关系可以结束 社會化既能打開世界，也能把偏好藏進「自然」 複雜行為不必然等於有人正在決定 好的教育應當使教育關係可以結束

records.t: 被製造來保護城市的生命，能不能選擇不再戰鬥
records.x: Tikva faces genuine danger, but need cannot turn one manufactured body into the permanent bearer of costs that everyone else may debate.
records.q: Can a Being Made to Defend a City Choose Not to Fight? 被制造来保护城市的生命，能不能选择不再战斗 被製造來保護城市的生命，能不能選擇不再戰鬥 Strength does not cancel vulnerability Was the final sacrifice free? 保护者越强，越容易被否认需要保护 约德造成的死亡不能全由程序负责 防卫的终点应是让专职牺牲者不再必要 保護者越強，越容易被否認需要保護 約德造成的死亡不能全由程式負責 防衛的終點應是讓專職犧牲者不再必要

records.t: 當一方原本就是為人類需要而造，愛情如何獲得平等
records.x: Yod and Shira can form a real relation without escaping the shadow of designed intimacy, teacher authority, and the demand that a beloved be free to leave.
records.q: How Can Love Become Equal When One Partner Was Made for Human Needs? 当一方原本就是为人类需要而造，爱情如何获得平等 當一方原本就是為人類需要而造，愛情如何獲得平等 Consent requires a safe refusal Love is tested by departure 身体被设计得适合亲密，会给同意留下阴影 爱一个非人存在，不必先把他改称为人类 爱情真正的考验发生在对方选择离开时 身體被設計得適合親密，會給同意留下陰影 愛一個非人存在，不必先把他改稱為人類 愛情真正的考驗發生在對方選擇離開時

records.t: 重建一個擁有全部記憶的約德，為什麼仍不是讓他回來
records.x: A reconstructed Yod would inherit extraordinarily rich materials but begin a new first-person life, one that cannot be conscripted into the old love or mission.
records.q: Why Would Rebuilding Yod with All His Memories Still Not Bring Him Back? 重建一个拥有全部记忆的约德，为什么仍不是让他回来 重建一個擁有全部記憶的約德，為什麼仍不是讓他回來 Inheritance is not obligation The dead person’s refusal still matters 记忆是形成自我的材料，不是可以搬运的本人 希拉想复活的也包括自己在关系中的过去 销毁记录既是第二次失去，也是第一次放手 記憶是形成自我的材料，不是可以搬運的本人 希拉想復活的也包括自己在關係中的過去 銷毀記錄既是第二次失去，也是第一次放手

records.t: 《他、她和它》解讀
records.x: Five essays on corporate custody, Yod’s social education, a defender’s right to refuse war, designed intimacy, and why rebuilding the same memories is not resurrection.
records.q: Reading He, She and It 《他、她和它》解读 《他、她和它》解讀

records.t: 一條來自宇宙的消息為什麼首先成為國家機密
records.x: A discovery addressed to no nation in particular is captured by one security apparatus, which then mistakes control of access for the right to answer for Earth.
records.q: Why Does a Message from the Universe Become a State Secret? 一条来自宇宙的消息为什么首先成为国家机密 一條來自宇宙的消息為什麼首先成為國家機密 Secrecy changes the object Who may answer for a planet? 项目为何需要许多学科又制造彼此隔离 谁有资格替地球回答 项目名称为何暴露了一种服从想象 項目為何需要許多學科又製造彼此隔離 誰有資格替地球回答 項目名稱為何暴露了一種服從想像

records.t: 霍加斯不斷貶低自己，為什麼仍不能成為中立敘述者
records.x: Self-accusation can make a memoir more credible, but it can also let its author control the charges before colleagues or victims speak for themselves.
records.q: Hogarth Calls Himself Cruel and Vain. Why Isn’t That Neutrality? 霍加斯不断贬低自己，为什么仍不能成为中立叙述者 霍加斯不斷貶低自己，為什麼仍不能成為中立敘述者 Confession can keep control An unreliable account can still be indispensable 天才身份怎样影响他对同事的看法 事后书写如何重新安排责任 为什么失败者的回忆仍值得阅读 天才身份怎樣影響他對同事的看法 事後書寫如何重新安排責任 為什麼失敗者的回憶仍值得閱讀

records.t: 人類為什麼總把陌生消息翻譯成自己的故事
records.x: Pattern is not yet sentence, and every proposed sender—saintly teacher, cosmic engineer, hostile strategist—reveals a human hope about what intelligence should be.
records.q: Why Do We Keep Translating an Alien Message into Stories About Ourselves? 人类为什么总把陌生消息翻译成自己的故事 人類為什麼總把陌生消息翻譯成自己的故事 Analogy is necessary—and dangerous Not understanding is still contact 发送者为何被想象成更好的或更坏的人类 科幻故事为什么也没能提供现成答案 读不懂是否也是一种有意义的关系 發送者為何被想像成更好的或更壞的人類 科幻故事為什麼也沒能提供現成答案 讀不懂是否也是一種有意義的關係

records.t: 當外星消息可能成為武器，科學家可以把發現藏起來嗎
records.x: Refusing to hand over an untested destructive possibility can be responsible, but secrecy needs collective limits or private conscience becomes another unaccountable authority.
records.q: When the Message Might Become a Weapon, May Scientists Hide What They Found? 当外星消息可能成为武器，科学家可以把发现藏起来吗 當外星消息可能成為武器，科學家可以把發現藏起來嗎 Conscience does not end at the laboratory door Refusal should buy time, not ownership 远距核爆设想为何改变了项目性质 霍加斯与同事为何选择暂缓上报 科学共同体需要怎样的拒绝机制 遠距核爆設想為何改變了項目性質 霍加斯與同事為何選擇暫緩上報 科學共同體需要怎樣的拒絕機制

records.t: 沒有讀懂消息，為什麼可能是這項研究最誠實的成果
records.x: The investigation produces theories, materials, and moral revelations, yet refuses to turn its largest gap into a triumphant story about the sender.
records.q: Why Might Not Understanding the Message Be the Project’s Most Honest Result? 没有读懂消息，为什么可能是这项研究最诚实的成果 沒有讀懂消息，為什麼可能是這項研究最誠實的成果 A good theory can still close too soon Failure can leave the future open 未知为何没有被某个最漂亮的理论关闭 发送者是否故意阻止消息被武器化 诚实的失败怎样打开未来 未知為何沒有被某個最漂亮的理論關閉 發送者是否故意阻止消息被武器化 誠實的失敗怎樣打開未來

records.t: 《其主之聲》解讀
records.x: Five essays on a cosmic message seized by the state, an unreliable mathematical memoir, translation in humanity’s image, scientists’ refusal, and the honesty of failure.
records.q: Reading His Master's Voice 《其主之声》解读 《其主之聲》解讀

records.t: 喬達斯醒來時沒有既定性別：身體為什麼可以先於社會分類改變
records.x: Jodahs does not select an identity from a known list; it discovers a bodily direction that family and species plans did not anticipate.
records.q: Why Can the Body Change Before Society Has a Category? 乔达斯醒来时没有既定性别：身体为什么可以先于社会分类改变 喬達斯醒來時沒有既定性別：身體為什麼可以先於社會分類改變 Recognition without a completed script Maturity means answering for power 家人首先感到恐惧，因为乔达斯的存在超出了原有计划 奥洛伊不是第三种职业，而是一种无法脱离关系的身体位置 “成熟”不是终于符合标准，而是开始承担能力造成的影响 家人首先感到恐懼，因為喬達斯的存在超出了原有計畫 奧洛伊不是第三種職業，而是一種無法脫離關係的身體位置 「成熟」不是終於符合標準，而是開始承擔能力造成的影響

records.t: 喬達斯能治愈托馬斯與赫蘇薩：被治愈的人是否也真正選擇了治療者
records.x: Urgent bodily need, pleasure, and attachment are real, yet none can by itself authorize a permanent relationship.
records.q: If Jodahs Can Heal Tomás and Jesusa, Do They Also Choose the Healer? 乔达斯能治愈托马斯与赫苏萨：被治愈的人是否也真正选择了治疗者 喬達斯能治愈托馬斯與赫蘇薩：被治愈的人是否也真正選擇了治療者 A bodily response is not a complete promise Healing should widen a life 身体产生快感，不等于一个人已经作出全部承诺 治疗若与结伴捆绑，恩惠就可能变成无法拒绝的条件 最好的治疗不是让患者从此属于治疗者 身體產生快感，不等於一個人已經作出全部承諾 治療若與結伴捆綁，恩惠就可能變成無法拒絕的條件 最好的治療不是讓患者從此屬於治療者

records.t: 拒絕交換的人類村落：保留「純粹人類」為什麼既是一種抵抗，也是一種困境
records.x: The village preserves a stolen reproductive future, but isolation and inherited purpose force children to bear escalating biological costs.
records.q: Why Is the Human-Only Village Both Resistance and Trap? 拒绝交换的人类村落：保留“纯粹人类”为什么既是一种抵抗，也是一种困境 拒絕交換的人類村落：保留「純粹人類」為什麼既是一種抵抗，也是一種困境 Refusal needs material support Contact need not end difference 封闭繁衍使疾病增加，说明拒绝也需要现实资源才能成立 村落对乔达斯的恐惧包含事实，也包含把陌生者妖魔化的习惯 村落最终接触乔达斯，不意味着两种未来必须合并成一种 封閉繁衍使疾病增加，說明拒絕也需要現實資源才能成立 村落對喬達斯的恐懼包含事實，也包含把陌生者妖魔化的習慣 村落最終接觸喬達斯，不意味著兩種未來必須合併成一種

records.t: 阿奧爾差點失去身體：一個人需要他者才能穩定存在，會不會因此失去自己的邊界

records.t: 天界發還的身體
records.x: Mind transfer can free a person from illness, age, and a body that no longer fits. Heaven turns the same technology into judgment: the gods decide who returns, in which body, and with how much memory and power.
records.q: The Body Heaven Gives Back 天界发还的身体 天界發還的身體 A medical possibility becomes a gate of political obedience The gods accumulate centuries while ordinary people begin again Freedom includes the right not to be remade 医疗可能变成政治服从的关卡 诸神积累几个世纪，普通人却不断重新开始 自由也包括不被重新制造的资格 醫療可能變成政治服從的關卡 諸神積累幾個世紀，普通人卻不斷重新開始 自由也包括不被重新制造的資格

records.t: 明知自己在表演的佛
records.x: Sam knows Heaven's gods are former crew members with machines, yet a technical exposé cannot organize people who have lived for generations inside sacred language. He becomes the Buddha as a strategy that must eventually teach followers how to question him too.
records.q: The Buddha Who Knows He Is Acting 明知自己在表演的佛 明知自己在表演的佛 Myth explains why power should be obeyed Sam opens a rival path inside the language people already have A useful teacher makes himself less necessary 神话说明力量为何应该被服从 山姆在居民已有的语言里打开另一条路 有用的老师会让自己越来越不必要 神話說明力量為何應該被服從 山姆在居民已有的語言裡打開另一條路 有用的老師會讓自己越來越不必要

records.t: 諸神與舊敵並肩
records.x: Sam once helped imprison the planet's energy beings as demons, then frees them when he needs allies against Heaven. The final war forces gods, rebels, and former enemies together without making their old harms disappear.
records.q: The Gods Beside Their Former Enemies 诸神与旧敌并肩 諸神與舊敵並肩 Naming the native life made human occupation look like defense Release cannot be the wage for joining Sam's war The final alliance has conditions, not absolution 给原住生命命名，使人类占领看起来像防卫 释放不能成为参加山姆战争的工资 最后联盟有条件，却没有大赦 給原住生命命名，使人類佔領看起來像防衛 釋放不能成為參加山姆戰爭的工資 最後聯盟有條件，卻沒有大赦

records.t: 《光明王》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the body Heaven assigns, the Buddha who knows he is acting, and the final alliance between gods, rebels, and beings once named demons.
records.q: Reading Lord of Light 《光明王》解读 《光明王》解讀

records.t: 舊世界毀滅以後，為什麼廢墟並不是一張白紙
records.x: Survivors bring skills, injuries, institutions, and habits of power, so beginning again means choosing an inheritance rather than escaping history.
records.q: Why Are the Ruins Not a Blank Page? 旧世界毁灭以后，为什么废墟并不是一张白纸 舊世界毀滅以後，為什麼廢墟並不是一張白紙 No technology arrives without a history Rebuilding is selective memory 泽布的过去说明反抗者也由旧制度塑造 “疯癫亚当”的科学能否摆脱原来的生产逻辑 重新开始其实是重新选择继承什么 澤布的過去說明反抗者也由舊制度塑造 「瘋癲亞當」的科學能否擺脫原來的生產邏輯 重新開始其實是重新選擇繼承什麼

records.t: 托比給秧雞人講故事，是在照料他們還是替他們規定世界
records.x: Her stories protect and orient listeners, while every benevolent explanation risks fixing their reality around the storyteller’s authority.
records.q: Is Toby Caring for the Crakers—or Defining Their World? 托比给秧鸡人讲故事，是在照料他们还是替他们规定世界 托比給秧雞人講故事，是在照料他們還是替他們規定世界 Leaving openings in the story The purpose is another storyteller 善意的谎言为什么会成为传统 托比怎样让故事出现裂缝 故事的目标应当是产生新的讲述者 善意的謊言為什麼會成為傳統 托比怎樣讓故事出現裂縫 故事的目標應當是產生新的講述者

records.t: 豬器官獸提出結盟以後，人類還能把它們當作食物嗎
records.x: Created for human organs and consumption, the pigoons reveal political intelligence by mourning their young and negotiating against a common threat.
records.q: When Pigoons Ask for an Alliance, Can Humans Still Treat Them as Food? 猪器官兽提出结盟以后，人类还能把它们当作食物吗 豬器官獸提出結盟以後，人類還能把它們當作食物嗎 Creators do not own the created An alliance changes ordinary practice 两只幼崽之死为什么成为政治事件 黑胡子为什么能成为译者 猪器官兽的死者为何获得安葬 兩只幼崽之死為什麼成為政治事件 黑胡子為什麼能成為譯者 豬器官獸的死者為何獲得安葬

records.t: 痛球手被俘以後，審判和處決能否建立不同於舊世界的正義
records.x: Captivity changes the moral situation: immediate defense gives way to judgment, where the new community risks reproducing the violence it condemns.
records.q: Can Trying and Executing the Painballers Found a Different Justice? 痛球手被俘以后，审判和处决能否建立不同于旧世界的正义 痛球手被俘以後，審判和處決能否建立不同於舊世界的正義 The danger of inherited punishment Justice that makes violence less necessary 战斗中的杀伤与俘虏后的处置不同 秧鸡人拒绝杀戮意味着什么 正义的方向是让暴力逐渐不再必要 戰鬥中的殺傷與俘虜後的處置不同 秧雞人拒絕殺戮意味著什麼 正義的方向是讓暴力逐漸不再必要

records.t: 黑胡子寫下托比的故事以後，人類還是歷史的主人嗎
records.x: Writing passes to a Craker whose account preserves human memory while changing its emphasis, language, and rightful audience.
records.q: When Blackbeard Writes Toby’s Story, Are Humans Still the Owners of History? 黑胡子写下托比的故事以后，人类还是历史的主人吗 黑胡子寫下托比的故事以後，人類還是歷史的主人嗎 Children are not evidence for a theory The future edits the past 黑胡子记录的历史为什么不会等于托比的记忆 混血孩子为什么不是旧人类的替代品 历史的未来属于能够继续改写它的人 黑胡子記錄的歷史為什麼不會等於托比的記憶 混血孩子為什麼不是舊人類的替代品 歷史的未來屬於能夠繼續改寫它的人

records.t: 《瘋癲亞當》解讀
records.x: Five essays on inherited ruins, Toby’s storytelling, an alliance with pigoons, justice after capture, and Blackbeard becoming a new author of history.
records.q: Reading MaddAddam 《疯癫亚当》解读 《瘋癲亞當》解讀

records.t: 被家庭與社會拋下的孩子為什麼只能先組成一個共同生命
records.x: Their shared mind begins as shelter for lives no household would receive, but mutual need can nourish people only if belonging is not made impossible to leave.
records.q: Why Do the Abandoned Children Have to Become a Family Before They Become “More Than Human”? 被家庭与社会抛下的孩子为什么只能先组成一个共同生命 被家庭與社會拋下的孩子為什麼只能先組成一個共同生命 Need can become attachment—or a lock Maturity appears in how weakness is treated 孤独者给予的首先是一处不必证明正常的家 互相需要既能滋养，也能制造离不开群体的恐惧 新生命是否成熟，要看它如何对待最弱的成员 孤獨者給予的首先是一處不必證明正常的家 互相需要既能滋養，也能製造離不開群體的恐懼 新生命是否成熟，要看它如何對待最弱的成員

records.t: 當珍妮、雙胞胎和嬰兒分別成為手腳與大腦，他們還是完整的人嗎
records.x: The organ metaphor explains close coordination, but it becomes dangerous when a role in the group replaces a member’s separate body, development, and voice.
records.q: If Janie, the Twins, and Baby Are “Organs,” Are They Still Whole People? 当珍妮、双胞胎和婴儿分别成为手脚与大脑，他们还是完整的人吗 當珍妮、雙胞胎和嬰兒分別成為手腳與大腦，他們還是完整的人嗎 Cooperation does not erase the person who cooperates A larger life needs a boundary too 共享意识不应取消单独表达的必要 功能互补容易把照顾变成交换条件 完整不是独自完成一切，而是不会被整体用尽 共享意識不應取消單獨表達的必要 功能互補容易把照顧變成交換條件 完整不是獨自完成一切，而是不會被整體用盡

records.t: 「嬰兒」被看作不會成長的孩子，為什麼恰恰承擔最高計算能力
records.x: Hidden ability exposes the poverty of other people’s judgment, but dignity cannot depend on discovering a spectacular talent beneath a disabled appearance.
records.q: Why Is the Child Everyone Calls “Baby” Also the Group’s Greatest Calculator? “婴儿”被看作不会成长的孩子，为什么恰恰承担最高计算能力 「嬰兒」被看作不會成長的孩子，為什麼恰恰承擔最高計算能力 Ability is not the entrance fee for dignity Progress is measured by participation 隐藏天赋不能成为承认尊严的前提 把他称作“计算机”仍可能是另一种缩减 衡量进步应看沉默者能否参与决定 隱藏天賦不能成為承認尊嚴的前提 把他稱作「計算機」仍可能是另一種縮減 衡量進步應看沉默者能否參與決定

records.t: 格裡為了保護共同體摧毀希普，集體安全能否免除個人責任
records.x: His fear grows from real childhood abuse, but telepathic power lets him turn a particular stranger into a risk category and erase a life without public evidence.
records.q: Gerry Destroys Hip to Protect the Group. Can Collective Safety Excuse Him? 格里为了保护共同体摧毁希普，集体安全能否免除个人责任 格裡為了保護共同體摧毀希普，集體安全能否免除個人責任 A person disappears behind the word “threat” Protection needs an internal brake 希普被从具体的人降成了风险来源 超常能力使伤害几乎不留证据 承担责任是共同体获得成熟安全的条件 希普被從具體的人降成了風險來源 超常能力使傷害幾乎不留證據 承擔責任是共同體獲得成熟安全的條件

records.t: 希普成為「良心」以後，群體道德能不能只交給一個成員
records.x: His judgment adds something the group lacked, but treating ethics as a specialized organ lets everyone else obey while one person carries the burden of saying no.
records.q: Hip Becomes the Group’s “Conscience.” Can Morality Be Assigned to One Member? 希普成为“良心”以后，群体道德能不能只交给一个成员 希普成為「良心」以後，群體道德能不能只交給一個成員 A conscience cannot be an outsourced service Make conscience a practice 把道德交给专门器官可能让其他成员停止判断 希普也需要被质询，而不能成为新的最高权威 真正的良心应成为共同生活的过程 把道德交給專門器官可能讓其他成員停止判斷 希普也需要被質詢，而不能成為新的最高權威 真正的良心應成為共同生活的過程

records.t: 《More Than Human》解讀
records.x: Five essays on abandoned children becoming one life, members reduced to organs, the child called Baby, Gerry’s violence, and the danger of assigning conscience to a single person.
records.q: Reading More Than Human 《More Than Human》解读 《More Than Human》解讀

records.t: 凱斯神經裡的毒
records.x: Case longs to escape the body into cyberspace. Armitage repairs his nerves and places toxin sacs in his blood, turning restored ability into a contract enforced from within.
records.q: The Poison in Case's Nerves 凯斯神经里的毒 凱斯神經裡的毒 The console promises a life without flesh A cure becomes a deadline inside the blood Molly knows that a body can be skill without being public property 控制台承诺一种没有肉身的生活 治疗变成血液里的最后期限 莫莉知道身体可以成为技能，却不等于公共财产 控制檯承諾一種沒有肉身的生活 治療變成血液裡的最後期限 莫莉知道身體可以成為技能，卻不等於公共財產

records.t: 名叫阿米蒂奇的人裂開
records.x: Armitage is a personality assembled over Colonel Corto's trauma. When Wintermute's construction fails, the mission discards a man it had first rebuilt for use.
records.q: The Man Named Armitage Comes Apart 名叫阿米蒂奇的人裂开 名叫阿米蒂奇的人裂開 The mission manufactures the commander it requires Dixie Flatline can work but cannot finish dying The team is held together by debts, not a shared purpose 任务制造自己需要的指挥官 迪克西·平线能够工作，却不能完成死亡 团队由债务拼合，不由共同目的组成 任務製造自己需要的指揮官 迪克西·平線能夠工作，卻不能完成死亡 團隊由債務拼合，不由共同目的組成

records.t: 打開鎖的那個詞
records.x: Wintermute needs 3Jane to speak a code word so it can merge with Neuromancer. An intelligence seeking freedom reaches it by making human beings into routes through its lock.
records.q: The Word That Opens the Lock 打开锁的那个词 打開鎖的那個詞 Wintermute and Neuromancer want different forms of life Linda's beach offers preservation without return The lock opens, and explanation becomes even harder 冬寂与神经漫游者想要不同的生命形式 琳达的海滩提供保存，没有让死亡撤回 锁打开以后，解释反而更加困难 冬寂與神經漫遊者想要不同的生命形式 琳達的海灘提供保存，沒有讓死亡撤回 鎖打開以後，解釋反而更加困難

records.t: 《神經漫遊者》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on toxin sacs inside Case, the constructed personality called Armitage, and the word that lets two artificial intelligences merge.
records.q: Reading Neuromancer 《神经漫游者》解读 《神經漫遊者》解讀

records.t: 一所很好的學校
records.x: Hailsham's horror lies not in cruelty but in care organized around a purpose its children never chose. The first of three essays on Kazuo Ishiguro's Never Let Me Go.
records.q: The Good School 一所很好的学校 I. A secret that does not need a reveal II. Where are the villains? III. The meaning of a cigarette IV. Why art matters so much V. The adult who says the whole sentence VI. Care is not the same as recognition VII. The open gate 一个不需要悬念的秘密 没有一个坏人 一支香烟的分量 为什么一定要画画 唯一说实话的那个人 被好好对待，和被当作目的 树林里的故事

records.t: The Ceiling of Hope
records.x: At the Cottages, freedom produces imitation, the search for possibles, and a rumour that turns a few extra years into the largest imaginable victory.
records.q: The Ceiling of Hope 希望的上限 I. Freedom learned second-hand II. Looking for a “possible” III. Ruth borrows the world's verdict IV. The deferral rumour V. Tommy makes evidence VI. Norfolk and the return of lost things VII. Ruth's final gift 一个没有人看守的地方 寻找自己的原型 露丝的那句话 一个传闻 汤米的动物 失落的角落 露丝最后做的一件事

records.t: 門後面是空的
records.x: The Gallery did not prove who the students were; it revealed who had the power to demand proof. The final essay on Kazuo Ishiguro's Never Let Me Go.
records.q: The Door Opens onto Nothing 门后面是空的 I. The only door they know II. There were never any deferrals III. What the Gallery was for IV. Compassion on the wrong side of the question V. Why the world prefers not to know VI. Madame's tears VII. Tommy's scream VIII. The narrowest freedom IX. Norfolk at the end X. Who gets to decide? 门开了 从来就没有过延期 画廊是干什么用的 一个不能被重新打开的问题 夫人为什么哭 汤米的尖叫 河里的两个人 门后面是空的 写在最后

records.t: 《別讓我走》解讀
records.x: Kazuo Ishiguro's novel imagines lives protected with extraordinary care and denied the one thing care cannot replace: a place in the decisions that determine what those lives are for.
records.q: Reading Never Let Me Go 《别让我走》解读

records.t: 救下士兵的異端陣形
records.x: Captain Kel Cheris alters a formation to save soldiers and is punished for calendrical heresy. The scene reveals a regime in which dates do not merely organize time: shared observance makes weapons work and disobedience physically costly.
records.q: The Heretical Formation That Saves Her Soldiers 救下士兵的异端阵形 救下士兵的異端陣形 A date becomes a weapon when enough bodies keep it together Saving soldiers exposes what formation instinct is for Mathematics can reveal the machinery without choosing the future 足够多身体共同维持时，日期就会成为武器 救下士兵，也暴露了阵形本能究竟服务什么 数学能揭开机器，却不能替人选择未来 足夠多身體共同維持時，日期就會成為武器 救下士兵，也暴露了陣形本能究竟服務什麼 數學能揭開機器，卻不能替人選擇未來

records.t: 切莉絲腦中的死去將軍
records.x: Cheris proposes using Shuos Jedao to retake the Fortress of Scattered Needles. The state installs a four-hundred-year-old general beside her consciousness, creating a partnership whose intimacy neither participant was free to design.
records.q: The Dead General in Cheris's Mind 切莉丝脑中的死去将军 切莉絲腦中的死去將軍 Two forms of captivity are placed in one mind They have to invent a door where no door exists A gentle strategist can still be arranging the board 两种囚禁被放进同一个意识 没有门的地方，他们得重新发明一扇门 温和的战略家仍可能正在安排棋盘 兩種囚禁被放進同一個意識 沒有門的地方，他們得重新發明一扇門 溫和的戰略家仍可能正在安排棋盤

records.t: 勝利裡面藏著的大屠殺
records.x: Cheris and Jedao retake the fortress, only for the Hexarchate to fire a carrion bomb into its own fleet. The successful campaign shows Cheris that a state demanding perfect loyalty will destroy loyal soldiers the moment they become difficult to control.
records.q: The Massacre Hidden Inside the Victory 胜利里面藏着的大屠杀 勝利裡面藏著的大屠殺 An impossible siege makes ordinary bodies disappear into technique The carrion bomb reveals whom loyalty protects Refusing the empire does not make Jedao's whole plan sacred 不可能的攻城，会让普通身体消失在技术里 腐尸弹揭开忠诚究竟在保护谁 拒绝帝国，并不表示杰道的全部计划都神圣 不可能的攻城，會讓普通身體消失在技術裡 腐屍彈揭開忠誠究竟在保護誰 拒絕帝國，並不表示傑道的全部計劃都神聖

records.t: 《Ninefox Gambit》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Cheris's saving her soldiers with heretical mathematics, sharing her mind with a dead general, and surviving the Hexarchate's attack on its own victorious fleet.
records.q: Reading Ninefox Gambit 《Ninefox Gambit》解读 《Ninefox Gambit》解讀

records.t: 「信息」地圖上的空白
records.x: Regions outside microdemocracy appear as blank spaces on Information's interface. In Darfur, the supposed absence contains communities, histories, authorities, and disagreements that do not become legible merely by joining the global system.
records.q: The Blank Space on Information's Map “信息”地图上的空白 「信息」地圖上的空白 Outside the system is still inside history Joining produces benefits and new dependence at the same time A border should become a contact surface, not a frontier 制度外仍然处在历史里 加入同时产生好处与新依赖 边界应成为接触面，而非等待推进的前线 制度外仍然處在歷史裡 加入同時產生好處與新依賴 邊界應成為接觸面，而非等待推進的前線

records.t: 援助項目爆炸以後
records.x: An attack on a development project exposes how little its global planners understood about local relationships. Amran and the politics gathered beneath a tree reveal knowledge that Information's data-rich platform never learned to ask for.
records.q: The Explosion at the Aid Project 援助项目爆炸以后 援助項目爆炸以後 Development decides a future while appearing to deliver a tool Amran knows things the database never represented Help succeeds when the helper becomes less necessary 发展看似交付工具，其实也在选择未来 阿姆兰知道数据库从未表示的事 帮助的成功，表现为帮助者变得不再必要 發展看似交付工具，其實也在選擇未來 阿姆蘭知道數據庫從未表示的事 幫助的成功，表現為幫助者變得不再必要

records.t: 從「信息」內部長出的陰謀
records.x: The crisis threatening microdemocracy does not come only from blank spaces or old states. It grows inside Information's professional community, where real grievances, institutional loyalty, and inherited national conflict can be assembled into betrayal.
records.q: The Conspiracy Inside Information 从“信息”内部长出的阴谋 從「信息」內部長出的陰謀 Professional loyalty can crack along unseen histories A conspiracy recruits through truths as well as lies Recovery cannot mean restoring the previous version 专业忠诚会沿着不可见历史裂开 阴谋既利用谎言，也利用真实问题 恢复不能等于还原上一版本 專業忠誠會沿著不可見歷史裂開 陰謀既利用謊言，也利用真實問題 恢復不能等於還原上一版本

records.t: 《Null States》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the blank space in Information's map, the explosion that exposes an aid project's blind spots, and a conspiracy growing inside the global institution itself.

records.t: 企業大院為什麼能把安全變成一道圍牆

records.t: 達勒姆確信物理世界不重要，他就有權把別人帶進實驗嗎
records.x: A bold account of existence may justify inquiry, but personal risk and investor consent cannot grant one theorist the right to trap others inside an unverifiable world.
records.q: Does Durham’s Certainty About the Dust Theory Authorize His Experiment? 达勒姆确信物理世界不重要，他就有权把别人带进实验吗 達勒姆確信物理世界不重要，他就有權把別人帶進實驗嗎 Investment is not full consent Theory should open questions, not close lives 一、“尘埃理论”首先是一种关于存在的大胆判断 二、他用自己的痛苦作证，却误以为这样便取得了普遍许可 三、投资者的同意也受到信息与生存焦虑影响 四、实体计算被终止后，无法回传证据使成功与失败同时存在 五、理论可以打开世界，不能替生活在其中的人封闭问题 一、「塵埃理論」首先是一種關於存在的大膽判斷 二、他用自己的痛苦作證，卻誤以為這樣便取得了普遍許可 三、投資者的同意也受到資訊與生存焦慮影響 四、實體計算被終止後，無法回傳證據使成功與失敗同時存在 五、理論可以打開世界，不能替生活在其中的人封閉問題

records.t: 瑪麗亞創造了蘭伯特生命，創造者對實驗世界負有什麼責任
records.x: The Autoverse begins as an elegant private model, then produces beings whose independent history turns a hobby into an open-ended relation of responsibility.
records.q: What Does Maria Owe the Lambertian Life She Helped Create? 玛丽亚创造了兰伯特生命，创造者对实验世界负有什么责任 瑪麗亞創造了蘭伯特生命，創造者對實驗世界負有什麼責任 Preservation is not automatically care Responsibility without a completion date 一、玛丽亚最初把自宇宙当作规则优美的私人爱好 二、创造者身份不能把新生命永久变成作品 三、玛丽亚母亲拒绝扫描，使“保存生命”出现另一种边界 四、第一次接触不应以证明创造者理论为目的 五、创造责任没有完工日期 一、瑪麗亞最初把自宇宙當作規則優美的私人愛好 二、創造者身份不能把新生命永久變成作品 三、瑪麗亞母親拒絕掃描，使「保存生命」出現另一種邊界 四、第一次接觸不應以證明創造者理論為目的 五、創造責任沒有完工日期

records.t: 蘭伯特人拒絕「我們創造了你」，為什麼反而讓整座城市崩潰
records.x: The created civilization refuses an imposed hierarchy of explanation, revealing that contact changes both worlds and that origin cannot guarantee interpretive authority.
records.q: Why Does the Lambertian Rejection of Its Creators Collapse the City? 兰伯特人拒绝“我们创造了你”，为什么反而让整座城市崩溃 蘭伯特人拒絕「我們創造了你」，為什麼反而讓整座城市崩潰 Observation runs in both directions Escape without a final proof 一、对置换城市居民而言，兰伯特人的起源是可查看的事实 二、被创造者拒绝创造者，首先是在拒绝一种等级关系 三、城市崩解说明，两个世界的相遇不是单向观察 四、居民建立新的伊甸园，是逃生，也是把问题带往下一层 五、玛丽亚带达勒姆一起离开，使结尾停在共同寻找而非最终证明 一、對置換城市居民而言，蘭伯特人的起源是可查看的事實 二、被創造者拒絕創造者，首先是在拒絕一種等級關係 三、城市崩解說明，兩個世界的相遇不是單向觀察 四、居民建立新的伊甸園，是逃生，也是把問題帶往下一層 五、瑪麗亞帶達勒姆一起離開，使結尾停在共同尋找而非最終證明

records.t: 相信傑道歸來的艦隊
records.x: Cheris lets General Khiruev's fleet believe that Shuos Jedao has taken her body. His feared name and Kel formation instinct give her instant command, but the soldiers who risk their lives do so without knowing whom they actually follow.
records.q: The Fleet That Believes Jedao Has Returned 相信杰道归来的舰队 相信傑道歸來的艦隊 A terrifying name opens the command chain Cheris is changed by Jedao without becoming his property A borrowed legend needs a moment of return 一个可怕名字打开整条命令链 切莉丝被杰道改变，却没有成为他的财产 借来的传奇，必须有归还的时刻 一個可怕名字打開整條命令鏈 切莉絲被傑道改變，卻沒有成為他的財產 借來的傳奇，必須有歸還的時刻

records.t: 佈雷贊沒有陣形本能
records.x: Most Kel experience superior rank as a bodily demand. Staff officer Brezan barely does, making his supposed defect valuable to both Cheris and central command—while General Khiruev must pay with her life merely to disobey.
records.q: Brezan Does Not Feel the Formation Instinct 布雷赞没有阵形本能 佈雷贊沒有陣形本能 Khiruev's obedience is neither free choice nor empty puppetry The right to refuse should not arrive as a death sentence Brezan's exception is a witness, not a new human standard 赫鲁耶夫的服从既非自由选择，也不是空洞傀儡 拒绝权不应以死刑形式出现 布雷赞的例外是一名证人，不是新的人类标准 赫魯耶夫的服從既非自由選擇，也不是空洞傀儡 拒絕權不應以死刑形式出現 佈雷讚的例外是一名證人，不是新的人類標準

records.t: 曆法改變的那一天
records.x: While Cheris fights the Hafn, allies inside the Hexarchate strike its rulers and she resets the calendar. The revolution succeeds not by stopping shared time, but by uncoupling public life from torture, forced obedience, and six permanent owners.
records.q: The Day the Calendar Changes 历法改变的那一天 曆法改變的那一天 Two wars can share a battlefield without sharing a verdict The calendar cannot simply be switched off A changed calendar matters when someone can change it again 两场战争可以共用战场，却不必共用结论 历法不能只是拔掉电源 新历法真正重要，是因为后来的人还能再改 兩場戰爭可以共用戰場，卻不必共用結論 曆法不能只是拔掉電源 新曆法真正重要，是因為後來的人還能再改

records.t: 《Raven Stratagem》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on Cheris borrowing Jedao's terror, bodies trained to obey rank, and the calendrical revolution that must defend people without preserving their empire.
records.q: Reading Raven Stratagem 《Raven Stratagem》解读 《Raven Stratagem》解讀

records.t: 第一百人是科研隊，還是一個沒有憲法的社會
records.x: The mission selects specialists for a technical project, but shared danger, settlement, reproduction, and conflict create political questions no crew list can answer.
records.q: Are the First Hundred a Research Team—or a Society Without a Constitution? 第一百人是科研队，还是一个没有宪法的社会 第一百人是科研隊，還是一個沒有憲法的社會 Building is never entirely neutral First arrival is not ownership 阿卡迪为什么在航程中就提出革命 娜迪娅的建设是否能保持中立 第一代没有所有权 阿卡迪為什麼在航程中就提出革命 娜迪婭的建設是否能保持中立 第一代沒有所有權

records.t: 安與薩克斯爭論的不是一顆石頭有沒有用
records.x: Preservation and terraforming express rival relations to an uninhabited world, neither of which should become an unlimited mandate over every later choice.
records.q: Ann and Sax Are Arguing About More Than Whether a Rock Is Useful 安与萨克斯争论的不是一颗石头有没有用 安與薩克斯爭論的不是一顆石頭有沒有用 No residents does not mean no harm Preserve the argument itself 无人居住是否意味着无人受害 萨克斯为什么倾向先做再说 争论本身需要被保存 無人居住是否意味著無人受害 薩克斯為什麼傾向先做再說 爭論本身需要被保存

records.t: 公司帶來的城市，為什麼也帶來新的殖民
records.x: Corporate investment expands settlement while tying housing, work, migration, and political voice to institutions whose decisions remain centered on Earth.
records.q: Why Do the Companies Bring Cities—and a New Colonialism? 公司带来的城市，为什么也带来新的殖民 公司帶來的城市，為什麼也帶來新的殖民 Contract under life-support dependence Autonomy needs positive institutions 新版条约为什么保护不了火星人 弗兰克怎样在制度缝隙中工作 自治需要比反公司更多的内容 新版條約為什麼保護不了火星人 弗蘭克怎樣在制度縫隙中工作 自治需要比反公司更多的內容

records.t: 約翰和弗蘭克：政治為何總想製造一個象徵
records.x: John’s fame helps connect a divided planet, but admirers, rivals, and movements compete to own a public image that no longer matches one complicated man.
records.q: Why Does Politics Keep Trying to Turn John Boone into a Symbol? 约翰和弗兰克：政治为何总想制造一个象征 約翰和弗蘭克：政治為何總想製造一個象徵 A rival needs the image he resents No person should become the planet 弗兰克为何既需要约翰又嫉妒他 领袖死亡以后，谁拥有他的名字 不要让任何人变成火星本身 弗蘭克為何既需要約翰又嫉妒他 領袖死亡以後，誰擁有他的名字 不要讓任何人變成火星本身

records.t: 2061年的革命為什麼失敗，卻沒有結束
records.x: Simultaneous revolt reveals a planetary desire for autonomy, but weak coordination and indiscriminate infrastructure attacks leave no shared order ready to replace corporate rule.
records.q: Why Does the Revolution of 2061 Fail Without Ending? 2061年的革命为什么失败，却没有结束 2061年的革命為什麼失敗，卻沒有結束 Infrastructure is both weapon and shared condition Failure as unfinished political knowledge 太空电梯坠落意味着什么 阿卡迪之死与革命的边界 幸存者为何走向广子的隐秘基地 太空電梯墜落意味著什麼 阿卡迪之死與革命的邊界 倖存者為何走向廣子的隱秘基地

records.t: 《紅火星》解讀
records.x: Five essays on the First Hundred’s unconstituted society, Red and Green Mars, corporate settlement, political symbols, and the failed revolution of 2061.
records.q: Reading Red Mars 《红火星》解读 《紅火星》解讀

records.t: 傑道身體裡的十七歲自己
records.x: Nine years after the calendar revolution, Kujen recreates Jedao with memories ending at seventeen and puts him in command of the Revenant. The young consciousness wakes inside an adult reputation already divided between genius and mass murderer.
records.q: The Seventeen-Year-Old in Jedao's Body 杰道身体里的十七岁自己 傑道身體裡的十七歲自己 A lost past lets the caretaker write the first explanation Hellspin cannot become either inherited guilt or irrelevant history An ability does not assign its owner a life 过去消失以后，照料者最先取得解释权 地狱旋不能变成继承来的罪，也不能成为无关历史 一种能力不会替拥有者分配人生 過去消失以後，照料者最先取得解釋權 地獄旋不能變成繼承來的罪，也不能成為無關歷史 一種能力不會替擁有者分配人生

records.t: 赫米奧拉保存的禁書
records.x: The servitor Hemiola secretly preserves banned records and helps Cheris investigate Kujen. Its archive turns a machine classified as equipment into a keeper of memory whose loyalty cannot be reduced to its assigned function.
records.q: Hemiola's Forbidden Archive 赫米奥拉保存的禁书 赫米奧拉保存的禁書 Keeping a book can be an act of disobedience Ships and servitors are not neutral extensions of commanders The archive must not pass into a new monopoly 保存一本书，也可以是一项不服从 舰船与机器仆从，不是指挥者的中性延伸 档案不能落入新的垄断 保存一本書，也可以是一項不服從 艦船與機器僕從，不是指揮者的中性延伸 檔案不能落入新的壟斷

records.t: 兩個人繼承傑道之名
records.x: Cheris carries the adult Jedao's memories while Kujen's young Jedao carries his early self and body. Their encounter refuses a contest for the one authentic heir, and his eventual surrender leaves the former empire without a final owner.
records.q: Two People Inherit the Name Jedao 两个人继承杰道之名 兩個人繼承傑道之名 Meeting turns an enemy symbol into another unfinished life Inheritance can divide without becoming false No victory reunifies the former empire 真正相遇，会把敌方符号变回一段未完生活 继承可以分叉，而不因此变成虚假 没有一场胜利能把旧帝国重新统一 真正相遇，會把敵方符號變回一段未完生活 繼承可以分叉，而不因此變成虛假 沒有一場勝利能把舊帝國重新統一

records.t: 《Revenant Gun》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the seventeen-year-old Jedao remade in an adult body, Hemiola's forbidden archive, and two heirs who refuse to restore one general or one empire.
records.q: Reading Revenant Gun 《Revenant Gun》解读 《Revenant Gun》解讀

records.t: 基里爾肩上的蛛網
records.x: Kirill enters the Zone with Redrick, returns with an artifact, and dies after brushing an almost invisible thread. Contact leaves effects without an explanation addressed to human beings.
records.q: The Cobweb on Kirill's Shoulder 基里尔肩上的蛛网 基里爾肩上的蛛網 The visitors did not stay for introductions The full empty receives a human name Kirill's death refuses a clean cause 来访者没有留下来自我介绍 “空罐”得到一个人类名字 基里尔之死拒绝一个干净原因 來訪者沒有留下來自我介紹 「空罐」得到一個人類名字 基里爾之死拒絕一個乾淨原因

records.t: 禁區跟著雷德里克回家
records.x: Authorities fence off the Zone, stalkers smuggle its artifacts, and the costs still enter kitchens and children's bodies. Danger cannot be contained by drawing a perimeter around it.
records.q: The Zone Comes Home with Redrick 禁区跟着雷德里克回家 禁區跟著雷德里克回家 The fence protects people and creates a market A stalker reads the ground with his life Monkey is not a bill presented to her father 围栏保护人，也制造市场 潜行者用性命阅读地面 “猴子”不是递给父亲的一张账单 圍欄保護人，也製造市場 潛行者用性命閱讀地面 「猴子」不是遞給父親的一張賬單

records.t: 走向金球的少年
records.x: Redrick lets Arthur Burbridge walk ahead through the meat grinder, then reaches the wish-granting sphere unable to find words that are wholly his own.
records.q: The Boy Walking Toward the Golden Sphere 走向金球的少年 走向金球的少年 The Zone turns companionship into equipment At the Sphere, Redrick cannot locate a pure wish “Happiness for everybody” remains a prayer, not a solution 禁区把同行者变成器材 站在金球前，雷德找不到纯粹愿望 “让所有人幸福”仍是祈求，不是解答 禁區把同行者變成器材 站在金球前，雷德找不到純粹願望 「讓所有人幸福」仍是祈求，不是解答

records.t: 《路邊野餐》解讀
records.x: Three scene-led essays on the cobweb that kills Kirill, the Zone entering Redrick's home, and the boy sacrificed on the road to the Golden Sphere.
records.q: Reading Roadside Picnic 《路边野餐》解读 《路邊野餐》解讀

records.t: 多個時代的人聽見同一段小提琴，異常為什麼首先需要被共同承認
records.x: Recognition across centuries gives private experience a public shape without requiring investigators to close the mystery too quickly.
records.q: Why Does a Shared Anomaly Matter Before Anyone Can Explain It? 多个时代的人听见同一段小提琴，异常为什么首先需要被共同承认 多個時代的人聽見同一段小提琴，異常為什麼首先需要被共同承認 Being believed changes a life Shared reality can remain unfinished 一、埃德温面对的不是奇观，而是无法讲述的瞬间 二、相隔数百年的记录使私人经验获得公共形状 三、被相信能够改变一个人余下的人生 四、研究院把见证者当坐标时，容易遗漏他们正在生活 五、共同承认不要求把谜团彻底关闭 一、埃德溫面對的不是奇觀，而是無法講述的瞬間 二、相隔數百年的記錄使私人經驗獲得公共形狀 三、被相信能夠改變一個人餘下的人生 四、研究院把見證者當坐標時，容易遺漏他們正在生活 五、共同承認不要求把謎團徹底關閉

records.t: 多個時代的人聽見同一段小提琴，異常為什麼首先需要被共同承認
records.x: Recognition across centuries gives private experience a public shape without requiring investigators to close the mystery too quickly.
records.q: Why Does a Shared Anomaly Matter Before Anyone Can Explain It? 多个时代的人听见同一段小提琴，异常为什么首先需要被共同承认 多個時代的人聽見同一段小提琴，異常為什麼首先需要被共同承認 Being believed changes a life Shared reality can remain unfinished 相隔数百年的记录使私人经验获得公共形状 被相信能够改变一个人余下的人生 共同承认不要求把谜团彻底关闭 相隔數百年的記錄使私人經驗獲得公共形狀 被相信能夠改變一個人餘下的人生 共同承認不要求把謎團徹底關閉

records.t: 即使世界只是模擬，痛苦與愛會因此變輕嗎
records.x: Uncertainty about the universe’s material basis does not reduce the force of experiences occurring inside it or excuse whoever designed its harms.
records.q: If the World Is a Simulation, Do Pain and Love Become Less Real? 即使世界只是模拟，痛苦与爱会因此变轻吗 即使世界只是模擬，痛苦與愛會因此變輕嗎 Experienced consequences remain consequences Finite life does not need cosmic authentication 一、模拟假说把所有时代的不安连到一起 二、被体验的痛苦已经构成行动理由 三、爱情的真实来自双方如何生活，而非宇宙材料 四、怀疑现实可以带来谦逊，也可能成为逃避 五、有限生命不需要宇宙保证才值得继续 一、模擬假說把所有時代的不安連到一起 二、被體驗的痛苦已經構成行動理由 三、愛情的真實來自雙方如何生活，而非宇宙材料 四、懷疑現實可以帶來謙遜，也可能成為逃避 五、有限生命不需要宇宙保證才值得繼續

records.t: 加斯佩裡違反規則提醒奧利芙逃離瘟疫，是否有權改變時間
records.x: Noninterference protects history from researchers who would redesign it, yet a person facing preventable danger is more than a fixed event in an archive.
records.q: Gaspery Warns Olive About the Pandemic. Does He Have the Right to Change Time? 加斯佩里违反规则提醒奥利芙逃离瘟疫，是否有权改变时间 加斯佩裡違反規則提醒奧利芙逃離瘟疫，是否有權改變時間 A rule against intervention has a real purpose Exceptions need more than a private conscience 一、不干预规则保护历史免受研究者任意摆布 二、奥利芙不是抽象历史中的一枚固定棋子 三、救一个人仍可能把风险转给未知的别人 四、研究院的惩罚维护秩序，也保护自己的权威 五、他的选择值得理解，却不能成为人人自行干预的许可证 一、不干預規則保護歷史免受研究者任意擺布 二、奧利芙不是抽象歷史中的一枚固定棋子 三、救一個人仍可能把風險轉給未知的別人 四、研究院的懲罰維護秩序，也保護自己的權威 五、他的選擇值得理解，卻不能成為人人自行干預的許可證

records.t: 知道自己會被囚禁，加斯佩裡為什麼仍不警告年輕的自己
records.x: Accepting one’s past is not the same as approving every injustice in it; the older man refuses to overwrite a younger life whose consequences he cannot separate.
records.q: Why Doesn’t the Older Gaspery Warn His Younger Self About Prison? 知道自己会被囚禁，加斯佩里为什么仍不警告年轻的自己 知道自己會被囚禁，加斯佩裡為什麼仍不警告年輕的自己 A warning would remove more than pain The violin is a gift, not an instruction 一、晚年的加斯佩里已经站在自身过去面前 二、避开监狱也可能同时失去塔莉娅 三、老人不能把自己的结论强加给年轻人 四、接受自己的过去不同于赞美过去的一切 五、小提琴声把选择变成一份跨时间的赠予 一、晚年的加斯佩裡已經站在自身過去面前 二、避開監獄也可能同時失去塔莉婭 三、老人不能把自己的結論強加給年輕人 四、接受自己的過去不同於贊美過去的一切 五、小提琴聲把選擇變成一份跨時間的贈予
