records.q: The Wager 赌约

records.t: Jingkang
records.x: Yang Kang learns that the life he knows was built from a crime and is ordered to return it all at once.
records.q: Jingkang 靖康

records.t: 桃花島
records.x: The freest man in the martial world permits no law on his island except his own.
records.q: Peach Blossom Island 桃花岛

records.t: Black Marsh
records.x: A child becomes a strategic move, and four adult lives begin again from the afternoon he dies.
records.q: Black Marsh 黑沼

records.t: The Great Khan
records.x: Genghis Khan truly loves and rewards Guo Jing, then asks the young man to make that love a command.
records.q: The Great Khan 大汗

records.t: 《射鵰英雄傳》解讀
records.x: Five essays on a wager made with unborn children, an inherited name, an island ruled by one voice, a child used as a move, and the Great Khan's unanswered question.
records.q: Reading Legends of the Condor Heroes 《射雕英雄传》解读

records.t: 半個饅頭
records.x: At six, Meng Xinghun receives half a cold, hard bun from Gao Jiping. The rescue is real, and so is the lifetime later collected in its name. The hardest debt is owed to someone who truly saved you.
records.q: The Price of Half a Bun 半个馒头 When rescue acquires a job description The last job that never quite becomes the last Why Boss Gao cannot be reduced to a villain Gratitude without surrender 救命之恩后来长出了用途 高老大不是一个简单的恶人 一个人怎样还完救命之恩

records.t: 老伯的賬
records.x: Sun Yubo is father, patron, and center of a powerful organization. He reads people brilliantly and accepts terrible losses, yet a system that places everyone in its ledger eventually changes loyalty itself.
records.q: The Old Master’s Ledger 老伯的账 He does care The loyal deputy who inventories the throne A ledger large enough to include everyone What the account cannot price 他真的在乎手下的人 越了解一个人，越知道怎样取代他 一本把所有人都算进去的账 算不进去的人

records.t: Little Butterfly
records.x: Lü Xiangchuan’s violence does not reduce Little Butterfly to an explanatory wound, nor does her father’s exile define what follows. Meng accepts the life and child who arrive together.
records.q: Little Butterfly 小蝶 The event the household cannot contain Two strangers beside the water Ye Xiang’s last refusal “Your child is my child” 孙府容不下的一件事 水边的两个陌生人 叶翔最后没有替她决定 “你的孩子就是我的孩子”

records.t: 《流星·蝴蝶·劍》解讀
records.x: Three essays on half a cold bun, the vast ledger of the Sun estate, and Little Butterfly after exile: a reading of lives that remain larger than the debts, offices, and family names meant to contain them.
records.q: Reading Meteor, Butterfly, Sword 《流星·蝴蝶·剑》解读

records.t: 孤兒
records.x: Every adult initially receives Yang Guo for a reason located elsewhere; the first complete teaching comes from someone who has never learned society's reasons.
records.q: The Orphan 孤儿 Judged through a father he never knew Misconduct as proof of the arrangement The first complete gift

records.t: 師徒
records.x: The most righteous man in the novel enforces a moral order that cannot permit Yang Guo and Xiaolongnü's relation to exist.
records.q: Master and Disciple 师徒 A relation grows before its prohibition appears The same measure for two persons Lived without ratification

records.t: 斷臂
records.x: After irreversible loss, Yang Guo builds a martial practice from abandoned materials, a wordless bird, and the conditions of his own changing life.
records.q: The Severed Arm 断臂 A permanent consequence, an incomplete remorse An inheritance that records its error A skill belonging to one life

records.t: Sixteen Years
records.x: A lie saves Yang Guo by replacing his choice with a promise; the years that follow reveal what he makes from a life returned without consent.
records.q: Sixteen Years 十六年 A rescue that overrides its recipient Gifts with no return clause How a false promise becomes true

records.t: 襄陽
records.x: Guo Jing's self-chosen law becomes the fate of his family, while Yang Guo joins its public work without surrendering his incompatible private law.
records.q: Xiangyang 襄阳 When one's own law becomes another's fate Agreement without conversion The hero who does not stay for the name

records.t: 《神鵰俠侶》解讀
records.x: Five essays on an orphan governed by other people's debts, a forbidden teacher–student love, a martial art rebuilt after loss, a life-saving lie, and two incompatible laws meeting at Xiangyang.
records.q: Reading The Return of the Condor Heroes 《神雕侠侣》解读

records.t: 讓
records.x: Li Xunhuan gives his beloved, estate, and the truth to a sworn brother. The celebrated sacrifice leaves only Lin Shiyin—the person never asked—to name what was taken.
records.q: Giving Her Away 让 A sacrifice performed on someone else What the gift did to its recipient The lie outlives the performance Her first unarranged answer 一场没有问过她的成全 让出去之后 谎言活过了十年 第二次安排

records.t: 兵器譜
records.x: Bai Xiaosheng ranks forty-three fighters only after excluding women and the “unorthodox.” The list then turns living people into numbers they feel obliged to inhabit.
records.q: The Weapons Register 兵器谱 When a person becomes a number The first three fall in reverse Those the list cannot measure The vacant top 号码开始替人活着 前三名倒着死去 榜外之人 空出来的第一

records.t: 林仙兒
records.x: A-Fei loses more than a lover: his judgment must pass through another person’s permission. The novel counts Lin’s sexuality obsessively and this deeper seizure only rarely.
records.q: Lin Xian’er 林仙儿 She saves him because he can be used The life in the plum grove The crime the novel prefers to count The same method turned in both directions Judgment grows back 救他，也使用他 梅林里的生活 书定下的罪名 同一种用法 重新长回来的判断

records.t: The Cough
records.x: Li’s outward self-sacrifice is called loyalty and its inward form devotion. Sun Xiaohong alone refuses to admire the cough and asks him to live.
records.q: The Cough 咳嗽 One gesture, praised under two names What he once possessed Other people pay the bill The one person who does not admire the cough Coming out of the stone chamber 两次被赞美的自我处理 他交出去的东西 别人替他付账 唯一要他活的人 从石门里出来

records.t: 《多情劍客無情劍》解讀
records.x: Four essays on a sacrifice made without its beneficiary’s consent, a ranking that first decides who counts, judgment captured from within, and self-erasure mistaken for devotion.
records.q: Reading Sentimental Swordsman, Ruthless Sword 《多情剑客无情剑》解读

records.t: 無招
records.x: Linghu Chong learns that freedom is not having no tradition, but being able to move where no teacher has supplied the next approved step.
records.q: No Form 无招 The space between approved moves Two ways of transmitting power Freedom still has a cost

records.t: 君子劍
records.x: Yue Buqun's public virtue, Lin Pingzhi's revenge, and Yue Lingshan's final request reveal three different ways a purpose can consume a life.
records.q: The Gentleman Sword 君子剑 A real life inside a public role When one purpose becomes the whole self The path that excludes him

records.t: The Duet
records.x: The score of “Smiling Proud Wanderer” crosses the orthodox–unorthodox boundary without asking its heirs to inherit the boundary itself.
records.q: The Duet 合奏 A relationship put on trial An inheritance without a side Care that does not collect its recipient

records.t: 一統
records.x: Orthodox alliance and demonic cult reproduce the same machinery whenever a position requires uniform speech, loyalty, and posture.
records.q: Unification 一统 A classification that need not inspect facts The same summit on the other side Refusing the posture

records.t: 那把鎖
records.x: Hengshan uses leadership to shelter difference, while the novel's final joke turns binding from coercion into a relation deliberately chosen.
records.q: The Lock 那把锁 Protection without redesign Care without a claim Two bindings

records.t: 《笑傲江湖》解讀
records.x: Five essays on formless skill, public virtue, music across a forbidden boundary, institutions that reproduce domination, and the difference between a bond imposed and a bond chosen.
records.q: Reading The Smiling, Proud Wanderer 《笑傲江湖》解读

records.t: 麗春院
records.x: Wei Xiaobao lives by a rule of his own, but its narrow border leaves other people outside.
records.q: The Rule He Brought from Lijing House 丽春院

records.t: 總舵主
records.x: Chen Jinnan completes an inherited mission so faithfully that it leaves no place for him.
records.q: The Chief Helmsman 总舵主

records.t: Little Xuanzi
records.x: The emperor's only unpurchased friendship cannot survive the shape of imperial power.
records.q: Little Xuanzi 小玄子

records.t: 反清復明
records.x: A restoration still beyond the horizon already has offices, factions, and a proposed emperor.
records.q: Overthrow the Qing, Restore the Ming 反清复明

records.t: The Leopard Embryo Pill
records.x: The perfect reward feels wonderful today and must be renewed under authority next year.
records.q: The Leopard Embryo Pill 豹胎

records.t: 《鹿鼎記》解讀
records.x: Five essays on a private code with a narrow border, a perfect servant of a ruined cause, friendship under sovereignty, restoration without a future, and a reward that must be renewed.
records.q: Reading The Deer and the Cauldron 《鹿鼎记》解读

records.t: The Double
records.x: Yan Nanfei appears, fights, and receives fame for Gongzi Yu. When the mask is vacant again, Fu Hongxue faces a complete identity whose purpose has already been assigned.
records.q: The Double 替身 A name another person can wear The weapon that kills while absent Defeating the man inside the mask Refusal as the final victory 一个可以穿上的名字 一件丢失的兵器怎样继续杀人 打败面具里的人 不接，胜负就已经结束

records.t: 《天涯·明月·刀》解讀
records.x: One essay on Yan Nanfei’s mask, Gongzi Yu’s prematurely aged face, a name another person can wear, and why Fu Hongxue defeats the position by refusing to inherit it.
records.q: Reading The Horizon, the Bright Moon, the Saber 《天涯·明月·刀》解读

records.t: 一個計劃
records.x: To save two infants, Lianxing invents a revenge that will culminate twenty years later. It preserves their lives that day by laying claim to the lives they have not yet lived.
records.q: A Plan 一个计划 A wrong committed against refusal Two children on a drawing board They become friends first 一件谁也没有做错的事 用十八年换来的当天 图纸上的两个孩子 先成为朋友

records.t: 惡人谷
records.x: Five villains teach Xiao Yu’er everything they know in hopes of producing perfect evil. He learns every skill and chooses uses they never prescribed.
records.q: Villains’ Valley 恶人谷 Making a child into a masterpiece The result grows away from its use Teachers who trust no one How the list closes 把一个孩子做成作品 结果没有按用途生长 不交出信任的人 名单最后怎样收场

records.t: 移花宮
records.x: Hua Wuque receives unmatched skill, manners, and discipline but never the reason for his single command. Unable to refuse the duel, he chooses to die in it.
records.q: Yihua Palace 移花宫 The reason withheld Two educations The only side on which he can fall Lianxing’s last moment 没有交给他的理由 两种教育 他只能决定往哪边倒 怜星等到最后一刻

records.t: Jiang Qin
records.x: The servant who sells his master’s escape becomes a universally admired hero. Jiang Biehe’s finest skill is making the entire jianghu explain him on his behalf.
records.q: Jiang Qin 江琴 A new name for an old method How to manufacture a hero Bad names and good names The education of a trickster The father and son after reputation 一句话换来的一生 怎样经营一个大侠 恶名与好名 骗子教出的本事 父子最后的位置

records.t: 那一戰
records.x: Every stage of Yaoyue’s plan succeeds until the last stroke. She can arrange the brothers’ lives but cannot decide where either man’s sword will fall.
records.q: The Duel 那一战 The difficulty of losing convincingly The woman who breaks her own plan The destination arrives—and disappears Every step but the last The one stroke left unassigned 要输得像真的 说破计划的人 计划终于抵达终点 每一步都成功，最后一步失败 只剩那一剑

records.t: 《絕代雙驕》解讀
records.x: Five essays on a revenge devised to save two infants, two rival educations, a heroic reputation manufactured from betrayal, and a duel both brothers enter intending to lose.
records.q: Reading The Legendary Siblings 《绝代双骄》解读

records.t: 一隻鵝
records.x: Hu Fei pursues justice for a family he never knew and for a goose that never existed.
records.q: A Goose 一只鹅

records.t: 掌門
records.x: An imperial celebration of the martial world quietly converts its leaders into an inventory.
records.q: The Assembly of Sect Leaders 掌门

records.t: 圓性
records.x: Yuan Ziyi is required to save her father three times before avenging the mother he violated.
records.q: Yuanxing 圆性

records.t: 靈素
records.x: The novel's most intelligent person finds a place beside Hu Fei, then chooses life for him without permission.
records.q: Cheng Lingsu 灵素

records.t: 《飛狐外傳》解讀
records.x: Four essays on justice for strangers, the state's inventory of the jianghu, a daughter ordered to save and kill the same man, and the novel's clearest mind choosing another person's life.
records.q: Reading The Young Flying Fox 《飞狐外传》解读

records.t: 偏不喜歡
records.x: A king's refusal seals a culture away; Li Wenxiu's refusal leaves everyone else's choices untouched.
records.q: I Simply Do Not Like Them 偏不喜欢

records.t: 《白馬嘯西風》解讀
records.x: One essay on two nearly identical refusals: a king closes a culture for everyone, while a young woman speaks only for herself and leaves the world intact.
records.q: Reading White Horse Neighs in the Western Wind 《白马啸西风》解读

records.t: 惡名
records.x: Xiao’s name is credible enough for any crime and defended by no school, making it public property for anyone who needs a culprit. He neither clears it nor lives down to it.
records.q: A Useful Bad Name 恶名 The most convenient culprit The thief who can afford noodles When the name reaches the scene first A good name put to work The theft everyone expects 一个最好用的名字 只请得起牛肉面的大盗 名字怎样抢在眼睛前面 好名声的用法 所有人都认定他会抢

records.t: Two Pieces of Jade
records.x: Shen Bijun and Lian Chengbi are both named for flawless jade. One leaves a perfectly assigned place; the other feeds more lives into the cracks of a perfect public self.
records.q: Two Pieces of Jade 璧 The name arrives before the man The first step taken without a role The other flawless jade Leaving without acquiring a new title 一桩人人看好的完整婚姻 名字先到了她眼前 有人终于在等她 另一块璧 名分开始坍塌

records.t: Doll Manor
records.x: Xiaoyao Hou collects living people as dolls, while the Deer-Cutting Saber concentrates borrowed value. The open ending leaves two lives on a dead-end road and Feng Siniang finally answering Yang Kaitai.
records.q: Doll Manor 玩偶 Two kinds of sight in one prison A saber made valuable by everyone else Feng Siniang does not barter care An ending that does not certify survival Who remains more than a doll 同一座庄子里的两种看见 人人看见，才值钱的刀 风四娘没有拿爱交换 没有替读者封口的结局 谁是玩偶，谁仍在行动

records.t: 《蕭十一郎》解讀
records.x: Three essays on a useful bad name, two people named for flawless jade, a manor that collects living dolls, and the different acts by which Shen Bijun and Feng Siniang step outside assigned roles.
records.q: Reading Xiao Shiyilang 《萧十一郎》解读

records.t: 從一個問題進來，沿一條思想走下去。
records.x: A multilingual library of philosophical essays by Han Qin, beginning with ordinary life, AI, history, and stories and opening toward the Self-as-an-End tradition.
records.q: Enter through a question. Follow the thought as far as it goes. 从一个问题进来，沿一条思想走下去。 從一個問題進來，沿一條思想走下去。 Five ways into the library 从五扇门进入 從五扇門進入 Why is a person more than a function? 为什么人不只是一种功能？ 為什麼人不只是一種功能？ How do we care without taking over? 怎样关心一个人，又不接管他的人生？ 怎樣關心一個人，又不接管他的人生？ What becomes visible when machines answer? 当机器开始回答，人的什么反而显现出来？ 當機器開始回答，人的什麼反而顯現出來？ Why do orders rise, harden, and lose sight of people? 秩序为什么兴起、固化，又逐渐看不见其中的人？ 秩序為什麼興起、固化，又逐漸看不見其中的人？ What can a story show before a theory can name it? 一个故事能比理论更早让我们看见什么？ 一個故事能比理論更早讓我們看見什麼？ New and newly reconsidered 新作，也包括重新想过的旧作 新作，也包括重新想過的舊作 Value is not a prize awarded from outside a life. 价值不是从一个人的生活之外颁发的奖章。 價值不是從一個人的生活之外頒發的獎章。
